excerpt: A relationship is built upon many things, some primary things being trust, communication, and connection. contentHtml:
A relationship is built upon many things, some primary things being trust, communication, and connection. There are times that you may feel that the relationship is not sailing on a smooth sea, and you’re fighting on the small things that should have been resolved without any communication at all. Either you talk or fight, or barely talk at all. To deal with this and find a solution, going to a marriage counselling in Gurgaon and Delhi NCR with a qualified expert can help you understand how and where you are going wrong. It’s a preventative measure and a communication channel to help you know what is wrong and fix it together.

You don’t have to be somebody who is already dealing with the crisis in your relationship. Connect with us, simply to know how to communicate better.

Hundred percent confidential | 20+ years of experience with couples

Why do Couples Seek Marriage Counselling in Gurgaon and Delhi NCR?

When a couple searches for a marriage counsellor in Gurgaon and Delhi NCR, it means that somewhere or the other, they have been struggling for months with their relationship or marriage and are asking for a helping hand to revive the relationship for the better. This search is a positive sign that they want to work on it together.

Communication Issues

They might be having the same fights on loop, or a partner is feeling unheard in this situation. There is a lot of defensiveness and a buildup of silent treatment within the partners. The conversations may not be as positive and turn into blame within seconds.

Trust Issues

The partners may feel that they are into physical or emotional affairs, dealing with suspicious mindset, and difficulty dealing with it when the truth comes out.

Emotional Distance and Intimacy

Somewhere down the road, couples feel like they are living like roommates, without any kind of affection or shared time for each other. The scene may be such that one partner reaches out and the other withdraws, leaving a rift in between.

Family and Cultural Pressure

There are expectations within the family regarding views on roles, caregiving and children or money. Usually couples get caught between their partners and their parents, and this has been a long standing cultural difference which we deal with during marriage counselling.

Work Life Stress

In a cities like Gurgaon and Delhi NCR, long commutes and demanding corporate jobs are quite common and a part of daily life. Since now the couples are in dual careers, giving time to each other can be a big task.

How a Marriage Counsellor can Help

A good marriage counsellor will act like your guide and neutral point of view, rather than a judge. When you will be undertaking the sessions in their guidance, they will be focusing on your patterns and pointing you towards the direction of positivity, not pointing at somebody who is right or wrong in a particular situation.

Communication and Listening

A couple work on some practical skills like speaking without adding blame to the conversation, taking a moment during heated talks and trying to hear the other side of the story as well.

Recurring Conflicts

When there are back to back conflicts in the same situation, there is always a surface argument and a real issue beneath it. So helping the clients understand and delve deep into what real issues are something we tackle up.

Rebuilding Trust

Trust is a big thing, and rebuilding it step-by-step works wonders. It covers accountability, transparency, and patience in the relationship with support from both partners.

Life Transitions

Big transitions like having a baby, shifting places, losing jobs or changing one and caring for aging parents can have a lasting impact on a couple. We help them get these feelings out in the open and talk openly about it.

After a successful couple counseling in Gurgaon and Delhi NCR, partners often report that they have calmer conversations, know the root cause of their issues and feel like a team again.

Our Approach to Couples Counselling in Gurgaon and Delhi NCR

Our treatment approach at Tulasi Healthcare is quite simple. Every structure that is built is flexible and personalised by a marriage therapist in Gurgaon and Delhi NCR. We build an understanding according to your needs, goals, and concerns.

Evidence Based Methods

We take a lot of therapy into consideration, like-

  1. Gottman Therapy: This works with understanding each other, managing conflict and building friendship within a couple
  2. EFT: It builds upon emotional bonds and repairs a broken communication channel.
  3. CBT: It challenges, unhelpful behaviours, and thought patterns that are becoming a problem in your relationship.

Safe and Confidential Space

We take utmost care of your privacy and confidentiality. Providing equal time to both partners, we make sure that we are taking no sides and no judgement is built around culture, religion, or background that you come from.

Personalised Plans

Our plans are built around goals that are set in the early communications, the progress is reviewed on a timely basis, and we also provide homework and activities to the couples which helps him repair their bond in private and comfortable settings.

Relationship Counselling: not Just for Married Couples

Relationship counselling in Gurgaon and Delhi NCR can be taken by any couple, despite the fact that they are married or not. There are many kinds of relationships that exist in this modern society, and each one holds equal value for us.

Premarital Counselling

It is a level of counselling that is provided before a couple enters into a marriage. It helps them talk through their expectations from each other, the finances they are going to share and the level of family involvement they want in each other’s life. It helps them understand what their goals are for the future and if they are aligned for the same.

Live in Long-term Partners

Usually, there is a different point of view on commitment amongst such couples and they want to understand how moving in and marriage in the future will help them grow.

Separation and Divorce Decisions

When a couple comes to us with these kinds of issues, we try to understand their thinking clearly, where this decision has come from and how communication between them works. We helped him decide what is best without pushing reconciliation or separation.

What to Expect from Your First Couples counselling Session in Gurgaon and Delhi NCR?

The first session can be very unexpected, and many couples feel nervous before coming in. At Tulasi Healthcare, we make sure that each person is at their best comfort level before sharing anything with us. The first session looks more like a general conversation rather than going into things in the first go.

Intake Conversation

We have a proper session, with the therapist will ask your history, current problems and what each partner hopes for from this communication. We do see the partners together, sometimes separately or both as well.

Goal Setting

Defining and knowing what better looks like for each of the partners is something that we need to measure quantitatively and qualitatively as well. We try to measure these goals from the perspective of both partners and set a common precedent.

Number of Sessions

We don’t have a typical range for a number of sessions, as each client varies in their own way, and the goals that they have set. It varies according to what kind of goals you have set, what is your progress and how you are growing.

Signs it’s time to Seek Marriage Counselling

Here are some common pointers that you can look into if you feel that you are requiring marriage counselling, and can help from seeing an expert.

  • – You are avoiding each other, without having any kind of conversation to resolve that conflict that started everything in the first place.
  • – You have repeated and unsolved fights, which do not reach a conclusion and create a sense of uncertainty and distance in your relationship.
  • – There is always some kind of contempt or sarcasm in your tone towards your partner, that comes out, knowingly, or unknowingly.
  • – When your partner shuts down and does not let you in even after multiple persuasion and attempts.
  • – You are thinking about separation.
  • – When you feel that your trust has been broken and no necessary measures have been taken by your partner to repair them.

Questions to Ask Yourself –

  1. Are we talking about it properly?
  2. Do I feel heard in this situation? and,
  3. When did we last talk about things without arguing?

If the answers to these questions are not clear and you see these signs within your relationship, marriage counselling in Gurgaon and Delhi ncr can give you a right place to start a conversation.

Online and in Person Sessions

Tulasi Healthcare provides both online and in person sessions for couples seeking counselling with us.

In the online format, we have flexible timings, privacy from the comfort of your home and it is ideal for professionals and partners that live in different cities and are unable to get time from their busy schedule.

In person sessions are also available, and they provide deeper presence in connection with a dedicated calm space.

Both the methods are equally effective, with no change in its quality and concern from our experts. If you’re looking for a marriage therapist near me, our clinic is at- Sector 64, Golf Course Extension Road, opposite M3M URBANA, next to Shriram millennium school, Gurugram, Haryana 122102.

You don’t have to Figure this Out on Your Own

When you are estranged in a relationship, you may feel that the world is collapsing around you and the one person that you could rely on is being taken away. This feeling is very isolating and we understand it on a personal and human level with you. We provide a confidential, judgement free marriage counselling in Gurgaon and Delhi NCR at Tulasi Healthcare and help you build a better connection with your partners through our therapeutic modalities.

Connect with us to a simple call, WhatsApp, online booking form or walk-in.

Your first step can be a simple conversation with us.

Frequently Asked Questions

FAQ's

Is Couple counselling confidential?

Yes. Everything that is shared in a confined space with us during therapy is very confidential. It isn’t disclosed to any family members and employers except in rare situations where serious risk to safety is present or it’s a legal requirement.

What if my partner is reluctant to attend?

You can start with yourself as well. Invite your partner to a session gently, framing it more like support rather than blame. Many reluctant partners join afterwards when they see that their loved ones are improving and they see changes.

How many sessions will we need?

It depends on your goals, and that kind of problem that you bring. Many couples notice progress within 6 to 8 sessions, though confidential and complex issues take longer. Your therapist will review the progress regularly.

Can marriage counselling save a relationship on the brink?

It can help many couples repair their trust and companionship, but the outcomes around it are not guaranteed. Even when couples part, counseling can help them decide their journey with clarity and respect.

Is there a marriage therapist near me in Gurgaon?

Yes. Our cleaning is at Sector 64, Golf Course Extension Road, opposite M3M URBANA, next to Shriram millennium school, Gurugram, Haryana 122102. We also have online sessions available if you prefer to attend from the comfort of your home. CONTACT US

Get In Touch With Us

contentHtml:

What Mental Health Services are available in Noida?

The care pathway at a mental health clinic in Noida is very simple – have a consultation, get an assessment, undergo therapy and medication. The admission process comes if needed and the follow-ups remain throughout the process. We have both OPD and inpatient care available and in case of emergencies our hospital is open 24 x 7.

Psychiatric Consultation

During the visit, our mental health doctor in Noida takes care of your concerns through history, taking, symptom review, and mental status exam. You should come in if you feel that you are consistently in a low mood, undergoing sleep problems and feel your behaviour has changed for the worse. If you feel habits are going out of hand and turning into addiction, you can join us here along with your family and any documents of your previous visits to any consultation areas.

Psychological Assessment​

We conduct proper clinical interviews along with standardised tests for concerns like depression, anxiety, IQ, developmental issues, personality, and neuro physiological issues. Sometimes these tests are very important due to some common reasons like unclear diagnosis, behavioural concerns, and establishing any pre-treatment baselines. These steps are performed by our expert staff, which are provided along with the written report.

Psychotherapy & Counselling

Our team offers therapeutic modalities like CBT, DBT, trauma focused therapy, motivational interviewing, and any supportive counselling required. The session length and frequency for any typical course of therapy is anything between 8 to 12 weeks and it may also fluctuate according to the severity of the concern being faced by the individual. We have all the options available – individual, group and online options. Our mental health treatment in Noida is not confined to a singular space.

Inpatient Psychiatric Care​

Inpatient psychiatric care is available for people who are dealing with acute psychosis, severe depression, mania, suicide, risk, and severe withdrawal. We have voluntary and admission available at our mental Hospital in Noida and patient rights reserved under Mental Healthcare Act 2017.

Addiction Treatment​

Addiction treatment is available at Tulasi Healthcare for substances like alcohol, opioid, cannabis and prescription drugs. Our stages of rehab include medically supervised detox, rehabilitation and then relapse prevention. At our psychiatric clinic in Noida, we provide nonjudgemental space to fight the stigma around substance abuse and provide after-care in the months after treatment.

Family Counselling

At Family Counselling, families are informed about the illnesses their loved ones are going through along with warning signs and medication management. They are also advised on how to support the patients in the right way.

What Mental Health Conditions can be Treated?

We have a treatment plan ready for a variety of conditions under the expert care of our mental health doctors in Noida. We treat every age group – adults, adolescents, and children. Let’s explore some major concerns that we see at our mental Hospital on a regular basis.

Depression

Having low mood, loss of interest in things, sleep issues and appetite changes can direct you towards the issue of depression. We provide proper medical treatment along with therapeutic modalities involved through our mental health treatment in Noida.

Anxiety Disorders

Anxiety disorder feels like a racing heart, tight chest, and a mind that won’t switch off. You may also have a breakdown in more severe conditions like phobias, panic attack, and social anxiety. Therapy and medication help you in understanding their effects on your life, and then helping to control them with therapeutic modalities like CBT and EMDR with the help of a mental health doctor in Noida.

Bipolar Disorder

Bipolar disorder comes in the form of highs and lows in life and mood. During the highest there is little sleep, big ideas and impulsive thoughts. During the loss, deep depression is present with withdrawal and stress that comes with a big responsibility of management. Sometimes it may become severe, so it may require medication management. So early intervention is a big concern when it comes to bipolar disorder.

Schizophrenia & Psychotic Disorders

Families notice a sense of unrealistic realities and uncommon thoughts that originate from the person suffering from schizophrenia and other psychiatric disorders. They lose their sense of reality and complain about hearing voices, face suspiciousness around things and have withdrawn from their social life. Early treatment in these cases improves outcomes and short hospital stay sometimes is needed at the start if the cases are very severe.

OCD

OCD is an intrusive loop of thoughts and behaviours that come along with anxiety and compulsion. It gives the person experiencing the loop a brief relief of sometime before the thought returns to start the vicious cycle again. Some every day examples include repeated hand washing, checking the locks and counting things without being sure about it. This is not just about being “neat.” The treatment modalities include ERP plus medication management in severe cases.

PTSD & Trauma-Related Disorders

Trauma follows you in a way that an event that has happened long ago, can leave a big mark on your mind and psyche. This event can be an accident, loss of a loved one, violence or abuse. The way it manifests is having flashbacks, nightmares, and being easily started or avoiding reminders around it. Therapy here is based in a way that it takes care of the person’s comfort while allowing them to reconsider events in a more accepting light.

Substance Use & Addiction

Substance use never starts as an addiction in itself. It starts as a habit, or a habitual casual concern that turns into dependence over time. It is a medical condition that originates from inability to withdraw from a certain habit. It has a proper treatment path that is properly available to discuss in a psychiatric clinic in Noida.

Personality Disorders

A personality disorder is not a character flaw. It is a long standing pattern of emotions, relationships and distorted self image. Personality disorders can be of many types and delving into it requires proper standardised assessment and concerns that go towards therapy like DBT and structured assessments as the treatment progresses.

Sleep Disorders

Sleep disorder is a vicious cycle of mood and sleep concerns. If any of the 2 is disturbed in a certain way, the other one loses its balance automatically. Disturbed sleep cycles, insomnia, and hypersomnia can trigger issues like depression, anxiety, or mania. The treatment path here covers solving sleep habits, getting therapeutic management and medication if required.

Child & Adolescent Mental Health Issues

As a parent, you can understand when your child goes to a concern, it is very difficult for you to understand them since you are a parent for the first time yourself. For younger children and adolescents, the treatment and the symptoms are very different. As the best mental health specialist in Noida, our team helps you understand your child’s concerns in a way that they are able to communicate and share their concerns with us, so a timely intervention is available.

How does Mental Health Treatment Work?

Our mental health treatment in Noida is very structured, personalised and confidential in an ethical manner. The treatment follows a very defined and proper process, which is followed and standardised for every individual that visits us.

Initial Assessment

During the initial assessment, a mental health doctor in Noida takes your family history, your personal medical history, your symptoms that you are facing and a family background that can help us track where these issues are coming from.

Diagnosis

Taking the clinical expertise and criteria as a basis of diagnosis (ICD 11 or DSM 5), we explain the situation and concerns that are shared by them in a plain and understandable language.

Personalized Treatment Plan

Every individual is different, and so is their concern. We always plan a mix of therapy, medication and lifestyle changes according to the issues shared by the individual and how comfortable they are in following a certain pathway for their treatment. Our mental health clinic in Noida, always takes care of the ethical and comfort concerns that are shared by our clients.

Therapy Sessions

There are multiple types of therapeutic management patterns which are applied at different frequencies in the way that the patients require them along with other therapeutic modalities like medication, management and other alternative therapies.

Medication

There are many medications prescribed only if required that come under the classification of antidepressants, antipsychotics, and mood stabilisers. And expert always monitors the doses and the side-effects that the medication may have and adjusts the doses accordingly.

Progress Monitoring & Follow-Up

We offer review visits, proper dose, adjustments for medication and relapse prevention programmes for inpatient and OPD patients.

When is Psychiatric Hospitalization Needed?

Psychiatric hospitalisation is needed in very severe cases where?-

  • – There is a risk of self harm or suicide and the person feels that they are not able to control their thoughts properly. They are not able to understand what is going on with them and they may become a risk to themselves.
  • – The risk of harm to others is present, and the person is not in control of their own thoughts. They feel wrong and agitated and angry and are not in proper control of their impulses.
  • – The person is going through severe psychosis or Mania – where they are not in touch with reality and they may take any steps or actions that are not warranted for. They may act on facts which are only true to them and not a reality in real life.
  • – Directly refuse to eat food and ingest medicines which are required for their own safety.
  • – They are under dangerous alcohol and drug withdrawal and may become agitated and harmful for people around them and for themselves as well.
  • – They failed to take out patient treatment with a psychiatry clinic in Noida and revert back to their original symptoms and issues whenever they are out in the normal environment.

Why Choose Our Mental Health Care

With some of the best mental health specialists in Noida on our panel, Tulasi Healthcare hosts a number of experts that are topmost names in their field.

Qualified Mental Health Professionals

With MD/DNB qualified psychiatrists and MPhil and RCI registered clinical psychologists, we hosted an army of staff that has multiple years of experience under their belt.

Personalized Treatment

We have no one size fits all plans. That is not a philosophy. We take care of each and every concern considering age, diagnosis, culture, and family concerns surrounding the individual.

Patient & Family Support

Patient and family support is very crucial when it comes to rehabilitation. We provide regular family updates, psycho education, and after-care guidance to our patients.

Confidentiality & Privacy

Confidentiality and privacy play a very critical role in the field of psychology. We have very secure records and discrete entry and consent base sharing, which are ruled by ethical concerns.

How Can You Book a Psychiatric Consultation in Noida?

It is very easy to book a consultation with our experts at a mental Hospital in Noida.

  • – Connect with us through WhatsApp, online form or a walk in.
  • – Visit our mental health facility in Noida at-  Metro, BR03, Basement Below Puma outlet, beside Karma Hyundai showroom, walking distance from sector 76, Road sector 49, Noida, Uttar Pradesh, and understand what is required and expected from you from the first visit.
  • – Get insurance consultancy (if you require it)
  • – Tele consultancy is also available with our mental health doctor in Noida.

Need Mental Health Support in Noida?

Mental health support is not something that you can gain from just your family and friends when you are feeling down. It is a concern that requires expert care and help when you feel that there is no way out. You can visit any mental health clinic in Noida and share your concerns with them at the earliest. If you feel that you have no one to talk to, and you are being trapped in your own thoughts. Visit our facility today and share your concerns with us, regardless of the stigma and judgement that surrounds you.

Frequently Asked Questions

FAQ's

Is my information kept confidential?

Yes, your information is kept confidential at all times under our ethical and professional tieups. Your information is only made available when it is required by you or by any mandate issued by the law.

Which hospital is best for mental health?

If you’re looking to consult with a mental health hospital, Tulasi Healthcare is the mental health Hospital in Noida that can provide you with the personalised, intervention, guided concerns at your own comfort.

Is online therapy as effective as in person therapy?

Yes. There is no difference between the quality of online therapy and in person therapy. The experience and the inside truly depend on the person's comfort, and their availability.

Does every mental health condition require hospitalisation?

No, it is not mandatory to get hospitalized for every mental health condition. Many conditions can be treated with the outpatient and OPD treatment plans. But when the conditions become truly severe and out of control to be handled in a normal social environment, hospitalisation may be required.

Does mental health treatment always involve medication?

No. Mental health concerns do not always require medication and they truly depend upon the kind of issue you are facing and how severe it is. If the symptoms are out of control and they are meddling with your daily life, medication may be provided, but under control doses. CONTACT US

User Content – any information, documents, reports, photographs, journal entries, messages, responses, logs or other material uploaded or entered by a user.

CONFIDENTIALITY OF MENTAL HEALTH INFORMATION:

Any information related to user’s mental health, healthcare, or treatment will be handled with utmost confidentiality as per Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 (MHCA, 2017) and other applicable laws.

6.2 The information here includes information which is stored and maintained electronically or digitally. However, we might share such information wherever permitted or required by law, including for the purposes of providing treatment with the members of the treating team or with a duly authorized representative after obtaining proper consent.

6.3 The disclosure of information might also be done in cases where it is necessary to prevent harm, violence, or threat to life, or to adhere to any orders passed by the competent court or authority.

6.4 Patients can choose to add their care-givers’/NR/any other authorized person’s name while registering on the app with whom the wish to share their information, the onus of such transaction/disclosure remains on the patient himself in such cases.

6.5 In all such situations, Tulasi will try to limit the disclosure of information that is reasonable and necessary for the relevant purpose.

PATIENT CONSENT AND RIGHTS:

Nothing in these terms takes away or limits any of the rights of the users given to them under the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 or any other applicable laws.

The app shall not be interpreted in any manner determining the user’s legal or mental capacity merely because a user has or does not have access to a certain feature of the app.

APPOINTMENTS AND ONLINE CONSULTATIONS:

8.1 The app allows users to book appointments and attend online consultations with the authorized healthcare professionals. All the appointments are not guaranteed and subject to the availability of the concerned professional.

8.2 The booked appointments may be rescheduled or cancelled due to emergencies, clinical requirements, technical glitches, or any other circumstances affecting the services.

8.3 All the consultations are provided in accordance with the law, professional standards and telepsychiatry guidelines mentioned in clause 12. A prescription for the same will only be provided if considered clinically appropriate and legally permissible by the professional.

8.4 The healthcare professionals may advice in-person consultation or referral based on their clinical findings. A request for an appointment or consultation does not create a right to receive a prescription, diagnosis, treatment or referral.

8.5 The user has a duty to provide accurate information related to their health, medications, previous treatments and must not withhold any such information that might affect the treatment or consultation directly.

8.6 Before and during an online consultation, Tulasi or the Healthcare Professional may verify the patient’s identity and may ask the patient to confirm their current location and contact details. The patient must provide accurate information and inform the Healthcare Professional if another person is present during the consultation.

8.7 In cases where an account is created and an appointment is booked on behalf of any patient, maybe by a parent, guardian, care giver or any other person, that person has a duty to disclose all the information accurately and also to make sure that they have the authority or consent to use that information.

MINORS AND CHILDREN:

9.1 A minor may avail the services of the app only in a manner that is permitted by the applicable law. Where parental or guardian consent is required, the relevant parent or lawful guardian will be responsible for providing such consent and for the information provided during registration or booking.

9.2 The duty to provide accurate personal and health related information also remains with the user in such cases.

9.3 Tulasi may maintain confidentiality of information relating to a Minor to the extent required by law and professional obligations. Information may nevertheless be shared with a parent, guardian or other authorized person where required for treatment, safety, legal compliance or protection of the Minor or another person.

PSYCHOLOGICAL ASSESMENTS:

The app offers offline as well as online psychological and mental-health assessments depending on the clinical requirement of the patients. These assessments do not constitute a conclusive or final diagnosis but are intended to support the clinical understanding unless confirmed by a qualified mental-health professional.

The suitability and availability of the assessment may vary on the discretion of the professional, also on the age, condition and clinical requirements of the patient.

PRESCRIPTIONS AND TREATMENT INSTRUCTIONS:

The healthcare professional will issue a prescription only if it is believed to be clinically required. It is the duty of the patient to use only for himself without making any alterations, and also to make sure that it is not copied, forged or used for any other unauthorized purpose. Prescribed medicines should only be used as per the instructions of the healthcare professional.

The App may also display treatment plans, medication schedules, follow-up instructions and other treatment-related information. Information displayed on the App should not be treated as a substitute for professional medical advice. If the users are unsure about any prescription, medication or treatment instruction they must seek clarification from the dedicated healthcare professional.

TELEPSYCHIATRY GUIDELINES:

Telepsychiatry consultations through the Platform will be provided in accordance with applicable laws and guidelines, as amended from time to time. The following shall apply:

12.1 Patient and caregiver/family member identity may be verified by the psychiatrist before the consultation.

12.2 The patient should ordinarily be present during the consultation. Proxy consultations may be allowed where permitted under applicable guidelines and at the psychiatrist’s discretion.

12.3 Consultations may be conducted through text, audio or video, as considered appropriate by the psychiatrist.

12.4 The psychiatrist may require an in-person consultation at any stage where clinically necessary. The patient may opt for an in-person consultation at any stage.

12.5 Prescriptions will be issued only where permitted under applicable law and based on the psychiatrist’s clinical assessment.

12.6 Prohibited or restricted medicines will not be prescribed through teleconsultation.

12.7 In an emergency, the patient may be advised to seek immediate in-person or emergency medical care.

12.8 Tulasi will take reasonable steps to maintain the privacy and confidentiality of telepsychiatry consultations and records.

MEDICAL RECORDS:

13.1 The App may record and allow patients to access their medical and treatment-related records, including prescriptions, laboratory reports, psychological or psychiatric assessments, consultation records, treatment plans, discharge summaries and other documents made available by Tulasi, subject to applicable law.

13.2 Tulasi may require identity, authority verification or consent before providing access to any record.

13.3 A patient who independently approached Tulasi for his treatment and is considered to have the capacity to make decisions regarding their healthcare will ordinarily control access to their medical information, and records will not be shared with a family member, caregiver or other person merely because of their relationship with the patient.

13.4 Where the patient is a Minor, lacks the capacity required for the relevant decision, has authorized a Caregiver or Nominated Representative, or where disclosure is considered important for the safety of the patient or is otherwise permitted or required by law, Tulasi may provide relevant information to the appropriate parent, guardian, Nominated Representative or other authorized person.

13.5 In cases where the parent/care giver/ guardian/ NR has registered their minor child for their treatment and the child is actively involved in the treatment, that parent/care giver/ guardian/ NR will have access to the treatment records without putting any liability on Tulasi for the same.

13.6 Access to particular information may also be restricted where permitted by law, including where disclosure may result in serious harm to the patient or another person.

13.7 Medical records made available through the App must not be altered, manipulated or misrepresented, and their electronic availability does not change their legal or clinical status.

COMMUNICATION WITH THE TREATING TEAM:

The App may provide messaging, call-back, call-centre or other communication features to support continuity of care. These channels are not continuously monitored and, unless specifically stated otherwise, must not be used for urgent or life-threatening situations. Response times may vary depending on the nature and urgency of the request, availability and operating hours, and a message does not guarantee an immediate response, prescription, diagnosis or change in treatment. Tulasi may retain records of such communications for continuity of care, clinical documentation, quality assurance and legal or regulatory purposes.

EMERGENCY AND QUICK SUPPORT:

The App may provide Emergency Support or Quick Support features to help a user contact Tulasi or seek appropriate assistance. However, these features are not a substitute for emergency medical services. Tulasi does not guarantee an immediate response, immediate consultation, ambulance, emergency transportation, physical rescue, on-site intervention, hospital admission or any other emergency service merely because a request is made through the App.

If a user or any other person is at immediate risk of self-harm, suicide, violence, serious injury or any other medical emergency, the user or the person accompanying them must immediately contact the appropriate emergency services or take the person to the nearest suitable hospital or emergency facility.

JOURNALING AND PERSONAL ENTERIES

16.1 The App may allow you to maintain personal journal entries, which may include sensitive personal or health-related information.

16.2 Journal entries are not continuously monitored or routinely reviewed by Tulasi or your treating team. Unless the App specifically tells you that an entry has been shared with or is being reviewed by your treating team, you should not assume that anyone is monitoring it.

16.3 A journal entry, mood log, message or similar information submitted through the App should not be treated as a clinical message or a request for immediate medical attention.

16.4 The App and its messaging, journaling and mood-tracking features are not continuously monitored for emergencies. If you need urgent or emergency medical or mental health assistance, you should contact the appropriate emergency service or seek immediate medical care rather than relying on these features.

16.5 If you choose to share a journal entry or other information with your treating team, it may be considered part of your healthcare information and handled in accordance with applicable law and Tulasi’s records-management practices.

PSYCHOEDUCATION AND TREATMENT RESOURCES

The App may provide psychoeducation, articles, videos, exercises, treatment information and other educational resources to help users better understand mental health and related care. These resources are intended to support, and not replace, professional medical or psychological assessment and treatment. Users should not make changes to their medication, treatment or care solely on the basis of such content and should consult their treating professional before making any significant changes to their care.

TREATMENT PACKAGES AND PROGRAMMES

The App may offer treatment packages, programmes, memberships or bundled services, with details of the services included, validity, applicable fees and taxes, consultations or services covered, exclusions, and the applicable cancellation, rescheduling and refund terms. Purchasing a package does not guarantee any particular clinical outcome, and all services remain subject to the treating professional’s clinical judgment. A healthcare professional may determine that a particular service is not clinically appropriate or that an alternative course of care is required. Nothing in the package terms limits any mandatory rights available to users under applicable consumer, healthcare or other laws.

PAYMENTS

The App may allow users to make payments for consultations, treatment packages, medicines, laboratory tests and other services. Applicable prices, taxes, delivery charges and any other additional charges will be disclosed before payment, wherever required by law. Payments may be processed through authorised third-party payment providers. Users are responsible for providing accurate payment and billing information and for ensuring that the details provided are correct.

CANCELLATION, RESCHEDULING AND REFUNDS

Cancellation, rescheduling and refund terms may vary depending on the service or package purchased and the applicable policy communicated to you at the time of booking or purchase. Where a refund is applicable, it will be processed through the relevant payment method within the applicable timeframe. Nothing in these Terms limits any consumer rights or other remedies available to you under applicable law.

DATA PROTECTION AND PRIVACY

User privacy is important to Tulasi Healthcare. Tulasi collects and uses personal and health information only for legitimate purposes connected with providing and managing its services, including registration, healthcare and teleconsultation, medical records, appointments, treatment and caregiver coordination, medicines and laboratory services, payments, support, emergency assistance, legal compliance and improving its services.

The User’s personal data will be handled in accordance with applicable data-protection laws, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025, to the extent applicable. Where required by law, Tulasi will obtain the User’s consent before processing personal data.

Detailed information about the data collected, how it is used and protected, when it may be shared, how long it is retained, and the rights available to the User is set out in Tulasi’s separate Privacy Policy, which forms part of these Terms of Use. Users are encouraged to read the Privacy Policy carefully before using the App.

Users may exercise their applicable rights in relation to their personal data in accordance with the Privacy Policy and applicable law. Withdrawal of consent or restriction of certain processing may affect Tulasi’s ability to provide services where such processing is necessary for providing the service or is otherwise permitted or required by law.

THIRD-PARTY SERVICE PROVIDERS

Tulasi may engage trusted third-party service providers to support the App and its services, including cloud hosting, payment processing, laboratory and medicine services, logistics, teleconsultation, communications, customer support, cybersecurity and analytics.

These providers may process information on Tulasi’s behalf and are required to comply with applicable legal and contractual obligations. Where a User directly uses or interacts with an independent third-party provider, that provider’s own terms and privacy practices may also apply.

RECORDINGOF CONSULTATIONS AND COMMUNICATIONS

INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

AVAILABILITY OF THE APP

Tulasi will make reasonable efforts to keep the App and its services available, but uninterrupted or error-free access cannot always be guaranteed. The App or certain features may be temporarily unavailable due to maintenance, updates, network or technical issues, cybersecurity incidents, third-party service interruptions, device or operating-system issues, force majeure or other circumstances beyond Tulasi’s reasonable control.

SUSPENSION OR RESTRICTION OF ACCESS

Any suspension of App access will not affect a patient’s lawful right to access healthcare or medical records under applicable law. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

Tulasi will not be responsible for issues caused by the User’s device or internet connection, third-party infrastructure, inaccurate information provided by the User, failure to follow professional instructions, or circumstances beyond Tulasi’s reasonable control.

NO GUARANTEE OF CLINICAL OUTCOME

title: Child Counsellor Near Me – Professional Counselling for Children
h1: Child Counsellor Near Me – Professional Counselling for Children
excerpt: Every child goes through a phase of ups and downs in their life, but sometimes those phases need some extra support from experts. If you have been searching for a child counsellor near me, you are already taking the first step towards care and recovery of your child. Our child counselling services are built around […]
contentHtml:
Every child goes through a phase of ups and downs in their life, but sometimes those phases need some extra support from experts. If you have been searching for a child counsellor near me, you are already taking the first step towards care and recovery of your child. Our child counselling services are built around understanding our clients, being patient with them and producing real results. Our team helps children work through issues like anxiety, behavioural changes, school, stress, and emotional problems in a safe and friendly environment. Whether your child is dealing with feelings that are really big for them to understand or facing a tough phase in life, our experienced counselors are here to guide them gently towards feeling better and understood. Let us help your child feel confident again – with the right support that is easy to find and easy to trust.

Looking for a Child Counsellor Near Me?

Parenting always comes with its shares of joys and worries. It will always be a difficult thing to notice your child struggling emotionally when you are not able to help them properly. Maybe they become quiet, irritable and anxious about their life, and you have started looking for somebody nearby who can understand your kids better. So you are not alone in this. Help is always closer than you think when you search for a child counselor near me. Our team at Tulasi Healthcare offers accessible and professional support for families who want proper guidance without the confusion of where to start looking for a change and help for their child’s life. We meet children on a daily basis where they are using age appropriate techniques to help them open up, process emotions, and build healthier ways of coping for them – all while you are being involved in every step of the way.

Meet Our Child & Adolescent Psychologists Team Near You

Mr. Suparas Jain

Clinical Psychologist (RCI)

Experience: 2+ years

Subject Expert:

  • Autism
  • ADHD
  • Behavioural disruptions
  • Anxiety

Consultation Fees: ₹1400 for 45 minutes

OPD: Mon to Fri & Sun (5pm – 8 pm)

Book an Appointment

Ms. Hardika

Clinical Adolescent & Adult Psychologist (RCI)

Experience: 2+ years

Subject Expert:

  • Anxiety and Depression related disorders
  • Substance Use Disorder
  • Personality Disorders
  • Stress & Adjustment Related Difficulties
  • Psychodiagnostic Assessments
  • Family Interventions and Caregiver Burden

Consultation Fees: ₹1400 for 45 minutes

OPD: Mon to Sat (9am – 6pm)

Book an Appointment

Ms. Titiksha Agnihotri

Clinical Psychologist (RCI)

Experience: 2+ years

Subject Expert:

  • Child Psychiatry
  • Personality Disorders
  • Psychodiagnostic Assessments
  • Family Interventions and Caregiver Burdern

Consultation Fees: ₹1400 for 45 minutes

OPD: Mon to Sat (9am – 6pm)

Book an Appointment

Ms. Apoorva Khanna

RCI Licensed Child and Adolescent Psychologist

Experience: 2+ years

Subject Expert:

  • ADHD
  • Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)
  • Learning Disabilities
  • Behavioral Difficulties
  • Childhood Trauma
  • Substance Use & Addiction
  • Anxiety Disorders

Consultation Fees: ₹1000 for 45 minutes

OPD: Mon to Sat (9am – 7pm)

Book an Appointment

Signs Your Child may Need Counselling Support

Kids don’t always have the mechanism to save what they are feeling, so they often work with their behaviour instead to help their loved ones know what they are going through. As a parent, you tend to know your child best – and if something feels off for them, it is worth paying attention to and consulting a service of counselling for children near me. Here are some common signs to look out for.

Anxiety and Excessive Worry

If your child seems worried on a constant basis and gets nervous over very small things easily, or has trouble sleeping because they won’t switch off, it may be more than just a phase you are thinking of. Talking to someone who specialises in childhood anxiety like a child therapist near me for anxiety can help them manage these issues in a healthy way.

Behavioural Changes

Sudden issues like acting out of turn, not listening to instructions given, or becoming very withdrawn are a child’s way of expressing that they are uncomfortable about something and they need help. It is their way of saying that things cannot be put into words and counselling session with a children counsellor can help them deal with what’s really going on.

Anger and Emotional Outburst

Children may have frequent tantrums, anger, problems, and meltdowns that seem bigger than the situation that they are in. Your child needs help managing these emotions in a more calmer and balanced way.

School Related Issues

There is a concern of dropping grades, refusing to go to school, and trouble, and focusing on classes and academics, which results in stress and anxiety for coping. If these difficulties are something that your child is facing, they might not be able to express it directly, and may need help from an expert.

Social and Friendship Difficulties

If your child struggles to make friends, and feels left out – it is assigned that they may be struggling socially. They may tend to avoid social gatherings and peer play altogether and counselling may help build the confidence and skills required to go back out and to the social circle.

Low Confidence or Self-Esteem

If your child is involved in self criticism and they fear failure, they may tell themselves things like – “ I am not good at anything”– this is a sign that your child needs support for building a healthier sense of self.

Family or Life Changes

Big changes like divorce, moving homes, or having a new sibling can be very overwhelming for a small child. Counselling provides them a way to vent their feelings and begin a process that changes their mindset with a slow pace.

How can a Child Counsellor Help?

A good child counsellor does much more than just you think. The creator space of your child that feels safe enough for them to open up properly and share their fears and concerns. Here is our counselling can make a difference-

  • – Health children understanding express their emotion in healthy ways
  • – Builds proper mechanisms for coping for issues like stress, anxiety, and anger issues
  • – Improve communication between the child and their family members, if any family dynamic situations persist
  • – Boost self-esteem and confidence in life
  • – Supports better function and behaviour at school and academics
  • – Helps children process their difficult changes in life and losses as well
  • – Social skills and friendships along with peer pressure handling
  • – Gives parents practical tools to support their child at home

What Happens During Child Counselling?

Are you not sure what to expect during your session? Here is a simple breakdown of how our process works at Tulasi Healthcare.

Getting to Know Your Child

Our counsellor spends time building trust and comfort with your child before moving into any serious discussion.

Understanding the Concerns

True conversation and activities, our counsellor gently explores. What is the ongoing issue and what your child is feeling currently.

Creating a Support Plan

Based on what is uncovered, our counsellor designed a personalised approach that fits your child’s age, personality, and needs

Ongoing Sessions

Regular sessions, help your child build skills over time, with progress shared with you along the way.

Parent Involvement

We keep you in the loop throughout, with guidance and how to support your child’s growth at the right time at home.

Child Counselling Services We Offer

Every child has a different need when it comes to counselling, which is why we offer a range of different focused counselling services. If you have been comparing some child therapist near me against the counsellor, you know that our team covers all approaches- from anxiety to school stress and family changes – so your child gets exactly the kind of support they are looking for.

ADHD Assessment and Support

For children who are dealing with attention in hyperactivity problems, we provide a proper assessment that takes upon attention and focus of daily habits in a child’s life. Are assessments of an include tools like Vanderbilt assessment, scale,
Connor’s rating scale and clinical observation for attention, behaviour and daily routines. Our team build small practical focus sessions so that children can thrive on their own pace.

Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) Assessment and Support

Our team first incurs how a child communicates, plays and connect with the world around him and then assessment tools like autism diagnostic observation schedule-2, childhood autism rating scale, and developmental history are combined together to build a proper connection between observations. Support helps in building strengths through structured guidance and sensory friendly spaces.

Anxiety Counselling

For children who are dealing with constant worry, panic, and fear of things around them, our counseling team helps them understand their feelings in a practical manner. As a child mental health counsellor near me, we focus on building long-term emotional resilience, and not just giving you quick fixes.

Behavioural support

Our team works with children who show defiance, aggression and difficulty in following rules. This helps them dig into the root cause and guides them towards better self control, building patience and positive behaviour at home and school.

Emotional Support

For kids who are struggling with sadness, mood swings, and emotional issues, we provide safe space to express themselves freely and learn healthy ways of coping.

School Related Concerns

Exam stress and focus issues are a part of school related concerns – and we help children navigate academic pressures that build better study habits and help them feel more confident and comfortable in the classroom.

Parent Counselling

We guide parents with practical strategies to understand their behaviour and communicate more effectively. This creates a supportive environment that reinforces the progress made in sessions.

Adolescent Counselling

Teenagers face a unique set of challenges in their life around identity, relationships and independence. Our team offers a judgement free space for teens to talk about their feelings and go through these challenges.

Why Choose Our Child Counseling Services?

Having the right support for your child’s mental health concerns matters, and here is why families searching for a child counselling near me end up trusting us-

Experienced Child Counsellors

Our team specialises in working with children and understands how to connect with them at every age.

Safe Comfortable Environment

We create a warm and judgement free space for every child to feel like themselves and open up.

Personalised Approach

Each counselling plan we provide is tailored to your child’s unique personality and needs.

Parent Collaboration

We keep you involved through the session, so the support continues beyond the session.

Convenience and Accessibility

There is an easy scheduling and nearby location to make getting help simple and stress free.

How to Choose the Right Child Counsellor?

Finding the right fit is just as important as finding the right counsellor close by. Looking for someone who has experience specifically with children is very important. A good child counsellor should be able to make your child feel comfortable and not under pressure at all. Check their approach- do they use age appropriate methods like play and activities that stimulate conversation and do they trust their instincts with the child. A team of experts ensures that the child is taken care of in every way possible.

Ready to Support Your Child’s Emotional Well-being?

If your child has been struggling and you are searching for a child counsellor near me, don’t wait for things to get out of hand. Reach out today and book a session with a compassionate child counselling team. We are here to help your children feel understood and supported at all times without any pressure at all. Get in touch now and schedule a consultation today.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

FAQ's

At what age can a child start counseling?

Children as young as 4 to 5 years old can benefit from counseling. Techniques that we adapt are based upon the age, play, art, and conversations, depending on what suits your child best.

How many sessions will my child need?

This varies from child to child. Some improvement in merely a few days and while others benefit from ongoing support over a long period of time.

Will my child have to talk about everything themselves?

Know, we use play, drawing and games as methods to converse with younger children, and this helps them express their feelings without needing to explain everything in words.

Can I stay in the room during sessions?

This depends on your child’s age and comfort level. Older children benefit from private sessions, while younger ones may need a parent nearby.

Is child counselling only for serious problems?

No, not at all. Counselling helps with everyday struggles as well as serious issues that the child is facing. Giving your child tools to cope with them is better for life in general. CONTACT US

Get In Touch With Us

excerpt: At Tulasi Healthcare, our belief is that understanding your mind first is the right step towards truly caring for it. An IQ testing is often the very first tool used to understand a child or an adult’s thinking abilities for the first time, but we all know that the numbers alone don’t tell the whole […]
contentHtml:
At Tulasi Healthcare, our belief is that understanding your mind first is the right step towards truly caring for it. An IQ testing is often the very first tool used to understand a child or an adult’s thinking abilities for the first time, but we all know that the numbers alone don’t tell the whole thing itself. Every IQ testing Gurgaon at our centre is administered with proper insight, sensitivity, backed by science, and understood, and read by experts that actually understand and relay to you what it means for your child’s daily life.

Whether you are exploring an IQ assessment for kids or seeking clarity for your own inside, we are here to guide you with warmth and clinical precision.

What Exactly is a IQ Testing?

An IQ testing is usually a scientifically designed and backed tool, which is used to measure a person’s cognitive abilities, their personality traits, and their behavioural patterns.

It goes beyond a simple IQ score in Gurgaon, offering insight into memory, reasoning, attention, and emotional functioning. These testing are usually used to diagnose learning, difficulties, developmental delays in children and used to find cognitive strengths and challenges that are faced by them. At Tulasi Healthcare, we use IQ testings as a starting point to understand what is going on and never as the end point for your care journey.

Our experts interpret results based on the context of your life, the history you share, and the concerns you give, so the outcome feels less like a label and more like a roadmap of your interpretation towards the right support and treatment.

Tests Administered by Tulasi Healthcare Experts

Every mind is different, and so is the assessment for its abilities. This is why we don’t rely on a single test to understand your concerns here. Our team uses a range of validated tools which are clinically standardized and chosen based on age, concern and what we are trying to find and uncover during our IQ assessment session in Gurgaon & Delhi NCR. Let’s take a look at some assessment tools which are employed here at Tulasi Healthcare.

WISC-4

The Wechsler Intelligence Scale for Children is one of the most trusted tools in the child IQ test. It measures verbal comprehension, reasoning, memory problems, and processing speed to build a detailed cognitive profile.

Book an Assessment

WAIS-4

The Wechsler Adult Intelligence Scale is considered one of the gold standards in assessing cognitive functioning in adults. It works upon reasoning, memory, and processing speed, which helps adults understand if they have their cognitive strengths in place.

Book an Assessment

SFBT

SFBT is a simple therapy approach that works upon an individual’s strengths instead of highlighting their problems. It helps people find proper, insightful and practical solutions that build confidence. During IQ testing, it can reduce anxiety and help the person feel more comfortable without affecting the test results.

Book an Appointment

VSMS

The Vineland Social Maturity Scale takes upon a person’s social competence and everyday functioning. It is particularly useful for children who are experiencing any developmental concerns. It helps our team understand how a child manages their daily task compared to pairs of their age and often get a full picture beyond their cognitive issues alone.

Book an Assessment

SPM​

The standard progressive mattresses test measures the abstract reasoning of the individual and if they have proper problem solving abilities as well. It uses visual patterns and is a reliable cultural neutral way to assess intelligence in a general way. It is especially useful when language or reading skills should influence the results.

Book an Assessment

CPM

The coloured progressive mattresses are useful when they are designed for children with learning difficulties. It uses colourful and engaging visual puzzles for children to understand if their reasoning abilities are correct, and it is quite approachable, less intimidating for little children.

Book an Assessment

BKT

Binet Kamat Test of Intelligence is one of the most used tests that was adapted using Indian samples and is a reliable and coal standard consideration of valid tests in India.

Book an Assessment

MISIC

The Malin’s Intelligence Scale for Indian Children is adapted according to the Indian concerns for making it a culturally relevant and accurate choice for assessing children’s intelligence in our cultural setting.

Book an Assessment

NIMHANS Battery

The NIMHANS battery offers an in-depth look at cognitive functions like attention, memory, and executive functioning, when a more detailed neuro psychological picture is needed.

Book an Assessment

Who Should Consider IQ Testing in Gurgaon & Delhi NCR?

An IQ test is not only for children who are struggling in school. It can be genuinely useful for a number of people who are at different stages in life and for different reasons itself. Here is a list of people who might benefit from one.

Children Showing Signs of Learning Difficulty

If a child is struggling with reading, maths, or keeping up in class, despite effort, IQ test can be a great way to help them with proper assessment of specific learning disability, if it is at play.

Parents Concerned about Developmental Milestones

If a child feels like they’re falling behind the age appropriate developmental milestones and markers, an assessment can be a great way to offer clarity on whether intervention is required or not.

Adults Experiencing Work and Focus Challenges

Adults who struggle with concentration, memory or processing information in daily life and work despite trying to do their best, can benefit from understanding their cognitive profiles better.

Individuals Evaluated for ADHD, Autism, or Similar Conditions

When these conditions are suspected, an IQ test is a great way to understand the larger diagnostic process, helping specialist build a full picture in an accurate manner.

And Even Wanting Deeper Understanding of Self

Not every assessment is just about clarifying a concern. Some people may want to understand their own strengths and weaknesses better, and try to make informed choices about their education or personal growth.

What are the Benefits of an IQ Testing?

An IQ testing offers far more than just a simple number. It gives a detailed picture of how an individual thinks, learns and processes their information from the world. Here’s how it can benefit in the long run.

Identify Cognitive Strengths

An assessment helps in highlighting some specific areas where a person can excel, like verbal reasoning or memory. This helps the parents, educators and caretakers to recognise the natural abilities that can be developed further through right opportunities.

Flag Areas Needing Support

Just like the test reveals strengths, it also points out areas where there is a need to work upon. These may be areas like attention, processing, speed, working memory that will be requiring time and interventions before challenges occur. It can definitely affect school and work performance, so early intervention must be rectified by an IQ testing.

Support Accurate Diagnosis

Results give an objective data that clinicians can rely upon. It can be used alongside behavioural observations and history to better understand what kind of issues your child is going through. With standardised data backing, it makes the overall diagnostic process more reliable.

Guides Personalised Learning Plans

Once strengths and weaknesses are mapped out clearly, educators and therapists can design learning strategies and classroom accommodations accordingly. They can also design therapy and education plans tailored on how a person actually is presented on the standardised tests and assessment.

Tracks Progress Over Time

Repeating testing from time to time can help monitor cognitive development and children and keep a track of their growth. It helps measure the effectiveness of interventions and provides the clearance of what is working and what is not.

What Conditions can an IQ Testing Help Identify?

An testing is often one of the first steps and understanding what is the condition that is hindering developmental growth. While it does not diagnose on its own, combined with evaluation, we can help identify the following issues at Tulasi Healthcare-

Specific Learning Disabilities

Conditions like dyslexia, dyscalculia, dysgraphia often show up as gaps between overall intelligence. This can be assessed by an IQ test while helping bring clarity to the educators and parents.

ADHD and Attention Difficulties

While not providing diagnosis on its own, an IQ testing can reveal patterns of attention, while also working upon memory and processing issues that are combined with clinical evaluation. This supports the ADHD diagnosis thoroughly.

Developmental Delays in Children

For many younger children, assessment can help with cognitive development issues and tracks compared to an age expected milestone. This is essential for early intervention and support planning if any issues are identified.

Intellectual Giftedness

On the other end of the spectrum, IQ testings also identify children or adults with exceptionally high abilities, which may need a more challenging academic environment to stay engaged and grow. It also provides guidance to the parents and educators in a way that it helps recognise and develop these giftedness to something big.

How Should You Understand Your IQ Test Results?

Getting your results is just the beginning of the journey. At Tulasi Healthcare, we walk you through what they mean, step-by-step, so you leave with clarity and direction, rather than a report full of numbers.

Walk through with an expert

Instead of just hanging over a report, our team sits down with you and explains each and every score in detail with its consequences in plain simple manner, no confusing jargon with the steps ahead on what we plan to do.

Context matters

We look at you and your child’s daily routine routines and learning styles. This helps us understand the concerns and the results that are interpreted. We make that in a way that it is relevant to you in a real everyday manner, not just numbers on paper.

Pattern over single score

Rather than fixating on an overall number, we examine the full pattern of strengths and weaknesses that is showing up on the reports. We try to give the cognitive learning area a complete, accurate picture to build what the steps will be ahead.

Roadmap for next steps

Based on the interpretation, we outline a clear next step. Whether it is therapy, learning support or the evaluation, you leave with the direction, not just simple words and explanations.

Ongoing support

Understanding results is treated as the start of the conversation, not the end. Our experts remain available for you to follow up as you begin acting on the recommendations provided.

What Your Journey Looks like with Tulasi healthcare

It can feel very uncertain to go for an assessment and it is a journey itself. So to make this journey comfortable for you and to keep it clear and supportive at all times, we take very reassuring steps with everything we do.

First Consultation

Your journey begins with an open conversation. Our experts take time to understand your concerns, background and goals before recommending any test. So nothing feels rushed and impersonal from the very start.

Receiving a Recommendation

Based on your first consultation, our team recommends the most suitable assessment. It is according to your needs and whether that’s an IQ test for kids or a detailed adult evaluation, we explain it clearly so that you know exactly what to expect.

Conduction of Testing

Your test is conducted in a calm and comfortable environment. It is conducted by trained clinical psychologists and they ensure that the process feels natural, heard, and supportive at all times. It is especially important for children or anyone who feels anxious about these tests to feel supported at every step.

Formal diagnosis and care plan

Once the results are ready, we walk you through the plan in an easy way, followed by a personalised care plan. This isn’t just a report, it’s the beginning of a thoughtful path forward.

Why Choose Tulasi Healthcare for IQ Testing?

Choosing the right place for your concerns matters, as much as the assessment itself. Here is what sets our team apart as a trusted IQ testing specialist in Gurgaon.

RCI Registered Clinical Psychologist

Our testings are conducted by registered RCI clinical psychologists, which ensures that every test interpretation meets the standards of highest professionalism and ethical rules. You can trust that your results are in qualified and capable hands.

Cultural Insights

We understand that Indian families function differently from any other family in the world. It has its own upbringing and social contexts. Assessment and recommendations are shared with sensitivity so that the results are relevant and meaningful to your everyday reality.

Safe and Caring Environment

From the waiting room to the testing, we have created a space that is warm and trusting for your loved one. Children and adults alike are made to feel comfortable and never like they are being clinically judged.

Integrated Care Plans

We don’t stop at diagnosis. Our team creates integrated plans of care that combine therapy, counselling, assessment, and family support where needed to ensure that testing leads to real change.

Personalised Treatment Approach

No two individuals are alike, and neither are their treatment plans. Recommendation is given to the person according to their strength, their struggles, and what they will genuinely help them thrive.

Connect with Tulasi Healthcare to book your IQ Test Today

Understanding your child’s potential and their strengths shouldn’t feel overwhelming. At Tulasi Healthcare, we make the process very simple, supportive, and genuinely insightful for parents. Whether you are booking an online test in Gurgaon or an in person session with our specialist, our team is ready to guide you with the care and clinical expertise. Do not let your uncertainty hold you back from taking the first step which is essential for your child’s development. Reach out to book your consultation today and let her experts help. You understand your little ones might be a bit better and one assessment at a time.
