Choosing the Best Child Psychologist: What Parents Should Look For

Choosing the best psychologist is more than about having the right kind of qualifications. A good child psychologist should understand and be more comfortable with handling children and their behavioural concerns. They should look into how they communicate, express their emotions and be comfortable in handling those in real time. Looking for an RCI registered child, psychologist with proper exposure and experience with treatment of emotional and behavioural concerns will be very beneficial.

The psychologist should also involve parents throughout the process to keep the parents in loop and explain the child’s progress in a simple way. If you’re looking for an expert and going through the phase of finding the best child psychologist in gurgaon & Delhi, it is imperative to choose someone who focuses on your child’s individual needs and treats them as the foremost important thing here. Your child should feel comfortable and open in their presence.

Types of Child Psychologists - Which Specialist Does Your Child Need?

The issue that your child faces comes with a specific set of behaviours and concerns. Within your first consultation, you will come to understand what kind of a psychologist you will require that specialises in your child’s particular concern. There are a lot of demarcations and experts who deal with different kinds of issues within child psychology. Let’s explore them.

Clinical Child Psychologist

A clinical child psychologist focuses on the struggle with emotions, behaviour, anxiety, depression, ADHD, trauma, and other mental health concerns. It is very essential for them to understand and assess the child’s difficulties here and the causes behind it. Therapy and support with emotional well-being is pursued here with emphasis on emotional health and healthy development.

Developmental Psychologist

A developmental psychologist tracks. How a child grows and whether they reach important milestones or not. They work on areas like language, thinking, emotional development and social skills. Their guidance focuses on helping parents understand if the child is growing well or not, and if not, additional support and therapy is required.

Child & Adolescent Psychologist

A child and adolescent psychologist works with children as well as teenagers. In teenage, there are a lot of emotional challenges and exploration that can bring their emotional posture to a rocking start. For these issues, a child and a dollar and psychologist helps with school pressure, family issues, confidence, and anxiety along with behavioural concerns to support healthy development.

School/Educational Psychologist

An Educational psychologist supports children who are finding it difficult to navigate their school life and academic stress. They assess the challenges in academic life, attention, difficulties, behavioural issues in the classroom and emotional problems that arise and affect both the classroom performance and their lives. They were closely with parents and teachers to build a safer environment.

Behavioral Therapist (ABA-trained)

ABA is a technique for children to learn new skills by rewarding positive behaviours. So the behaviour therapist is somebody who uses these kinds of techniques to reduce behaviours that are interfering with daily life. It is mostly recommended for children with autism and ADHD to consult with a behavioural therapist to improve their communication and social skills.

Neuropsychologist (Pediatric)

A Paediatric neuropsychologist has their focus on knowing how brain development affects learning, attention, memory and other cognitive functions. They evaluate the children with developmental disorders and neurological conditions to understand which part of the brain is responsible and work upon their learning disabilities and brain injuries to recommend appropriate interventions.

What Types of Therapy Do Child Psychologists Use?

Children cannot always say what they feel inside. There we communicate differently from adults. They communicate usually through play, behaviour and through their artistic abilities like drawing or saying a story. every approach to tackle the issues faced by children is different from adults. Let’s look into what the children actually respond to in therapeutic means.

Play Therapy

Children express their emotions more naturally through play. As they are not able to converse very well, these methods use game, toys, story, and activities that help children communicate their thoughts and feelings, and what difficulties they are facing in expressing their emotions in a confidential and relaxed setting.

Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) for Children

CBT teaches children how to express and understand emotions in an easier way. Understanding the emotions can be a bit difficult for them, so CBT with children uses a bit different methods than that for adults. It helps them replace their negative patterns of thinking with the positive ones.

Parent-Child Interaction Therapy (PCIT)

PCIT helps children and parents make a healthier bond through guidance of an expert. Sometimes parents are not able to communicate their feelings properly. So learning about practical communication and behavioural changes can be beneficial for them. This helps them make a bond of trust and improve communication with their children.

Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA)

ABA helps children learn new skills by rewarding positive behaviours. It helps by practically breaking down the conception to simple steps and supporting communication through social interaction and attention and self-care. It teaches children to learn about daily life practices and skills through consistent practice.

Family Therapy

Family therapy follows the concept that children grow in the healthiest environments and which starts from their home and family. Sessions involve family members along with the children to help them make a bond of trust and improve communication. This makes the parents understand about the child’s current needs, and they need the long run and make the home environment supportive, and caring based on these interventions.

Art & Expressive Therapy

Some children find it difficult to talk about their feelings. They are not able to understand how to articulate them or they are not comfortable talking about it. Through art, drawing, painting, music, and storytelling. These children are able to express themselves creatively and reduce stress and improve self-confidence.

Signs Your Child May Benefit from Seeing a Psychologist

Parents are the first ones to know that something is not right with their child, even after they are in constant care in their classrooms. There are a lot of signs and symptoms to note down to consider if your child is facing any kind of issue with emotional and behavioural health. Here are some signs that you can look into and consult a psychologist near me to know if professional help would be an option.

Emotional Concerns

  • – Continuous sadness, crying and feelings of hopelessness for a long period of time
  • – Feeling of excessive fear and worry
  • – Feeling worthless without any cause
  • – Feelings of isolation and withdrawal
  • – Talking about things that are not like them like death, self farm, and wanting to disappear and isolating themselves

Behavioural Concerns

  • – Throwing frequent tantrums and having a lot of aggression towards small things
  • – Refusing to go to school and interacting with peers
  • – Lying, stealing, and indulging in wrong behaviour
  • – Loss of friendships and sudden isolation from peer group
  • – Self harm and risky behaviour

Academic and Developmental Concerns

  • – Noticing sudden decline in grades and academic performance
  • – Hyperactive actions, and loss of focus
  • – Struggling with reading and writing
  • – Not meeting developmental milestones

Conditions Treated by Child Psychologists

A child psychologist in Gurgaon & Delhi NCR can take care of a lot of concerns in the umbrella of emotional, behaviour and developmental learning challenges. Through professional child psychology services, psychologists can help parents and children understand their emotions and work upon their skills for a lifetime of healthy coping. Here are some concerns specifically listed for you to understand how a child psychologist in Gurgaon & Delhi NCR works on different problems.

  • – ADHD ( Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder) – There are three types of ADHD here- that is inattentive, hyperactive, and combined type. These are all concerns noted by a proper psychologist through assessment, diagnosis and parent coaching. In many severe cases, they also work with a psychiatrist to provide medicinal management of the concerns
  • – Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) – In autism spectrum disorder, children struggle with their social skills, emotional regulation, and sensory issues. Our team works with proper assessment, diagnostic support, and therapy intervention to help children understand their own behaviours and emotions in a long run with family education in lieu to support the whole household.
  • – Learning Disabilities – learning disabilities, like dyslexia, dyscalculia, dysgraphia are some of the name named disorders that are usually seen during psycho educational evaluation. With ongoing support from an expert, and interventions from the classroom, these issues can be resolved.
  • – Anxiety and Phobia – These are some of the most common issues found in child and adolescent concerns. Separation, anxiety, social anxiety, school anxiety, generalised worry and specific phobia can be found easily. With CBT and gradual exposure to the triggers, children can resolve their concerns with support from their family.
  • – Trauma, Abuse, and PTSD – there are many children who experience neglect and abuse from their caregivers and are not able to understand and process it properly. With proper informed approaches and treatment with EMDR and TF – CBT, experts can resolve trauma with play based practises.
  • – Adolescent and Teen Counselling – in adolescent life, children often struggle with identity issues, peer pressure, and social media anxiety. To deal with this, counselling can be an appropriate way to assess and respect autonomy while involving parents into the concerns.

After gathering enough information from the parents, the child psychologist meets the child in a warm, comfortable, and appropriate setting. They assess the child using play, conversation, and build repo with them to gain direct insight into what the child is feeling.

Feedback and Treatment Planning

After both parents and children are assessed properly, the experts meet up with parents for a feedback session and explain the psychologist and his insight into what they findings are and any proposed treatment plan. Therapy sessions usually run from 45 to 60 minutes and are considered to be taken weekly, if the cases are not severe. Progress is seen every few weeks to understand how the child has developed and what they have adapted from the interventions.

DBT

What is ADHD?

Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) is a common mental health condition that affects a person’s ways of paying attention, their control on their actions and how they manage their daily tasks. ADHD in children is often noticed when they start school because that is where they actually perform any activities and are in a state of focusing on something. With the right support, children and adults with ADHD can also do very well in their life. Learning more about ADHD and spreading ADHD awareness helps families understand this condition better and seek help in a managed way.

What are the Signs and Symptoms of ADHD?

  • – Inattention during conversations
  • – Getting distracted very easily
  • – Forgetting daily tasks
  • – Losing things on a daily basis
  • – Talking too much
  • – Difficulty finishing any task that is given
  • – Feeling restless and unable to sit properly
  • – Interrupting others a lot while speaking
  • – Having an extremely high thought train
  • – Finding it hard to stay organised

The early sign of ADHD in children may include difficulty following instructions, usually and constant movement all the time. They also find it difficult to complete and concentrate on their school work.

What are there Types of ADHD?

Doctors usually divide ADHD (attention, deficit hyperactive disorder) into three main types based on the symptoms. A person usually shows. These types of doctors help choose the right treatment and support based on the kind of symptoms. A person is projecting. They can usually show me their attention problems, hyperactive behaviour or a mix of both also. The type is decided after proper ADHD diagnosis given by a qualified doctor.

Predominantly Inattentive Presentation

People with this type mainly have difficulty paying attention and staying focused. They usually forget the daily task, lose their things, make very careless mistakes and find it hard to complete their work. They often also seem distracted even during conversations. Since they are not very active or restless, their symptoms are usually unnoticed. This type is a very common ADHD in children, especially those who appear quiet, but struggle to concentrate.

Predominantly Hyperactive-Impulsive Presentation

People with this type of ADHD are usually very active and find it very difficult to stay still in one place. They may keep moving and fidgeting with objects all the time and talk a lot. Waiting in line and taking tons can be very difficult for them, and they often interrupt conversations based on their thought train. Children with this type of major run, climb and plane situation where it is not appropriate. Adults may feel restless inside, even if they’re not physically active.

Combined Presentation

Combine presentation is the most common type of ADHD. In this a person experiences both attention problems and hyperactive problems. They may struggle to focus on their task, forget important things and become easily distracted. They also find it hard to sit quietly and control their actions. The symptoms can affect the learning and relationships along with their daily life. With the right ASD treatment, therapy, and family support people with step and manage their symptoms successfully.

What Causes ADHD?

There is no single cause behind ADHD. Experts usually believe that it develops because of a combination of certain factors that combine some form or the other. These factors usually include genetic, biological, and environmental factors. Understanding these factors helps families focus on proper care instead of blaming themselves for believing common myths.

Genetic Factors

Genetic of the strongest factors contributing to ADHD development. It often runs in families, and this means that a child is more likely to develop ADHD if a parent or blood relatives have this condition. Researchers have found that certain genes related to brain function and attention increase this risk. However, inheriting these genes does not guarantee that a person will definitely develop ADHD. It simply means that the chances are high.

Brain Development and Neurochemical Factors

Research shows that some areas of the brain responsible for attention, planning and decision-making may develop differently in people with ADHD. Brain Chemicals called neurotransmitters, especially dopamine and norepinephrine play a crucial role. When these chemicals do not work as expected, it becomes harder for a person to stay focused and control their impulses. These brain differences are natural and are not caused by poor parenting or lack of discipline.

Environmental and Prenatal Factors

Some environmental and pregnancy related factors also increase the chance of developing ADHD. Activities like smoking or drinking alcohol during pregnancy, exposure to harmful substances, premature birth, low birth, weight, and certain health problems during pregnancy can contribute to this. In some cases exposure to other toxins during early childhood may also play a big role.

Common Myths About ADHD Causes

There are many myths about what causes ADHD, but most of them are not supported by scientific research. Eating too much sugar does not cause it, even though many people say so, and believe that as well. Poor parenting, lack of discipline, or spending time on mobile phones with television are also not causes of ADHD. These factors affect child behaviour or routine, but they do not create the condition as such. ADHD is a medical condition and people who have ADHD awareness understand the facts well.

How Is ADHD Diagnosed?

There is no single blood test or brain scan that can confirm ADHD directly. In ADHD diagnosis, the answers are often attained by a detailed evaluation by the mental health professional. The doctor will ask you about your symptoms, school, performance, and daily behaviour along with your Medical history. Parents and teachers may also be asked to share their observations to get a full picture.

Sometimes rating skills and questionnaires are used as a part of an ADHD test. Here these tools help to understand the symptoms better. Getting an ADHD diagnosis early an adult receives the right kind of treatment and support.

What Are the Treatment and Support Options?

The right ADHD treatment depends on the person’s age, their symptoms, and their daily routine. There is no single treatment that works for everyone. Most people improve usually with therapy and family support. Other adjustments include workplace adjustment and medication whenever required. Treatment plans are usually created after a proper ADHD diagnosis. Families exploring ADHD treatment in Gurgaon & Delhi NCR will find that individualised plans tend to work best, built around each person’s specific needs.

Behavioral Therapy and Parent Training

Be able therapy, health, children and adults develop some positive habits and manage their difficult behaviours. It focuses on rewarding good behaviour and self control. Parent training is very important because it teaches parents a simple way to guide the child as well. They helped them set clear rules, and encourage positive behaviour. They respond calmly, challenging situations well with this training.

Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) for ADHD

Cognitive behavioural therapy helps people understand how their thoughts are, and how they’re feeling and actions are connected to it. It teaches practical skills to improve, focus and manage emotions. This reduces their stress and handles everyday challenges effectively. CBT allows people to develop better time management and problem solving skills. It is specially helpful for teenagers and adult, who experience anxiety and no confidence.

Medication — What It Can and Cannot Treat

A good child development centre in Gurgaon & Delhi NCR. will always focus first on therapy and then look into the specifics of medicine. If the experts feel that there are areas where the child needs specific and severe help, medication will be prescribed. A qualified doctor decides whether the medication is needed after a complete assessment.

Educational and School-Based Support

Many children with ADHD feel supported with extra efforts from school. Teachers can make small changes in their routine that helps children live and learn more comfortably in their classrooms. Small activities like extra time during exams, short movement breaks, and reducing classroom distractions are something that teachers can easily do. Some children also receive individual learning plans in class accommodations based on their needs. Working together, parents and teachers can create a warm and comfortable learning environment for their children.

Organizational and Life-Skills Coaching

Many people with ADHD find it very difficult to stay organised in their life. They often think how to manage their time and complete the daily task, but are not able to do so.
Organisational coaching helps people learn more practical ways of learning activities and use reminders and priorities to their life. People also learn how to build healthy routines and stay motivated. The simple strategies can reduce stress and improve independence.

Family Counseling

ADHD affects entire families. The family dynamics are quite disturbed as the shift is more towards a specific family member. Family counselling helps parents and siblings and other family members understand the condition better and learn how to support each other. When the whole family works together, children and adults with ADHD often feel more confident.

How does Someone Live with ADHD?

Living with ADHD can be very challenging. Such people suffer in their daily lives if they do not have the proper guidance. But many people lead successful and happy lives if they have the right guidance with them. Having a daily routine using reminders and breaking big tasks, smaller steps can be the starting points to a very healthy and organised life. It is also important to remember that ADHD is not something that directly equals low intelligence.

Early treatment and family support can help people reach their full potential.

The early sign of ADHD in children include difficulty, paying attention, constant movement and impulsive behaviour. Such children also forget instructions and have trouble completing their work in any case.

Can a person's ADHD type change over time?

Yes. This is possible. Some symptoms become stronger and some become weaker as a person grows. A child who is very hyperactive may become less active, but still have attention problems.

What is an ADHD person like?

Every person with ADHD behaves differently. Some may be very active, while others may appear quiet but struggle to stay focused. Many people with ADHD are very creative and curious also.

Can ADHD be cured?

Every individual with autism is unique in their own way, which is why it is called the spectrum. Some people need only minimal support, but some require ongoing assistance for a long period in their daily lives.

Understanding autism is the first step towards providing the right care and support. This complete guide explains what autism spectrum disorder is, what are the treatment options available, its early signs and symptoms, what are the possible causes behind it and different levels of support which can be provided to the individuals. It also helps families looking for autism treatment in Gurgaon & Delhi NCR and answers common questions that parents often have.

Earlier identification of autism symptoms and timely intervention can improve a lot of things for them like their communication and learning along with their social skills. What is Autism Spectrum Disorder?

Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a condition that affects how a person communicates, interacts with others around them, learns new things and understands how the world works. It is called a spectrum because every person with autism is unique in their own way. Some people need very little support, while some require attention with their daily activities.

Autism in children often becomes noticeable during the first few years of their life. There are very small but noticeable changes that may appear earlier or later in life. Early diagnosis and timely support can help children develop important communication and life skills. With growing autism awareness, more families are recognising the early concerns and seeking guidance from professionals. Visiting a trusted child development Centre, child psychiatrist or psychologist offering autism treatment in Gurgaon & Delhi NCR can make a real difference in a child’s progress.

What are the Signs and Symptoms of Autism?

Autism symptoms can vary from one person to another. Some children show only a little science, while some show a lot.

Common signs of autism include –

  • – Delayed speech and language development
  • – Problem and understanding what the social cues mean
  • – Repeating words, sounds and movements
  • – Strong urge to follow routines and difficulty handling changes
  • – Interesting in specific objects and topics
  • – High sensitivity to certain sounds, lights, smells, and textures
  • – Difficulty in expressing what they feel and understanding others feelings

Not every child with the symptoms usually has autism spectrum disorder, so a professional evaluation is necessary to know if the parents have any concerns.

What are the Levels of Autism?

Doctors often describe the ASD spectrum using three levels based on the amount of support an individual requires in their daily life. These are-

Level 1. Requiring Support

People at this level can usually manage their lives by using communication to manage themselves independently. However, they may struggle with social interactions on Level, making friends, and even adjusting to changes in the routines.

Level 2. Requiring Substantial Support

Individuals at this level, usually have a little more noticeable communication difference and they also display repetitive behaviors more frequently. They often need regular support at home, school and in social settings.

Level 3. Requiring Very Substantial Support

People at level three autism usually have a very significant communication challenge and require a lot of support in their daily life. They need to be with their caregiver and parents at all times and have very limited speech. They find changes in their routine extremely stressful and resent change.

What Causes Autism?

There is no single cause of autism spectrum disorder. Research suggest that several factors work together to build upon the conditions that bring out its expression. These are-

Genetic Factors

Genetics are considered as one of the biggest contributors to autism spectrum disorder. Research shows that autism runs in families, which makes it an inherited issue. Scientists have identified several genes that increase the likelihood of children developing autism, although no single one of them is responsible for the condition entirely. In many cases, a combination of changes may inference her brain develops before birth. However, having this cheese does not guarantee that a person will definitely have autism. Genetics simply increase the possibility of a child procuring autism, but it does not guarantee that. Many children with autism also have no known family history. Research is continuing to show how different genes affect brain development and contribute to the ASD spectrum.

Environmental and Prenatal Factors

Environmental and prenatal factors play a role in development of autism spectrum disorder, especially when combined with genetic influences. Certain pregnancy related conditions, like premature birth, low birthweight, advanced prenatal age, complications during pregnancy delivery have been linked with a slightly higher risk.
Some studies also suggest that maternal infections during pregnancy or exposure to certain medications may also contribute in rare cases. Most children expose to these situations do not directly develop autism, instead, experts think that autism developed complex interaction between genetic and environmental influences.

Common Myths About Autism Causes

There are many studies about what causes autism, but scientific research has repeatedly disproved them. One of the biggest misconceptions is that childhood vaccines cause autism, and that is simply not true. Multiple large-scale studies around the world have found no link between vaccines and autism spectrum disorder. Another false belief is that poor parenting, emotional neglect, or a lack of affection are also causes behind autism, and that is completely untrue.

Autism is a neurodevelopmental condition and cannot simply appear just because of a bad parenting style. Similarly, eating certain foods, using electronic devices and a child’s personality does not simply cause autism. Spreading accurate information improves autism awareness, and reduces stigma around it.

How is Autism Diagnosed?

There is no single blood test or scan that can diagnose autism directly. Doctors diagnose autism spectrum disorder by observing a child’s behaviour, communication and developmental milestones. They may ask parents detailed questions about the child’s growth and interactions that they have.

Their assessments involve things like-

  • – Developmental milestone screening
  • – Behavioural observations
  • – Speech and language evaluation
  • – Psychological assessment
  • – Medical examination to out any other plausible causes

A specialist in a child development center often has a team of experts like paediatricians, psychologist, speech therapist, and occupational therapist that work together to make an accurate diagnosis.

What are the Treatment and Support Options for Autism?

There is no single tour for autism, but early intervention and personalized support can greatly improve the quality of life for such children. The goal of autism treatment is to help individuals become independent and confident as possible. They should be able to support themselves in their daily lives without much help.

Behavioral Therapies (ABA and Alternatives)

Viral therapy is one of the most common approaches used in autism treatment. The goal is to help children improve their communication, their social interaction, their learning, their daily living skills while reducing behaviours. Applied behaviour and analysis (ABA) approaches are very child, Central and available, depending on the individual needs. Therapy plans are personalised, focusing on each child’s strengths and challenges.

Speech and Communication Therapy

Speech and communication therapy. Make sure that the children improve both on verbal and non-verbal communication skills. Some children learn to speak more clearly while others benefit from gestures and pitch based communications. Therapists work on improving their listening skills, their understanding of language and expression of emotions. They also encourage them to participate in conversations actively. Early speech therapy can become very effective and build stronger relationships with family members, and others around them.

Occupational Therapy

Occupational therapy focuses on helping children become more independent in their daily life. Therapists teach practical skills like eating, dressing up, writing, using school materials and personal hygiene. They help children who experience sensory sensitivity like loud noise, discomfort with bright lights and certain textures.
By improving motor skills and coordination, occupational therapy improves children’s participation by being able to help and stay comfortable at home school and social settings.

Educational and School-Based Support

Children with autism often benefit from educational support that matches their learning needs. Schools usually provide individualised education plans, classroom accommodations, and special educators to build a learning strategy better. Teachers, therapists and parents work together to create a supportive environment. Early education support also helps children build confidence and adapt easily in school routines.

Medication — What It Can and Cannot Treat

There is currently no medication that can cure autism spectrum disorder. however, doctors may prescribe medicines to health, manage these conditions that sometimes occur alongside autism. Conditions like anxiety, attention, difficulties, hyperactivity, sleep issues and irritability are common. Medication is usually recommended only when it is necessary and combined with therapy.

Family Counseling and Parent Training

Family support always plays an important role and helps a child with autism grow and thrive. Parent training programs and teacher caregiver practical are important to improve their communication and encourage positive behaviour. Family counselling also helps parents and siblings. Understanding what the child is going through, reduces stress and strengthens the family relationship.

How does a Person Live with Autism?

Life with autism spectrum disorder is different for every individual. Many people with autism attend school, build careers, develop friendships, and live independently. Others may need lifelong support. Creating a structured routine, encouraging strength, and providing emotional support, ensuring access to the right therapy can help individuals know how to live their life better

Families, teachers, and employers, along with communities around such children have an important role in building acceptance in promoting autism awareness. If you have any concerns about your child and are searching for an autism Centre near me, choosing an experienced team that provides comprehensive evaluation can make early intervention easier.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

FAQ's

Is autism a mental illness?

No. Autism spectrum disorder is a neuro developmental condition and not a mental health condition. However, some people may also experience some related issues like anxiety, depression, and other mental health conditions along with it.

Can autism be cured?

There is no cure for autism as of now. However, early treatment at diagnosis with appropriate autism treatment can significantly improve the conditions and quality of life.

What are the behaviors of autism?

Common behaviours include limited eye, contact, repetitive moments and difficulty with social interactions. These autism symptoms vary from person to person.

Can autism go away or be outgrown?

Autism does not disappear with age. However, early support and therapy can help individuals develop new skills and become more independent.

Is autism genetic?

Resource shows that genetics plays a very important role and development of autism spectrum disorder, but it is not a single root cause of its emergence.

Can adults be diagnosed with autism?

Yes, some people can be diagnosed with autism in their adulthood. this can happen when their symptoms are especially mild and overlooked during childhood. CONTACT US

How to Choose a Psychologist in India: Key Criteria to Look For

Choosing a mental health professional these days requires a number of factors to look into. Especially if it is your first time, looking into some specific pointers and factors can help make the process easier. These are –

Qualifications & RCI Registration

One of the first things you need to do is check whether the psychologist is properly qualified or not. In India, clinical psychologists are expected to be trained and licensed through the Rehabilitation Council of India. An RCI registered psychologist in India is completely recognised to provide proper therapy and support. This matters because mental health support requires an important understanding, ethical practice and professional skills. Before starting therapy, it is okay to ask about qualifications, training, and experience from your expert.

Choosing a Specialist for Specific Concerns

Different psychologists work with people who have different kinds of concerns. For example

  • – Someone struggling with a workplace burnout will go to a counselling psychologist
  • – A child who is facing emotional or behavioural problems will go to a child psychologist.
  • – A person who is recovering from trauma, may experience much better results with a trained trauma. Focused psychologist.

The right match often depends on therapy and what you are dealing with.

Therapy Approaches (CBT, DBT, ACT, EMDR, etc.)

Psychologists often use different kinds of methods based on their concerns. The individuals are facing in their life. You can hear terms like CBT, DBT, ACT or EMDR.

These may sound technical alert first, but understanding them will be a big help.

  • – Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT)– CBT focuses on identifying your unhelpful thoughts and behavioural patterns. It is commonly deployed when a person feels anxiety, depression for going through overthinking and fears and needs stress management.
  • – Dialectal Behavioural Therapy (DBT)– DBT helps people learn about emotional regulation, go through distress tolerance and build more healthier coping skills. It is quite helpful in building emotional stability.
  • – Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT)– ACT encourages people to go through and accept their difficult situations and emotions while focusing on meaningful actions.
  • – EMDR Therapy – this type of therapy is used for trauma recovery. It can help individuals process distressing memories and go through a revelation in the therapeutic setting.

Online vs In-Person Therapy

Today therapy is accessible to people more than ever. Many people now choose online psychologist consultation in India services because they offer a lot of convenience and privacy to them. It is also very flexible so it is very helpful for working professionals and students and caregivers. It is also very extendable and accessible for smaller cities as well.

Other Factors Like Language, Affordability, Comfort Level

Therapy works best when communication feels natural. Choosing someone with language accessibility is very important. Sessions can also vary depending upon the kind of concerns, so it also requires a lot of affordability on the patient’s end. Comfort level is also a very big factor to consider hair. If you do not instantly feel comfortable or find a sense of understanding in the first session itself, it is very important to trust your instinct and go with your best therapeutic relationship.

Types of Psychologists in India — Which Specialist Do You Need?

Many people assume that all psychologists do the same kind of work. This is truly not the case. In reality, different specialists focus on different areas. Here is a simple breakdown for our readers.

Clinical Psychologist

A clinical psychologist is a registered individual who assesses, diagnoses and treats mental health conditions. They commonly work with issues like anxiety disorders, depression, OCD, trauma, cases, personality disorders and severe inflected, emotional distress. People experiencing any kind of emotional and behavioural difficulties can easily consult them.

Counselling Psychologist

A counselling psychologist is focused on emotional well-being, life transition, and personal growth of an individual. These people often help with issues like relationship struggles, workplace stress, students facing academic pressure, self-esteem concerns, family conflicts, adjustment difficulties. Anybody who is dealing with a life challenge and requires emotional guidance can come to them for emotional support. A mental health counsellor in India is a professional that can help people process emotions and navigate personal challenges easily.

Child & Adolescent Psychologist

Children and teenagers also experience a lot of emotional struggles as well. But they may not always know how to express themselves. These psychologists can work with– behavioural concerns, related issues, ADHD problems, emotional regulation, problems, bullying experiences, and social anxiety. Parents who noticed that their children are facing, some kind of emotional and academic or behavioural concerns can go and consult a child and adolescent psychologist.

Neuropsychologist

Neuro psychologists specifically work in the area of the brain and how it influences behaviour, emotions and thinking. They offer help with issues like brain, injuries, memory, concerns, attention, difficulties, neurological disorders and issues of cognitive functioning. Individuals who face memory problems or have problems in cognition, can go and consult a neuro psychologist

Health Psychologist

Health psychologists focus on the connection between the physical and emotional health in an individual. They offer support in the areas of chronic illnesses, pain, management, lifestyle adjustment after a proper diagnosis is received and stress that comes with medical conditions.

Sports Psychologist

Sports psychologists work on the mental strength of athletes in sports performance. They provide their services in areas like – performance, anxiety, confidence, building, focus and concentration of athletes, dealing with competition, stress, and recovery after setbacks. Professional athletes, young players and even fitness enthusiasts can come and take a consultation with a sports psychologist.

Forensic Psychologist

Forensic psychologists work with people who are involved in both psychology and law. They usually give their expertise on cases like – criminal investigations, providing behavioural assessments and court related evaluation. Many legal institutions and professionals involved in legal matters can consult forensic psychologists.

What is the Difference Between Psychiatrist and Psychologist in India

This is one of the most common questions that experts at Tulasi Healthcare usually get. While both professional professionals support mental health, there is a bit of a difference in how they can support an individual in the best manner possible.

Psychologist

A psychologist in India mainly focuses on providing therapy, emotional support, building, behavioural, understanding, and providing psychological assessments. These people help them go through difficult conversations, build very structured interventions and employ therapeutic methods. They however, cannot prescribe medicines to individuals.

Psychiatrist

Psychiatrist and medical doctors who specialise in mental health. They can diagnose psychiatric conditions, prescribe medication, medically, monitor the symptoms of the individual and treat very severe psychiatric concerns as well. For example, if someone is experiencing very severe depression, going through symptoms of psychosis, bipolar disorder or experiencing panic attacks – they may definitely benefit from psychiatric care. In many situations, psychologist, and psychiatrists work together for better care of the individual.

What Mental Health Issues can a Psychologist Help With?

Many people believe that therapy is only required for serious problems in life, but this is totally not true. A psychologist can help with both everyday struggles and complex emotional problems.
Some common problems here include –

Anxiety and Stress

When people go through constant worrying, feel their thoughts are racing and they are going through a face of overthinking and work pressure they can go to a psychologist for therapy to understand their triggers in the situations and develop proper healthy coping mechanisms for themselves.

Depression

Feeling emotionally drained for long periods of time can be a very difficult phase for anyone. People sometimes lose interest in activities, feel fatigue, all the time and experience an emotional numbness that may require professional support.

Trauma

Past experiences continue affecting people and their emotions. So trauma sometimes hinders relationships and the confidence of the individual. Therapy here can help process painful memories and provide a safe environment for the person to explore them.

Relationship and Family Issues

Communication issues, conflict, trust issues and parenting concerns are some of the problems that benefit from psychological support.

Workplace Burnout

Due to long working hours and emotional exhaustion, sometimes people experience job related stress which is increasingly very common in India. A therapist in India can help individuals know what their boundaries are and understand emotional overload to create healthier coping mechanisms.

Benefits of Seeing a Psychologist: What the Research Says

People often don’t understand how therapy actually works. Research over the years gives away into therapy and tells us that it can positively affect emotion and mental well-being. It truly improves overall quality of life and some of the benefits that people report include –

Better Emotional Awareness

Emotional awareness is all about understanding where you find yourself in the spectrum of emotions. What your feelings are, and why you are feeling them. Sometimes emotions can feel confusing and talking through them helps create clarity around them.

Healthier Coping Skills

Instead of suppressing your emotions, therapy helps you be open about your problems and what you’re feeling towards them. Owning your own emotions and working towards them. A constructive and positive manner is all about building healthier coping skills.

Improved Relationships

Understanding communication patterns within yourself and identifying them for yourself, makes you improve your patterns for your loved ones and people around you. This directly helps you in improving your relationships and managing difficult situations effectively.

Better Stress Management

When you are in control of your emotions, you automatically feel that you can control what is happening with you and in front of you. This is truly about giving yourself the right to manage stress better and in a more aware manner.

Increased Self Awareness

Self awareness helps you in many ways that you cannot imagine. It helps people recognise their own patterns which helps them manage and understand their emotional triggers and unhelpful habits easily.

A Safe Space to Talk

Sometimes it is just good to be heard. Many people simply need a space where they can talk openly without any fear of judgement. Seeking counselling in India has become more accepted within the years and now people actually enjoy overall well-being rather than responding to just crises.

Ready to Speak to Someone? Your First Step Starts Here.

People do not need to have everything figured out before they come into therapy – because it is the purpose of therapy to do it with you. Sometimes it is very difficult to start something which you are unsure of– and that is why Tulasi Healthcare is here with you. Whether you are feeling overwhelmed, stuck emotionally in something and struggling with things around you, exploring therapy can be the beginning of a positive change for you. If you have considered support reaching out to our experts, today can be the very turning point in your life.

Who is the best psychologist in India?

There is no single university best accepted psychologist in India. But to enter the list, one really needs to have a ton of experience. In this case, Dr Gorav Gupta from Tulasi Healthcare is someone who makes the list. With more than two decades of experience in the field, his expertise in treating people with severe anxiety, depression, OCD, and a variety of mental health conditions is something to look out for and approach for a healthy lifestyle support.

Is online therapy effective in India?

Yes, online therapy is very effective in India. This is so because there are many people who cannot find the match within their own community or around them, and this particular practice helped them find their best matching therapist around the country. Also, due to the restraint placed by being a student, a working professional and somebody who does not feel at ease in another space, this online therapy provides a way to be flexible, yet approachable for many.

Can you be a clinical psychologist with autism?

Yes, it is absolutely alright to have autism along with being a clinical psychologist. It does not automatically prevent someone from becoming one. There are many autistic people who work successfully and mental health space.

Do I need a referral to see a psychologist?

No, it is not necessary for you to have a referral before seeing a psychologist. In case you have gone to other psychologist and they have not understood you or think that their case would be better handled by somebody else, in that case you would require a referral.

contentHtml:
Stroke Rehabilitation: a new Pathway to Independence and Recovery

A brain stroke can be an event of life and death, so it holds much significance in medical treatment and rehabilitation. But when it occurs, it is not an isolated event. It brings about issues with movement, cognition, learning, memory, and emotional health. Many people struggle to bring functionality back into their life. This is where stroke rehabilitation plays a critical role in defining quality of life for them. Such people need a structured, well equipped, multidisciplinary design that can help them regain control.

Whether you or your loved one are in the process of starting their journey to recovery. It is important to understand that a stroke rehabilitation centre can empower them in many ways. Here with the help of experts, one can design their journey in a specific manner. List their particular goals and work towards it with support and understanding. With the help of these realistic expectations, reaching goals is easier and it benefits both families and the clients.

What is Stroke Rehabilitation?

Stroke Rehabilitation is a specialised process of recovery focused on helping people regain their life after a brain stroke. A brain stroke essentially stops blood flow to certain parts of the brain that are essential for maintaining full functionality of the body and mind. This can damage a lot of areas responsible for movement, speech, cognition, and emotional regulation. The recovery also depends on the location and severity of the stroke in the brain area. The more complex the stroke, the higher will be the recovery issues and treatment plans.

The recovery is usually set out for the time as soon as the patient improves in condition. It is often set out after 24 to 48 hours post stroke.

This rehab rehabilitation can be accessed in various settings like hospitals, clinics, or dedicated rehabilitation Centre for stroke patients like Tulasi Healthcare. Where our team of specialised experts focus only on post stroke recovery.

Goals of Stroke Rehabilitation

The primary goal of stroke rehabilitation is to get as much functionality out of the situation as possible. This allows individuals to return to their routines with positivity and dignity. The goals include:

  • – Regaining physical abilities– Many patients suffer from paralysis and weakness usually on one side of the body. Rehabilitation restores movement with occupational and physiotherapy.
  • – Improving communication– Strokes are known to be highly damaging to communication areas in the brain. This medals with their ability to speak, listen, read as well as write in many cases.
  • – Enhancing cognition- Memory loss, confusion, and difficulty to communicate are very common problems in a brain stroke. With mental exercises a therapist helps them with problem solving abilities and improving overall functioning.
  • – Emotional and psychological support– Mental disturbance is like depression, anxiety and frustration can arise as a result of a physical issue. Counselling and therapy helps clients understand their new reality and walk towards their well-being
  • – Encouraging independence– The ultimate goal is to help people manage their independence with minimal to no assistance and enhancing quality of life.

What activities under Stroke Rehabilitation?

Brain stroke recovery is really simple. It requires multifaceted efforts to bring about a good result. If you approach a good stroke rehabilitation Centre, you can typically find these following activities that enhance recovery-

  • – Physiotherapy- It focuses on improving balance, movement and coordination. It usually includes activities like stretching, walking practices, exercise exercises, and motor learning programs.
  • – Occupational therapy– occupational therapy addresses life skills that are necessary to maintain functionality in real life. Every day activities like cooking, dressing, personal hygiene are included in this therapist usually suggest tools and medication inside the home environment for better learning.
  • – Speech and language therapy– This therapy helps in problems with speaking, understanding, reading and writing. If the condition is very severe, then therapists help with establishing alternative methods.
  • – Cognitive rehabilitation– As the affected area is the brain, problem solving skills suffer a major setback. Therapists here apply tasks and games designed to stimulate specific areas of the brain to improve memory and attention.
  • – Psychological counselling– A rehabilitation centre for stroke patients often provide mental health counselling to individuals and families scoping with emotional impact this event. It addresses issues like depression, anxiety, and motivation problems.
  • – Nutritional counselling– people with stroke issues suffer from several dietary restrictions because of their condition as well as swallowing difficulties. Here an experienced dietician creates a personalised plan that is accessory in supporting healing.
  • – Caregiver support– family environment in rehabilitation is critical. We offer caregiver education, community integration programmes along with support groups to reduce burnout and isolation.

Benefits of this Rehabilitation Program

Joining a good rehabilitation programme at a stroke rehab rehabilitation centre has several benefits then we can imagine. Here’s why it is a game changer for recovery-

  • – Faster and more Comprehensive– the chances of recovery increase multifold as earlier as it started. The effect of neuropasticity is rerouted to different parts of the brain, which significantly improves the patient’s condition and ability to live independently.
  • – Less Risk of Complications– When proper rehabilitation is not provided at the right time, issues like muscle stiffness, blood clots and infections due to immobility can rise. A stroke rehabilitation program actively works to prevent the issues and improve quality of life.
  • – Improve Motivation and Mental Status– A rehabilitation Centre for stroke patients offer a great psychological support post stroke. With depression and anxiety over their condition looming in their heads, being surrounded with positivity and support is essential. Our experts at Tulasi Healthcare foster Hope and a sense of purpose in clients and their families.
  • – Better Family and Social Integration– many people withdraw themselves, socially and emotionally from their circles, due to embarrassment and fear. Rehabilitation helps them navigate these crucial points.
  • – Personalised Progress Tracking– A high-level of personalised care is available at a stroke rehabilitation Centre, which ensures that no time effort is wasted on ineffective plans.

Choosing the right Stroke Rehabilitation Centre

A brain stroke is a life-threatening condition which can alter the course of life for anyone. But this does not mean it has to cost them their life and independence in any manner. If you are a loved one on this journey, connecting with Tulasi Healthcare today can be the answer to all your issues.

Frequently Asked Questions

FAQ's

What is stroke rehabilitation?

It is a structured process of recovery where people suffering from a brain stroke, their physical and mental well-being with the help of different psychological and physical therapies. Here the goal is to restore a good quality of life and social and emotional integration back into society.

Who should seek stroke rehabilitation?

People who have experienced a brain stroke or face difficulty due to its long-term effect can approach this rehab rehabilitation. It is suitable for people of all age groups who suffer from this issue and find better outcomes for their lives. Family members are also often a part of this program.

How long is rehabilitation after a stroke?

Based on criticality and location of the stroke, rehabilitation can vary. Some people may also take a higher time to recover based on their motivation and progression. The length of recovery may vary from a few weeks to months and even years and in severe cases. It is essential to seek therapy in the first few days to get the best results.

What does stroke rehabilitation involve?

Stroke rehabilitation covers levels of activities that improve memory, cognition and physical symptoms of the stroke. Apart from these nutritional counselling, psychological counselling and caregiver education are also provided to build a holistic environment for treatment.

contentHtml:
Drug screening tests these days have become a utility and pre-requisite in various sectors. From healthcare to corporate, the excessive interference of drug use in performance and livelihood endangerment has pushed decision makers to put legal frameworks into place. At the core, these tests are designed to detect the presence of substances that can affect an individual’s physical, emotional, or mental well-being, but their value goes far beyond detection alone.

With over two years of experience in the field of mental health care and rehabilitation, Tulasi healthcare brings a reliable and sensitive care approach to drug screening.

What is a Drug Screening Test?

A drug screening test is used to detect the presence of unwanted and illicit drugs in your body. It is commonly administered through blood, sweat, saliva or hair samples. The primary motive of these tests is to determine any foul play or performance enhancement through illicit use.

Drug screenings are frequently employed at:

  • – Pre-employment Screening
  • – Substance Abuse Treatment
  • – Sports and Athletic Programs
  • – Forensic and Legal Purposes
  • – Monitoring and Medication Compliance

Why Choose Tulasi Healthcare for Drug Screening Services?

At Tulasi, we ensure that each step taken towards the wellbeing of an individual is responsible, ethical and with utmost care to the individual’s dignity.

  • – Accredited Facilities– We follow international guidelines to maintain the best practices and standards. This ensures that our facilities function according to every legal and ethical guideline put into place.
  • – Confidentiality– We understand the confidentiality that surrounds the sensitive topic of drug testing. Our facility ensures that every data point is protected and displayed in accordance with medical and ethical guidelines.
  • – Quick Turnaround Time– With prompt timelines through efficient testing standards, we display accuracy with speed on our durg panels.
  • – Expert Supervision– Our tests are supervised and performed under the best medical professionals in the field that include professionals trained in toxicology, addiction medicine, and psychiatry.
  • – Comprehensive Support– Whether you approach us for a one time test or as a part of a rehabilitation program, we make sure you acquire every bit of support and understanding from our end.

Value of Drug Screening in Modern Healthcare

The use of drug detection extends beyond just clinical use. It has a variety of application that go beyond a rehabilitation center, listed as follows-

  • – Early Detection– Drug screening plays a critical role in managing substance use before progressing into full blown addiction. Early detection allows medical professionals to arise from drug associated difficulties. It paves a way for a deep understanding and development of a holistic health plan.
  • – Reintegration Support– As people transition out of their rehabilitation journey, regular monitoring is essential. Periodic drug tests ensure abstinence and care. So, drug screening here serves as a checkpoint and motivational intervention.
  • – Pre-employment and Background Screening– Employers often use drug screening as a part of the hiring process. It ensures that an individual joining the organization complies with the values and notions they stand for. . This is particularly critical in industries such as aviation, construction, manufacturing, and transportation—where impairment can pose serious risks. Beyond safety, pre-employment drug screening reflects a commitment to workplace integrity, reliability, and overall professionalism.

Thriving Minds is Tulasi Healthcare’s EAP program that focuses on the mental health and wellbeing of your employees. With our professional services pertaining to compliance and integrity, our team ensures the well being of every individual. Employee Wellbeing Programs provide a way for organizations to help their employees steer clear of such behavior through constant checks and interventions.

  • – Probation and Legal Mandates– There are times when court and legal mandates dictate drug testing due to foul-play or misconduct in some cases of sports or performance enhancement. In such cases, drug testing ensures that individuals abide by legal terms.
  • – Child custody and family court cases– Drug screenings can become a key factor in determining parental fitness. When there is a history or suspicion of substance use, routine testing helps to pertain to a child’s safety and wellbeing. While these screenings are emotionally challenging, they provide a practical and structured path for the child’s future.
  • – Youth accountability and sports integrity– For a stable academic and personal growth, schools may indulge in drug screenings. The aim is ‘prevention’, and not punishment. This step will ensure that any peer pressure does not contribute to this kind of behavior. The same runs for sports integrity, where performance enhancement after consuming illicit drugs is a serious offence.

Drug Screening Panels Offered at Tulasi Healthcare

At Tulasi, we understand that every area has its own spectrum and different needs. Keeping that in mind, we have different panels of drugs that test for some specific drugs at a time. Let’s take a look at all the different panels.

  • – 5 Panel- Marijuana, Amphetamine, Cocaine, Morphine/ Opiate (MOI) & Phencyclidine (PCP)
  • – 6 Panel- Marijuana, Amphetamine, Cocaine, Phencyclidine (PCP), Opiates and Barbiturates
  • – 7 Panel- Marijuana, Amphetamine, Cocaine, Phencyclidine (PCP), Opiates, Barbiturates & Benzodiazepine
  • – 8 Panel- Amphetamine, Barbiturates, Benzodiazepine, Cannabinoids, Cocaine, Opiates, Phencyclidine (PCP), Methaqualone
  • – 9 Panel- Marijuana, Amphetamine, Cocaine, Morphine/ Opiate (MOI) & Phencyclidine (PCP), Barbiturates, Benzodiazepine, Methadone, Propoxyphene
  • – 10 Panel- Amphetamine, Benzodiazepine, Marijuana, Methaqualone, Phencyclidine (PCP), Cocaine, Methadone, Opiates, Propoxyphene, Barbiturates
  • – 11 Panel– Amphetamine, Methamphetamine, Cocaine, Morphine, Benzodiazepine, Ecstasy, Propoxyphene, Methadone, Methaqualone, Tricyclic Antidepressants, Cotinine
  • – 12 Panel– Amphetamine, Barbiturates, Benzodiazepine,Marijuana, Cocaine, Methadone, Tricyclic Antidepressants, Opiates, Oxycodone, Phencyclidine (PCP), Propoxyphene, Methamphetamines.

Why Choose a Rehabilitation Centre for Drug Screenings?

A rehabilitation centre offers a far better chance of detection and follow up support than just a single use testing agency. At a trusted facility like Tulasi Healthcare, testing is not only a step- it is a part of a journey from diagnosis to recovery. It is all a part of a supportive ecosystem that is designed to facilitate a better recovery journey.

A rehabilitation centre brings about a clinical understanding, ethical concerns and a sense of confidentiality that builds the very premise of mental health care. Drug misuse is a growing concern in the sedentary and monotonous routines, and we facilitate methods that remove people from this trance. Whether you seek clarity, compliance, or support, a rehabilitation center is equipped to meet the need with professionalism and empathy.

Frequently Asked Questions

FAQ's

What is a drug screening test?

drug screening test is a tool used in the medical laboratories to test for the presence of illegal substances in the body. Its results are used to guide decision making processes in the medical, legal and employment related matters. Usually, it is administered in professional settings through psychiatrists in rehabilitation centers to maintain all ethical standards.

How long can drugs be detected in urine?

Illegal substances like drugs can show up in the urine and be detected for a time period ranging from a few hours to weeks. This depends upon the potency of the drug. Chronic use and metabolism rates also affect the detection timeline. This is why urine can be a reliable tool to detect short to medium term indicators.

What drugs test positive?

Some common drugs that are easy to detect include marijuana, amphetamine, cocaine, heroine, benzodiazepine etc. Detection depends upon a list of factors that include type, variety, dosage etc.

What is screening for drugs?

Screening for drugs is a medical probe that focuses upon finding a specific illegal substance in the body with the help of a biological sample. These can include blood, saliva and hair samples. The goal is to identify recent or chronic drug use patterns.

How long do drug test results take?

Typically, the tests take around 1-3 days for proper testing. However, urine testing is a quite rapid process. Timing may vary based on the type of test and the testing facility.

Can a urine drug test show how much you take?

A urine drug test cannot actually show the specific amount of drug that was taken. Rather, it can just show the usage and presence of a drug in the body. Factors like metabolism, hydration, and time since use affect results.

How is a drug test done?

A drug test is usually done with the help of a biological sample that involves use of blood, saliva, urine or sweat samples. Here, urine tests are most common.

How much does a drug test cost?

Usually, simply 5-7 panel tests cost somewhere between Rs.1000-1500, depending upon the comprehensive facility provided by a rehabilitation center. More extensive panel tests costs can vary for different places.

Psychologist vs Psychiatrist: Which One Should You Consult?

contentHtml:
Dementia treatment in India: How to approach the issue?

With the rise in neurological disorders, dementia is one of the most recognized issues. Even with its recognition and continuous advancement in the field, finding the right dementia treatment in India has been quite a concern. While conducting thorough interactions with our community of experts, we found that despite availability, many individuals struggle to find the right dementia treatment in India.

Only through the right management strategies and continuous monitoring, one can minimize the struggles of dementia for their loved ones. If you are searching for a dementia care center in Delhi or a dementia care center in Gurgaon, you are at the right place. With Tulasi Home, you receive a homely environment infused with love and essential therapeutic care one needs.

Dementia is a neurologically deteriorating condition that presently does not have a treatment. By treatment, we simply mean managing and balancing the condition better to improve the quality of life and improve wellbeing.

According to different sources, it is estimated that in India alone, around 4 million people may be subject to dementia. That is a huge number- without proper structure and awareness in place to take care of it. To raise awareness, counter concerns and answer the most searched queries, let’s talk about the basics, management and treatment options for dementia in India.

How do the symptoms present?

Since dementia is a presentation of cognitive decline with loss of memory, thinking, reasoning and language, it is fairly easy to detect in later stages. An early intervention is a hard task, since symptoms may be brushed off as usual disorientation from burnout or stress. The severity of dementia symptoms can range from mild to severe, but they typically interfere with the individual’s ability to carry out daily tasks and activities. Common signs and symptoms of dementia include:

  • Memory loss- Difficulty remembering recent events and activities.
  • Disorientation- Losing idea of current time, place and people.
  • Language issues- Difficulty finding the right words to express and understand language.
  • Lack of judgement- Taking decisions that are not correct according to any presented situation.
  • Mood changes- Sudden outbursts or downfalls in mood. Feeling depressed, anxious or irritable without cause.
  • Coordination issues- Issues with movement and motor skills.

Risk factors to consider

There are some predetermined factors that can result in developing dementia. There can be just one or a mix of such factors that increases the probability of the issue.

Age: Dementia is common in older adults, especially those over 65, but can also show up as an early onset.

Family history: Genetic factors can play a role, especially in early-onset dementia. Having a family member with dementia can exponentially increase your chances.

Gender: Women are more likely to develop dementia than men.

Lifestyle factors: Poor cardiovascular health, smoking, and lack of physical activity increase the risk of dementia.

Head trauma: Severe or repeated head injuries can lead to cognitive decline later in life.

Chronic health conditions: Diabetes, hypertension, and high cholesterol can increase the risk of dementia.

Dementia treatment options in India

Dementia treatment, as of now, is an emerging field full of research practices and continuous testing. The approach for now can be divided into medical management, non-pharmacological interventions and support systems.

1- Medical management

At our dementia care center in Gurgaon, we employ a well-studied dementia care regime that is medically managed to provide instant relief and orientation to our clients. These medications include-

  • Cholinesterase inhibitors: Medications like Donepezil, Rivastigmine, and Galantamine, increase the levels of acetylcholine, which is a neurotransmitter found for involvement in memory and learning. It is primarily employed in Alzheimer’s disease and some types of vascular dementia.
  • Memantine: Memantine regulates the activity of glutamate, which is associated with learning and memory. It is usually prescribed for moderate to severe Alzheimer’s and is often used alongside cholinesterase inhibitors. With a mixed impact, the symptoms are managed better. The dosage of these medicines are kept in regular check to minimize any side effects.
  • Antidepressants and antipsychotics: In most cases, clients with dementia experience depression, anxiety, or aggression. Medications like selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) or atypical antipsychotics are prescribed to manage these symptoms. These medications are also regulated in their dosages to minimize the side effects and still maintain the integrity of treatment.
  • Blood pressure, cholesterol, and diabetes management: Proper management of pre-existing issues such as hypertension, diabetes, and high cholesterol, is crucial in preventing further cognitive decline and managing vascular dementia. Apart from these, any other issues are also taken into account. Through a thorough assessment we ensure the well being of the client at our dementia care center in Gurgaon.

2- Non-pharmacological interventions

Along with medications, therapeutic interventions have proven to be very beneficial. They’re not just important for maintaining a state of wellbeing, but provide a sense of continuous support and improvement in quality of life.

  • Cognitive Stimulation therapy– Dementia takes over the cognitive functions, which can render a person in a state of confusion and problems. Tasks like puzzles, games, and exercises target different cognitive functions, such as memory, language, and problem-solving. These activities act as revision or memory exercises to keep the client up to date and active.
  • Reminiscence therapy– Here, the clients are encouraged to talk about their past experiences, to jog their memory and understand their level of recall. Along with this, they are also encouraged to stimulate their memory through photographs, audios, videos etc.
  • Reality orientation therapy– Due to dementia, a person is not oriented with their surroundings. During many cases we experienced at our dementia care center, we saw that the clients have a hard time orienting themselves. With this therapy, the clients are made familiar with the place, time and people to help them jog their memory.
  • Music therapy– Music is seen to have a deep impact on people suffering with dementia. When familiar songs or tunes are played, clients report an improved mood, reduced level of anxiety and even memory stimulation.
  • Art therapy– Art is a form of expression in many respects. With art therapy, dementia patients actively indulge in expressing their memories. At our dementia care center in Gurgaon, we make sure to employ such engaging and fun activities for our clients. This ensures a break from the monotonous routine of receiving treatment.
  • Physical therapy– Simple exercises like walking, stretching, playing simple games can promote motor cognition and prevent physical decline for clients. Since dementia is usually found in older adults, physical activity can also serve as a way of restoring and maintaining their wellbeing.

3- Caregiving and Support at our Dementia care center in Delhi

 With an issue like dementia, having care and support during every step of the way is essential. Not only the clients, but the family members are also in need of support as this is also an emotional turmoil for them. Let’s discuss some care practices at our dementia care center-

  • Family support– Usually, people with dementia are cared for by their family members. This is because they are unaware about any specialized dementia care centres. This usually takes a toll on their mental health. To deal with this, our dementia care center in Gurgaon imparts emotional support, education, and respite services. This ensures that they can manage the stresses of caregiving.
  • Respite care– There are times when family caregivers may feel burnout and feel that they are unable to care for their loved ones. In such cases, respite care or temporary caregiving services can be employed to ensure that the family has time to unwind.
  • Assisted living– At an advanced stage, intervention from experts is necessary. For this, assisted living with dementia care center can be a good option. Tulasi Home is a well-established Dementia care center in Delhi that provides round the clock care to clients suffering with such issues. With assisted management and interventions, we help our clients attain a state of wellbeing.
  • Support groups– With valuable support and practical advice, dementia care support groups are essential for caregivers to understand common issues.These groups, both online and in-person, allow individuals to share experiences, challenges, and coping strategies.
  • Palliative and hospice care– End of life care helps an individual live a life of dignity and respect during their last days. There is a special team of experts that helps the client manage their symptoms and support the family during such emotional and perilous times.

Challenges with dementia treatment in India

Even with specialized treatment facilities, there are many individuals that struggle to find the right kind of care for themselves & their loved ones. As mental health practitioners, we feel there are many challenges to address.

  • Awareness & diagnosis– Without awareness, seeking a diagnosis is a far cry. Many clients come to us at very later stages, where even providing intervention sometimes becomes a task.
  • Stigma– Any issue that is related to the brain and its workings draws stigma to mental health. Families tend to hide diagnosis in the fear of embarrassment. As a result, deterioration in the condition prevails.
  • Financial burden– Dementia in itself is a time consuming and financial responsibility. If an individual is to receive treatment, there is a lifelong financial commitment that many cannot take. This becomes a problem with many seeking treatment.

Visit our dementia care center in Delhi for a consultation today.

Dementia is a genuine issue with today’s sedentary lifestyle & needs to be taken seriously. It affects individuals as well as their families in many ways. Managing symptoms at an early stage is better to delay disease progress. If you or your loved one are experiencing memory loss, struggling to eat, facing issues in daily tasks, consulting a healthcare professional is a must. Explore available resources like specialized care facilities and support groups that help you by providing the necessary guidance.

Don’t hesitate to inform your loved one or a friend you trust when you face difficulties. Don’t let the stigma around it ruin you and your family life. Without delay, reach out to us today.  Let’s work together and help improve your quality of life.

How does dementia affect an individual?

It depends on person to person and the type of dementia. Patients suffering from dementia face difficulties in remembering things, rapid mood swings, and unable to perform daily tasks. The most common cause of dementia is Alzheimer’s disease. Patients are unable to eat, struggle to maintain relationships, and lose interest in socializing.

Is there any cure for dementia?

There is no cure for dementia as of now. It also depends on the type of dementia an individual has. However, treatment options like proper medication, therapies, and lifestyle changes can help in managing symptoms. Such treatment focuses on improving the patient’s quality of life. If you are looking for a dementia care center in Delhi, Tulasi Healthcare can be your go to.

Are there any special care facilities for people with dementia?

Yes, there are many specialized care facilities available for dementia patients. These are known as dementia care centers or memory care facilities. Facilities such as specialized care, trained staff, and therapies are available. They provide safe surroundings with a supportive system and proper routines. Clients can visit our dementia care center in Gurgaon and explore a variety of facilities that are provided.

What is the role of non-drug therapies in treating dementia?

Non-drug therapies are significant for treating dementia. Activities such as cognitive stimulation therapy and cognitive rehabilitation help in improving memory. It also assists individuals in upgrading their problem-solving skills.

How common is dementia in India?

According to recent estimates, 8.8 million adults in their 60s are living with dementia in India. It also highlights the massive impact of this condition on an average adult. They are unable to read, eat, and enjoy socializing. These figures raise an alarm that has to be addressed.

What are the treatment options available for dementia in India?

In India, dementia treatment focuses on improving the quality of life. This can be achieved by managing symptoms. Medications such as cholinesterase inhibitors, memantine, and donepezil are often advised for finding its symptoms. These medications are recommended for patients to delay the disease process.

excerpt: Seeking palliative care for Dementia? Tulasi Healthcare is your answer. The dawn of time takes a toll on our bodies, and it brings a myriad of issues along with it.
