contentHtml:
Seeking palliative care for Dementia? Tulasi Healthcare is your answer.

The dawn of time takes a toll on our bodies, and it brings a myriad of issues along with it. Dementia is one such condition. With sudden cognitive decline and memory disruptions due to damage to brain structure, it is a serious mental health condition. Some of the world’s population falls prey to this condition, and the treatment options are still a far cry. With recent advancements in the field, better management strategies and palliative care measures have been made. Through Tulasi’s palliative care for dementia, you receive the best of medical fraternity’s approved methods.

At Tulasi Healthcare, our palliative care strategies shine through with a dedicated staff and team. Since many of our audience is still looking and acquiring knowledge about palliative care and intricacies for dementia, let’s discuss the basics first.

What is Palliative care?

Palliative care is a curated medical care that focuses on providing relief from the symptoms and suffering related to serious illnesses like dementia and Alzheimer’s. It is not exactly a treatment plan, rather it enhances the quality of life by managing pain and other distressing symptoms. The goal is not to provide a cure by any means, but to ensure that individuals can live as comfortably and meaningfully as possible in the time they have.

It is quite holistic in nature, catering not only to physical symptoms but also to emotional, social, and spiritual needs. With a team of healthcare professionals that includes psychiatrists, nurses, social workers, and chaplains we work together to create a care plan tailored to the specific needs of the individual.

Why is Palliative care in Dementia important?

Dementia brings an umbrella of issues with it, most which are beyond management for an untrained eye.  As the condition progresses, it causes the memory to decline, thinking unclear and communication abrupt. The ability to perform everyday tasks is frozen. Over time, physical health problems also show up, such as difficulty swallowing, incontinence, and reduced mobility.

This is where palliative care in dementia steps in. How does it help the clients? Let’s take a keen look.

  • Managing symptoms- Clients often experience pain, agitation, confusion and motor issues. Aggression and sleep disturbances are quite common, leading to a dire state. Palliative care allows addressing these issues and providing medications or therapies that can improve condition and provide comfort.
  • Family support and care- A family works as a unit to take care of the issues that one member of the family is facing. This leads to a disturbance in the family’s daily functioning. Palliative care teams not only care for the individual with dementia but also offer support for families and caregivers. This is because they deal with the emotional and physical toll of caregiving. This may include counseling and practical advice on managing care at home.
  • Enhancing quality of life- SInce a disorder takes away the quality of life that an individual can experience, palliative care aims to give back that comfort. It emphasizes on emotional and physical well-being, aiming to make the client’s final years or months as pleasant and dignified as possible.
  • Addressing end of life care- As the issue advances, loved ones need to make difficult decisions about end-of-life care. This can  include pursuing certain medical treatments or interventions. Palliative care teams can guide families in making informed decisions that align with the patient’s values and preferences.

Palliative care during different stages of Dementia

Dementia progresses in different stages. Simply search for palliative care near me. Try to understand the dilemma that comes with management of dementia patients. Here, you will identify the different stages and their needs at times.

Let’s discuss the different stages and how palliative care for dementia helps-

  • Early stage- In the early stage of dementia, the individual may still function independently. But mild cognitive decline, memory loss, and difficulty with complex tasks usually sets in. Palliative care at this stage focuses on:
  • Education and support: Helping the client and their family understand the progression and what to expect.
  • Planning for the future: This includes discussions about legal and financial matters, living wills, and advanced care directives.
  • Managing early symptoms: Early symptoms, such as forgetfulness or anxiety, may be addressed with non-invasive interventions like therapy or medication.
  • Promoting quality of life: Encouraging activities that engage the person like hobbies, exercise, and social interaction for keeping them active and in the loop.
  • Middle stage- Assistance with daily activities raises, leading to a high level of dependence. As the condition worsens, issues that need to be tackled are-

Pain management: Pain may become more noticeable, especially when gauging it becomes problematic for the client. Palliative care identifies and alleviates pain through medication and other therapies.

Behavioral symptoms: As dementia advances, individuals may experience behavioral roadblocks such as aggression, agitation, or wandering without context. Specialized interventions like cognitive-behavioral strategies can be used to manage these behaviors.

Nutritional planning: There is a marked difficulty with swallowing and eating This may require modifications to the diet or assistance with feeding. Palliative care provides advice on how to maintain nutrition and hydration as the individual’s faces issues.

  • Late stage- .In the later stages, individuals become completely dependent on caregivers, and the quality of life is not quite dignified. To deal with this, palliative care gives-

End-of-life care: End-of-life care is a primary issue that is to be dealt with by the family members of the client. This can include whether to pursue aggressive treatments or focus on comfort care.

Bereavement support: After the death of a loved one, the family may require support in coping with the loss. Palliative care teams provide grief counseling and help family members with the grieving process.

Therapies included in Palliative care for dementia

Palliative care requires the use of therapies in all aspects, and under our care, clients receive numerous therapies to soothe their issues. To make end of life care as smooth as possible, use of therapies is essential.  What essential therapies are applied- you might ask? Let’s discuss them in detail.

Physical Therapies: Occupational and physical therapies are essential to mobilize and keep motor function intact.Exercise routines are tailored to the client’s abilities, since not every person can have the range to maintain physical momentum. This prevents physical decline. Occupational therapies provide essential support to carry out daily activities that help the client take care of themselves on a basic level.

Psychosocial Support: Family counseling and support groups are essential for caregivers. Why, you may ask? This is because taking care of an individual who is suffering from a mental health issue is a daunting task. It takes away a lot of energy and time, which may take a toll on the caregiver. It is essential for providing emotional support and coping with the demands of caregiving.

Non-Pharmacological Therapies: These therapies play an important role in enhancing well-being and tackling behavioral and psychological symptoms of dementia (BPSD). Cognitive stimulation therapy (CST) focuses on employing clients in activities that promote cognitive function with group exercises or memory games. Reality orientation therapy is where the clients are regularly provided with information about time, place, and identity which helps reduce confusion.

Pharmacological Therapies: Pharmacological therapies control the more aggressive symptoms of dementia.  Antidepressants and antipsychotics are used to manage symptoms like depression, anxiety, or aggression. While there is no cure even through medications, pharmacological therapies help in managing symptoms and applying psychological therapies effectively.

Importance of family and caregiver support

Family and caregiver support are essential in managing problems of dementia. With Tulasi healthcare, we are providing a safe haven for the betterment of your loved one and your own health. Caring for someone who struggles on their own is not an easy task, it takes energy, time and sacrifice that can deter even the strongest minds. While we understand this, we also offer the most holistic support from our end so the caregivers can heal while their loved ones do.

  • Emotional support- Family members and support networks provide essential emotional stability, helping caregivers manage feelings of stress, guilt, and isolation.
  • Practical assistance– Caregivers assist with daily tasks, from managing medications to helping with personal care, mobility, and eating.This helps family members focus on themselves, Prioritize their own tasks without the guilt of not caring for their loved one.
  • Understanding and compassion- Harboring feelings of guilt can soon turn into hatred or even frustration when the client’s needs are not met. In such cases, family members need understanding and compassion to stabilize their mindset. This helps them to free their minds and tackle the situation of caring for their loved one much better.

Decision making– During the end of life care, family members need to make certain hard decisions that can impact the client as well as their future. In such cases, providing counseling and preparing them for what is to be expected ahead is a responsibility that lies with us. With a good palliative care for dementia at place, family members can make informed decisions.

Taking Initiatives toward Palliative Care for Dementia

If you are living with dementia, taking the initial step is the best way toward recovery. It can be overwhelming to look after a person with dementia. But with proper support, medical care, bringing comfort, dignity and quality of life for patients and their families is possible. Specialized care helps in recognizing symptoms. It provides the psychological and emotional support needed to address your needs.

Whether seeking help with regular caregiving tasks or seeking guidance on managing severe symptoms, palliative care is here to overcome your burden. We do create a holistic plan that respects your loved ones, and helps in empowering you as a caregiver.

Reach out today to explore several palliative care options. Let’s be together on this journey with you. We make sure to bring comfort and peace towards your loved ones and unlimited support only for you. Get in touch with a dementia care specialist now.

Frequently Asked Questions

FAQ's

How does palliative care help in curing dementia?

Palliative care plays an important role in helping an individual facing dementia. It gets difficult for them to eat food properly as they lose the ability to feed themselves. The specialists in palliative care make sure that a person gets the utmost care. It helps patients and families deal with the complicated healthcare system.

How can I access palliative care services for dementia?

Make sure to inform your loved ones with their primary doctor to discuss your concerns. Share what you are facing. Visit a palliative care specialist once the primary doctor refers you to them. The palliative care team will conduct an assessment of your physical, social, and emotional needs. They will continue to provide ongoing support and look after the condition.

When is the right time for a person with dementia to receive palliative care?

It can begin at any time. However, it gets worse in the later stages of dementia as symptoms deteriorate. So, it is recommended to receive palliative care for a person with dementia as early as possible. Palliative care can help in improving the quality of life quality. It reduces the burden on the person with dementia as their family.

How does palliative care help caregivers deal with patients with dementia?

There are several ways that palliative care can help caregivers to deal with patients having dementia. Here are a few of them: Communication, decision-making, support, advance care planning, and pain management. It is a specialized medical care that can be given at any stage of dementia. Its main focus is to improve the life quality of the patient and their family.

What are all the things to do before visiting a palliative care specialist?

It is great that you are preparing yourself to visit the palliative care specialist. But before visiting, make sure to collect medical reports, know your goals, be open and honest, be a good listener, and carry medications. These are the things to ensure that you consult a good specialist. It will help you to get a top-class team that can be cooperative and caring.

contentHtml:
Best Dementia Care Treatment Clinic in Gurgaon

Dementia- a condition many of us are not much aware about. An illness that does not show up until old age draws little to no attention from busy adults. This is the reason why awareness and education matters on this topic. Today, we discuss the condition itself, the possible risk factors and probable treatment and management strategies for dementia.

What is Dementia?

Described in easy terms, dementia is a condition where a severe cognitive decline occurs and interferes with daily functioning. It is not a single disease, but rather a cluster of symptoms affecting the brain. People with dementia may experience memory loss, difficulty in thinking, language problems, and changes in mood and behavior. Dementia is more common in older adults, but it can affect individuals under 65 as well. The symptoms can vary from person to person and an early diagnosis can be the key to effective management in the long run. This severely impacts the quality of life for affected individuals.

In cities like Gurgaon, Delhi NCR, access to healthcare is rapidly booming. With this, long term care is making its own space in the community with Tulasi Healthcare. Through our Dementia treatment clinic in Gurgaon, you can feel your loved ones improve with care and support of our incredible experts.

Risk factors for Dementia

An illness can dawn on anyone, at any time. Such is the cycle of life. But prevention and management falls in our own hands. There are always factors that put us at risk of developing a certain illness. These factors need to be in our knowledge and records for an early diagnosis. Sadly, many of us ignore this crucial step and have to face the consequences in the long run. Similarly for dementia, there can be different risk factors. If identified, they can be managed at the earliest for a better quality of life. Let’s take a look at some of them.

  • Age- Aging is a highly accounted for factor in dementia. It is seen that the likelihood particularly increases after the age of 65. Although, an early onset can also occur.
  • Genetics- Family history is crucial to determining if a person is at a risk of developing dementia. Since it is a condition that causes cognitive degeneration, specific gene mutations are responsible. Specially when it comes to Alzehimer’s the genetic factors are critically involved.
  • Cardiovascular issues- High cholesterol, diabetes and high blood pressure can damage the vessels to the brain. This damage to the blood vessels increases the risk of developing vascular dementia. Taking care and closely monitoring heart health is essential for such individuals.
  • Head trauma- Trauma to the head can result in a multitude of conditions. A severe injury or multiple trauma can result in dementia. Athletes, military veterans, and individuals with a history of accidents are at higher risk.
  • Lifestyle factors- Smoking, excessive alcohol consumption, poor diet, and lack of physical exercise damage heart and brain health in the long run. The results may not be suddenly evident, but can be quite damaging. A sedentary lifestyle and poor nutrition can negatively impact brain health and contribute to cognitive decline.
  • Depression- For older adults, depression can prove to be an issue. It causes mental decline due to existential and stressful issues. Seeking prompt consultation can actually manage depression and reduce risk for dementia.
  • Social isolation- Engaging in social activities, forming relationships, and staying mentally active can reduce the risk of cognitive decline. Adults often find themselves out of place. Without a regular engagement in their community, it may render them prone to isolation.

Symptoms to look for

As a top dementia treatment clinic in Delhi NCR, we feel that psychoeducation plays a huge role in seeking help at the right time. Knowing about a condition can lead to a prompt response or else at least refute any suspicions. Let’s talk about the symptoms in detail-

  • Memory loss- The most marked symptom of dementia is memory loss. Particularly, the short term memory is affected. Individuals may forget recent events, appointments, or conversations. In the later stages, long-term memory may also be affected.
  • Communication problems- It may happen that a person may not be able to find the right words or phrases. They may even forget the topic they were talking about mid conversation. They may also have trouble understanding conversations. As the disease progresses, communication becomes increasingly difficult.
  • Disorientation- People suffering from dementia face disorientation of time, place and people around them. They may feel confused all the time and lead to anxiety and frustration.
  • Mood and personality changes- A significant change takes over the mood and personality of people suffering with dementia. As for the Dementia treatment clinic in Gurgaon, we make keen observations on our clients to understand these symptoms. Mood swings and depersonalization is quite common.
  • Impaired judgement- With disorientation comes problems in judgment. As dementia progresses, individuals may make poor decisions or show a lack of judgment in everyday situations. Personal hygiene, financial decisions and risky behaviors are common examples.
  • Motor coordination issues- This happens particularly in the case of Parkinson’s, where muscular tremors & motor incoordination are quite common.
  • Loss of initiative- People with dementia no longer enjoy activities that they pursued. This can be a hobby or a profession. There is a lack of motivation, looming passivity and withdrawal from social interactions.

Treatment modalities available at our facility

Since there is no cure, management and early intervention strategies have a deep impact on the dementia patients.These methods include medication, therapy, lifestyle changes, and support from healthcare professionals and caregivers. Apart from these, our Tulasi Home is a long term stay home where such conditions are exclusively treated and managed.

  • Medication- Several medications can be used to treat the symptoms of dementia, especially in conditions like Alzheimer’s disease. These medications do not cure dementia but can help improve symptoms or slow down their progression.

– Antipsychotic medications- When clients experience severe behavioral problems such as aggression or hallucinations, antipsychotic medications may be prescribed. These are prescribed cautiously to minimize side effects.

– Antidepressant & Anti Anxiety medications- Depression and anxiety are quite common when it comes to alzehimer’s. Antidepressants and anxiolytics can help alleviate these symptoms, improving mood and overall well-being.

– Glutamate regulators- Glutamate is a chemical involved in learning and memory. With glutamate regulators like Memantine, symptoms of Alzehimer’s can be regulated.

– Cholinesterase inhibitors- Levels of acetylcholine, a neurotransmitter involved in memory and learning, are also responsible for dementia. Drugs like Donepezil, Rivastigmine, and Galantamine increase the levels of acetylcholine and are usually prescribed to increase levels of acetylcholine in the brain.

  • Cognitive Behavioral Therapy–
  • Cognitive stimulation therapy (CST) is one of the commonly applied approaches in dementia treatment. It involves structured activities designed to regulate thinking and improve mental function.Since dementia is a cognitively degenerating condition, behavior therapy is a must. VBT also addresses the emotional and psychological aspects of dementia, improving the individual’s ability to cope with the changes caused by the disease.
  • Supportive and palliative care-
  • Counselling on a regular basis is essential for individuals who suffer from dementia. With our Dementia treatment clinic in Gurgaon, we take special care of a client’s mental and emotional wellbeing. This is necessary because of the constant disorientation and memory issues one faces. Support groups and counseling can help caregivers deal with the challenges of looking after a loved one with dementia.

Psychosocial interventions like counseling and education for family members are essential. These help them understand the disease and develop necessary coping strategies. Many dementia care facilities provide specialized counseling services for caregivers . This is necessary to address emotional strain and reduce the risk of caregiver burnout.

  • Lifestyle Modifications-
  • Even after a confirmed diagnosis, lifestyle plays an essential role in management. As the condition progresses, there are several challenges that can be dealt with just simple yet effective lifestyle modifications.

Physical Activity: Regular physical exercise has been shown to improve cognitive function in the long run. It reduces depression, anxiety and adds to the overall health of the person. Even moderate exercise, such as walking or yoga, can make a significant difference. It may become a saving grace for people at risk of Parkinson’s.

Healthy Diet: A balanced diet rich in antioxidants, vitamins, and omega-3 fatty acids is essential for brain health. A diet that is rich in all these nutrients is a must.

Social Interaction: Encouraging social engagement can help reduce feelings of isolation and improve cognitive function. Activities such as group outings, social clubs, or family gatherings can stimulate the brain and boost mood.

  • Holistic and recreational therapy-
  • Some individuals with dementia may benefit from alternative therapies, such as music therapy, art therapy and mindfulness based meditation sessions. These therapies can provide emotional comfort, reduce anxiety, and improve overall quality of life.

Having these treatment options adds to a variety of therapies that are available at our long term facility Tulasi home. With a 24/7 staff available to cater to every small need of our clients, we are happy and content to care. In Delhi NCR, healthcare facilities are increasingly recognizing the importance of providing comprehensive dementia treatment and we are on the forefront. Through a 360 degree treatment and management plan, we aim to provide the best of our abilities. Since there is no cure for dementia, it is not fully treatable. Although, managing the symptoms is possible. What are the Key Differences Between Inpatient and Outpatient Psychiatric Services?

Comfort and understanding is a big part of any treatment plan, especially when it comes to mental health. Our inpatient and outpatient services programs are designed to keep this comfort of the clients and their families in mind. There can be many situations and circumstances where people might not be able to pursue a fully inpatient or outpatient program. To deal with this, our plans and choices are kept flexible, given the severity of the issue. If the issue is out of control, we suggest inpatient care with informed consent and accommodations.

How do Holistic Development Programs Enhance Mental Wellness?

Treatment of mental health is not just about fixing the physical problems- it is also about dealing with your mental biome and planting seeds of harmony and wellness in it. Holistic healthcare techniques are not just about managing your mental health- they are also a way of life that can be adapted by anyone in the long run. As one of the best psychiatrist in South Delhi, Dr. Gorav Gupta professes the need for adoption of holistic techniques like mindfulness, meditation and yogic practices. How Does a Psychiatrist Support Your Mental Wellness Journey?

At Tulasi, we are all about supporting our clients to embark on a transformational journey. Support is of crucial importance in any treatment plan, especially while pursuing our mental wellbeing. How we approach our treatment plan is beyond the “mainstream” treatment. This is how-

  • – We help you rediscover the purpose and zest of life with psychotherapeutic methods

What Types of Therapies Are Used at Our Psychiatric Facility?

Tulasi healthcare has always prioritized the well being and happiness of its clients in every manner possible. Therapies play a crucial part in treating psychiatric illnesses, along with medication and other holistic techniques. Our team takes pride in being experts of different therapeutic modalities that are employed in curing mental health issues. Let us understand different therapies that our employed at our facility during different treatment plans in many conditions.

Cognitive Behavioral Therapy

CBT is one of the highest employed therapies across a variety of conditions. It works on a simple principle of behavior modification by moulding thought cognition and adjusting maladaptive behaviors. A quite affordable and short term therapy, it has shown efficacy in treating a variety of mental health conditions. Some of the top psychiatrist in Delhi favor the use of this therapy since it shows a true change in the individual within limited sessions. The therapy focuses more on what is the problem currently, rather than what issues have built up to the currency situations. The absolution of the issues in the current scenario is emphasized. Healthy coping mechanisms are professed and taught at a pace where one can manage and channelize them in their life.

Dialectical Behavior Therapy

DBT is used to understand emotional expressions and regulations, and incorporate mindfulness for distress tolerance. Here, the person is taught to identify their emotional triggers, behaviors, self validate and distinguish themselves from the experience of others. This treatment is all about expanding a person’s skills to navigate their thought processes, emotional expressions and coping mechanisms in distressing situations.

Exposure Therapy

Exposure treatment is particularly employed in conditions where a person has undergone abuse, trauma or situations that have produced phobias and terrifying emotional responses on their part. Here, the person is first analyzed and then their triggers are identified. When these triggers are in place, the person is exposed to them under supervision to study their response. This also helps them to familiarize with this fear with repeated exposures and learn different aspects of their emotional response. With such repeated exposures- the client starts to abandon their fear, and adopt rational thinking to counter this behavior.

Mindfulness Based Therapy

Mindfulness based therapies are holistic in nature, bringing the ability to be present and aware of our emotions. Therapists teach the clients ways and manners in which they can draw energy and positivity from their present emotions, and generate coping mechanisms by which they can deal with negative thoughts. Tapping into feelings as they arise, such a technique is instrumental in decreasing and managing symptoms of anxiety, depression and trauma related issues. As one of the best mental health specialist in Mehrauli Delhi recommends, it is one of the highly effective therapies in the space of mental wellness.

Family Therapy

 Family therapy is all about taking care of an individual as a part of the family unit. It is a fact that a person is a part of the family system, and when one part of the system is affected, it ends up pushing the load on others too. The disbalance of harmony can take a toll on the other family members, and healing can become a more complex process. With family therapy, each individual has a chance to respond to the situation and share their issues, and cope with the problem they have faced.

Interpersonal Therapy

There are multiple benefits of seeing a psychiatrist, especially when one can feel stress and other issues build up in their lives. It is just a matter of time after these issues become manifestations and show up in our daily activities.

Will I have to take medication for the rest of my life?

Not necessarily. It truly depends upon the kind of issue you are facing and the severity it presents. Medication may be discontinued in a few months or years if the person shows any improvement, or otherwise stay on it for life.

What do psychiatrists do?

Psychiatrists are medical doctors that help in diagnosing, making treatment plans, and preventing mental health disorders. They work with mental health therapist & clinical psychologist to assess patients' psychological conditions, provide therapy, and prescribe medications. They work with various clients experiencing a variety of issues that can include depression, anxiety, schizophrenia, bipolar disorder & many more issues, offering both short-term and long-term treatment plans to improve mental well-being.

Do psychiatrist do therapy?

Yes, psychiatrists can provide therapy, often called psychotherapy or talk therapy. At Tulasi, we work with one of the best therapist in India to curate an experience for each of our clients. However, some psychiatrists may refer patients to psychologist or mental therapist for more specialized therapy.

Can a psychiatrist prescribe medicine?

Yes. Psychiatrists can prescribe medications since they are medical doctors that have obtained a license from medical authorities. They are licensed to diagnose mental health conditions and offer pharmacological treatments, such as antidepressants, antipsychotics, and mood stabilizers. They tailor medication plans based on the individual's needs, often combining them with therapy to manage conditions. However, a clinical psychologist cannot prescribe them. If you look for an online therapist, or psychiatrist, make sure to keep these points in mind.

What is the difference between a psychologist and a psychiatrist?

Psychologists typically hold a doctoral degree in psychology and focus on therapy and psychological assessments, but they cannot prescribe medication. Psychiatrists often combine medication with treatment, while psychologists primarily use therapy. So if you are searching for a psychologist near me, make sure to keep these points in mind according to your needs.

When to consult a psychiatrist?

Consulting a psychiatrist should not just be limited to an issue. There may be times when one feels lost and without guidance. A psychiatrist can help you with that. They can help you identify your needs and work on your issues with you or refer you to a clinical psychologist or therapist for further evaluation. A psychiatrist in particular can help you if you're experiencing persistent mental health symptoms, such as severe depression, anxiety, mood swings, hallucinations, or thoughts of self-harm.

A psychiatrist helps you diagnose and plan a treatment for your anxiety. They connect you with an anxiety therapist that guides you through the course of treatment. Mental well being is the rock of our existence. It dictates what decisions we make, our behavior and the important aspects that run our life. When this rock loses its hold, everything can seem tumbling down, eroding everything in its wake. Psychological wellness should hold paramount importance in our lives, given the stressors and demands of the sedentary lifestyle we have acquired. Our mental health has the power to make or break our relationships, affect our productivity and severely impact career choices that can set the course of our lives. Functioning well is a part of our role being in the societal setting, and one must know when to seek help.

Living in a city like Faridabad, you can surely understand the toll our environment, society and daily decision making can take on us. It can definitely feel like a stretch, trying to keep up with daily struggles and hassles.   • –Anxiety disorders

Anxiety issues are one of the most common issues that people of all ages and strata experience alike. These are results of going through a certain experience, trauma or abuse. The severity of anxious behaviors define its intensity, which include physical symptoms like sweating, palpitations and shortness of breath and excessive fear and irrational worry when encountering the situation or trigger. These disorders include Generalized Anxiety Disorder, Phobia, panic disorder, social anxiety disorder and many others.

  • –Depressive disorders

Depressive disorders manifest from environmental, situational or genetic etiology and leave a person to fend for themselves. The person cannot seem to gather enough motivation, energy to carry out tasks and remains enthusiastic about their lives while facing depression. Their lives go for a turn when their physical, emotional and occupational areas suffer from the lack of choices and motivation to act. These include major depressive disorder, dysthymia, cyclothymia and many more manifestations. With one of the highest occurrence rates in the world, depression is a highly reported disorder at our mental hospital in Faridabad.

  • –Bipolar disorder

Bipolar disorder consists of a high range of mood swings, where the person experiences a range of emotions within a short span of time, sending their emotional state into turmoil. It can go from a highly energetic mood to a sad and depressive state in minutes, without any apparent and rational cause. This can cause significant distress to them and the people around, affecting their interpersonal as well as occupational interactions. To deal with this management is needed through psychoeducation as well as a rigorous treatment regime.

  • -Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)

PTSD is an acquired disorder, where a person undergoes a severe traumatic condition like an accident, trauma or is a victim of a natural calamity that leaves a dramatic impact on their mental health. When this happens, a slightest trigger can result in a severe reaction and result in a panic attack and other physical symptoms. Symptoms can include flashbacks, nightmares, and severe anxiety. Treatment combines trauma-focused therapy with medication and exposure therapy to alleviate symptoms in the long run.

  • –Obsessive Compulsive Disorder (OCD)

OCD is a behavioral condition where a person feels compelled and obliged to perform a persistent thought that is irrational. They feel that until this thought is acted upon, some problem will arise for them. This maladaptive thought pattern is responsible for posing problems in their daily functioning, since this occupies their mind for the better part of the day. It leaves them unable to perform any task, resulting in losses of many kinds. To tackle this, many brain stimulation techniques as well as a combination of medications and therapies are available at Tulasi.

  • -Eating Disorders

Eating disorders hint towards a psychological problem in mismanagement of a balanced diet, that results in harmful body image issues and an unhealthy body weight. Anorexia and Bulimia nervosa are the two major types of eating disorders that are usually observed. Apart from this, they are also usually observed among young adults and adolescents, so these cases can be quite tricky to understand and manage.

Substance use issues are highly prevalent in Indian society, amongst all strata. Depression is also a highly occurring mental health condition that can manifest as a result of physical issues too. Major depressive disorder and persistent depressive disorder (dysthymia) significantly impact daily life, and decline productivity. Symptoms include feelings of hopelessness and sadness to physical symptoms like changes in sleep and appetite. Our multidisciplinary approach includes psychotherapy, medication management, and lifestyle modifications to aid the client in the long run.

3.Bipolar Disorder

Bipolar disorder is an extreme shift in mood, an emotional state marked by emotional highs (mania or hypomania) and lows (depression). Treatment can usually be tricky and often involves mood stabilizers, psychotherapy, and education about the disorder to help patients manage their symptoms. In many cases, where management is needed, non-traditional brain stimulation therapies provide significant help.

4.Schizophrenia and Psychotic Disorders

Schizophrenia and other psychotic disorders involve a pattern of  distorted thinking and perceptions, including hallucinations and delusions. It can be highly misdiagnosed without expert help and pose a huge threat to normal functioning of an individual. Treatment focuses on antipsychotic medications, therapy, and social support to help individuals cope with the challenges of these conditions.

5.Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)

PTSD is a rising occurrence and can be experienced after witnessing traumatic events that may include physical trauma, abuse or encounter with a natural calamity. Symptoms usually include flashbacks, nightmares, and severe anxiety along with physical manifestations. Treatment often combines trauma-focused therapy with medication to alleviate symptoms.

6.Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD)

OCD is a behavioral condition characterized by intrusive thoughts (obsessions) and repetitive behaviors (compulsions). It can be a challenge for individuals to manage this condition, since it takes a significant level of behavioral restructuring to do so. Treatment usually includes cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), Exposure and Response Therapy (ERP)  and selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs).

7.Eating Disorders

Eating disorders is a belief that renders the individual resolute with beliefs of problematic eating patterns. Anorexia nervosa, Bulimia nervosa, and binge-eating disorder require specialized care, since it severely affects the physical wellbeing of the client. Our hospital offers a structured program that combines nutritional counseling, therapy, and medical monitoring to support recovery.

8.Substance Use Disorders

Substance use disorders are a growing concern amongst every age group across the country. We are a mental hospital in Gurgaon that provides extensive support for individuals struggling with substance use disorders, including alcohol and drug addiction. Our treatment plans are tailored to the individual and include detoxification, rehabilitation, holistic care regime and ongoing support through counseling and support groups.

9.Personality Disorders

Personality disorders are issues with changing personality patterns, remaining inconsistent with the person’s actions. Disorders such as borderline personality disorder and narcissistic personality disorder, affect how individuals think and interact with others. Treatment and management can be hard to navigate, but usually involves psychotherapy, and in some cases, medication to address specific symptoms.

10.Developmental Disorders

Developmental issues carry a variety of aspects with it, with each case different from the other due to their manifestation. Conditions like autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) require unique approaches. Our team offers assessments and therapies designed to support individuals and their families in navigating these challenges

What to Expect During your Initial Consultation?

As one of the top psychiatric hospital in Gurgaon, we are dedicated to present and provide the best of our services. Visiting a psychiatric hospital for the first time can be unnerving, attracting feelings of judgment and an unsettling mindset. Knowing what to expect can ease your concerns and help you prepare for your consultation. Here’s a guide to the process:

1.Initial Contact with staff

Upon reaching out, you will likely be speaking with a staff member who will gather some basic information about your mental health history, current symptoms, and any previous treatments. This initial conversation helps us understand your needs and plan your visit. Here, most of your information will be collected to generate a general sense of the situation and assess your problem.

2.The Consultation

During your consultation, you will be introduced to a psychiatrist or mental health professional that specializes with the concern or issue best described by your symptoms. This session typically lasts 60-90 minutes. You’ll discuss your symptoms, personal history, and any specific concerns. It’s essential to be open and honest to receive the best care.

3.Assessments

As part of your consultation, it is essential to conduct psychological assessments or questionnaires to evaluate your mental health more comprehensively. It helps us identify the priority issues, and the underlying conditions manifesting with it. These assessments help us identify specific areas of concern and determine the best course of action.

4.Treatment Plan

Based on a thorough evaluation, the psychiatrist will discuss potential treatment options with you. This may include therapy, medication, or lifestyle changes. You will have the opportunity to ask questions and express any concerns about the proposed plan, and generate a timeline where you will set your goals and follow through with them in that given time frame.

5.Follow-Up

After your initial consultation, you may be scheduled for follow-up appointments. Ongoing support is crucial for effective treatment. Our team will work with you to monitor your progress and adjust your treatment plan as necessary.

How to access the best mental health facilities & services?

These days, it is all about having a goal, insight and necessary help. These are the basic requirements that can lead you towards the best of mental health services in no time. Many people these days struggle to find the right match for themselves, even when they have all kinds of resources available with them.

At Tulasi, we explore every treatment option with an open mind. Our team of expert professionals make sure that every individual is in a position to access the best for themselves. These days, it is not about having the best resources- but being in safe hands matters more. When it comes to some of the best mental health facilities and services, Tulasi Health Care is a name that stands at the top.

At the end of the wellness journey, it’s all about the support, resources and aftercare that one receives. The structure that is maintained by a caregiver builds the life of an individual in the times to come. This structure proves to be their backbone, the way in which they maintain sobriety and a good perspective towards life.

Searching up ‘mental hospitals near me’? We’re the answer

It is certainly not easy to go out and explore what can be the best answer to your mental health problems, let alone asking for help. The fear of being judged, misinterpreted and let down is always looming on one’s mind. To tackle this, Tulasi health care ensures its clients that during their treatment, they can be carefree and focused to become the best version of themselves, and we are their cheerleaders in the process.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

FAQ'S

Does a psychiatric hospital treat emergency cases?

Yes, Tulasi healthcare is a mental hospital in gurgaon that is open 24/7 to tackle emergency cases and handle any kind of situation that is presented. Along with our regular support and treatment, we also provide long term treatment plans to our clients.

How long is one required to stay in a psychiatric hospital?

This truly depends on the severity and the condition that the client is struggling with. If the condition is fairly new and manageable, the visit can be short or not even required. But for more complex and intricate cases, this visit may last from a few months to even a year.

Will my treatment be kept confidential?

Yes, according to the code of ethics, patient-clinician information is kept confidential, and a specific non-disclosure agreement is kept in place to protect the interests of the clients.

With a broadened ability for consultation in both online and offline mode, we can see a large surge in the number of people who are actively seeking help for therapy and counseling. What are the Reasons to Approach a Psychologist in Gurgaon?

There can be many reasons why you can approach a psychologist. It can be a simple discussion about your lives, or a situation where you are in dire need of support and guidance. A psychologist is not just a person that can interact with you in times of need- they can also be a channel of personal development and preventive practices to keep your mental health in check.

To Improve Your Life and Well Being

As we said, connecting with a psychologist is not just about curing or treating a mental health condition, it is also about preventing it and taking necessary measures. The greatest answer to taking care of ourselves is knowing about our strengths and vulnerabilities and acting on them. Therapy and counseling empowers us to handle the present and future situations with ease and support. This is a practice that can transform our lives for the better as well as change our perspective positively.

Lack of Productivity and Motivation

All of us are a part of a life cycle that emphasizes on the presence of a career, being motivated and productive at all times. Sometimes, this practice becomes a hassle and can lead us to the verge of burnout. This reduces our productivity output in every aspect of our life quite drastically. This is something that can happen to the best of us, and there is no harm in looking for a way out. A simple search for ‘a psychologist near me’ can lead you to a conversation of a lifetime.

Feelings of Emotional Distress

There are many instances in life when one might feel overwhelmed. Emotions can sometimes bring out the worst of us, and make us feel out of control. If you are feeling significant mood changes in your daily expression and feel that you are unable to cope with the necessary demands, emotional distress is a trigger waiting to be pulled. Sometimes, we just lack insight into our situation, and that is where a psychologist can be of huge help to our cause.

Social Withdrawal

Humans are social animals. We cannot survive without social interactions. Interpersonal interactions are important for our well being, given that we build our perceptions and cognitive abilities through these. So, if such issues begin without any cause and this seems like a shift from your usual activities and thinking, consulting a psychologist can be quite helpful. A therapeutic alliance can help you understand your concerns and reintroduce you back to society.

Recovering from a Traumatic Experience

We all have our certain instances in our lives where we go through the trauma of losing a loved one, separation or being a victim of abuse or a natural calamity. These situations can leave a long lasting impact on our minds, which seldom shape our responses and force us to build a maladaptive behavior or response. To tackle this, a psychologist in Gurgaon can apply various tools and techniques that can alleviate the stress, anxiety and depression repressed by such trauma.

Inability to Function

Psychological issues can hamper our ability to function on a higher level. Missing out on deadlines, feeling demotivated and inability to focus on our goals can be highly impactful for our growth in the long run. If this pattern continues to result, it is a good option to approach a psychologist and gather consultation. It will help you identify the root causes and the reasons due to which these behaviors result and resolve them from the core.

Diagnosis of a Mental health Issue

There are many symptoms and precursors that are usually disregarded as normal issues that develop to form psychological disorders. When things feel out of place and you think you need to understand such sudden developments, it may be time to get a formal diagnosis. A psychologist can help you in assessing and diagnosing your symptoms formally and build a therapeutic treatment plan.

Relationship Issues

As life progresses, we build many relationships around ourselves that are very important to us. Sometimes, due to lack of effort and misunderstandings, there can be issues that can blow out of proportion and create problems in communicating properly. Here, the role of a psychologist is crucial. They can help you by maintaining a neutral stance, understand the core issue and apply therapies and strategies that can be beneficial for your interpersonal growth.

What Do The Numbers Say

According to the statistics broadcasted by the World Health Organization, India is in a dire state of deficit in terms of psychologists. There are only 0.07 psychologists available for 100,000 people. This number speaks volumes in account of growing mental health concerns. 60-70 million people in India are suffering from mental health conditions, and most of them are unable to access the resources due to lack of awareness and brewing stigma. Tulasi Healthcare has biggest team of psychologist in Gurgaon.

Psychologist vs Psychiatrist : Roles and Right Fit For You

Psychologists and psychiatrists are the core roles of the mental health fraternity. Psychologists do focus on the therapeutic aspects of mental health, meanwhile a psychiatrist is trained in medical aspects and can also prescribe medications to handle and treat a specific condition.

To understand the difference between a psychologist and psychiatrist, a simple classification is described here-

  • Psychologist– A psychologist is focused on providing assessment and treatment through various tools and therapies, where the main emphasis remains on using therapeutic approach as the central tool for producing extensive results. Psychologists are extensively trained in providing therapy and handling various psychological problems through counseling and psychotherapies. They cannot, however, prescribe medications to clients. So, they work in close synergy with psychiatrists to enable the clients to access holistic mental health care plans. If you look for a ‘psychologist near me’, you will find a team of mental health professionals working together under one roof to build strategies and management plans for their clients. SInce every single professional brings a certain skill to the table, they are able to do justice to their client’s issues.
  • Psychiatrist– A psychiatrist is a medically trained professional who specializes in treating mental health conditions. The treatment involves psychopharmacological intervention along with a combination of therapeutic modalities. Since a medical professional is involved, non-traditional therapies like brain stimulation techniques can also be performed and prescribed. Some of the best psychiatrists in India truly immerse themselves in these techniques and try to find the right combination of treatment plans for their clients.

Dr. Gorav Gupta is one such name in the medical fraternity who is dedicated to providing the highest level of healthcare to clients from all over India. With his expertise in dealing with multiple psychological and chronic disorders, he has made his significant space as one of the best psychiatrists in Delhi.

What Evaluations and Therapies are Provided by Psychologists?

With an extensive training in many aspects of mental issues, a psychologist can assess the following areas to find out the true diagnosis and underlying issues-

  • – Intellectual skills and level
  • – Personality traits
  • – Cognitive & emotional level of processing
  • – Vocational preferences
  • – Psychomotor evaluation

Apart from these, there are various subtests that a psychologist employs that are related to the specific condition that their symptoms are indicative to. After a proper diagnosis is made, there are many therapies that can be employed for certain periods of time to assess their effect on the client’s condition. These therapies include-

Cognitive Behavioral Therapy

CBT is a structure oriented and talk therapy based upon changing the negative thought patterns and cognition to achieve the gradual removal of the maladaptive behavior of an individual. It is also very helpful in managing non-psychological and chronic conditions like pain management and insomnia.

Dialectical Behavior Therapy

It is a type of talk therapy where people learn to manage their emotions and generate positive behavioral patterns. It is based on the principle of acceptance of countering thoughts, where two things that are arising in our minds at the same time, but both of them stand true in their respective places. Sometimes, we have issues accepting them which leads to a series of psychologically harmful issues.

Interpersonal Therapy

IPT is based on the principle that our issues arise as a result of a maladaptive pattern that exists in our interpersonal relationships. So, IPT relieves such issues by improving our interpersonal issues through a series of activities and exercises. It can be of great help in resolving issues with family as well as romantic relationships.

Group Therapy

A group therapy is a form of psychotherapy where a psychologist gathers a small group of clients together and facilitates a conversion where they can share their common concerns and attain feedback and insights into their own issue. The common denominator here is that all the clients suffer from the same condition and agree to connect with others and voice their problems.

Family Therapy

Family therapy, as the name suggests, is focused upon the family systems and the role they play in the client’s life. These family systems contain an imbalance of some sort that affects one person more than the other and produces a rift in the family. Through family therapy, clients can bring our their problems and these issues can be mediated with a series of conversations.

What issues Can a Psychologist Solve For Me?

There are many cognitive, emotional and behavioral issues that a psychologist can mediate and solve for their clients. Some of these issues include-

  • -Substance use disorders
  • –Anxiety
  • –Depression
  • -Stress and related conditions
  • -Eating disorders
  • -Management of chronic illnesses
  • -Family and relationship issues
  • -Dealing with abuse and trauma
  • -Problems with productivity and performance
  • -Grief and loss of a loved one
  • -Phobias
  • -Managing unhealthy habits
  • -Issues with self-confidence and self doubt
  • -Sexual Disorders

How can I Find a Good Clinical Psychologist Near Me?

While it can be quite overwhelming to seek help from a psychologist, it is necessary that you do. A psychologist will not only help you identify your issues, but also provide a way out of them. Sometimes, we lose track of our well being and it costs us in the long run. With Tulasi Healthcare, you can be assured of the fact that you are under the right guidance and safe premises of some of the highly qualified and trusted psychologists in India. To know if we can be your partners in the journey of mental well-being, come and witness the magic of transformation at our facility today.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

FAQ's

When should I consult a psychologist?

A psychologist can be consulted, even when you feel a little bit out about your mental well-being. If you feel discomfort about your own functions, or feel burnt out or disturbed from your life issues, or just simply want to have a chat about your life – it is okay to consult a psychiatrist. A psychologist is a preventive measure, not a performative one.

How can I contact the best psychologist in Gurgaon?

The best psychologist in Gurgaon can be contacted via online and off-line methods. A good psychologist always has their services open in multiple methods where they can actually help people out. So you can connect with them in online, off-line methods according to your convenience.

What is the difference between a psychologist and a psychiatrist?

There is only one certain difference between a psychiatrist and a psychologist. A psychiatrist is a medically accredited professional who can prescribe drugs and medicines to individuals. And psychologist however, can only provide counselling and directive therapeutic support.

What issues can a psychologist help me with?

A psychologist can help you with the variety of issues like anxiety, depression, bipolar disorder, and psychotic and mood conditions. They can also assist you with rehabilitative and therapeutic support in many cases.

Do you offer online therapy sessions in Gurgaon?

Yes, we offer online therapy sessions in Gurgaon at the convenience of the client. People can book online sessions with us whenever they feel comfortable to connect.

Why should you consult a psychologist?

There are many reasons you can consult a psychologist. From daily burnouts to specific problems like anxiety, depression, you can connect with a psychologist and get guidance and therapy based on your concerns.

Can I consult a psychologist online?

Yes, you can consult an online psychologist according to your convenience and comfort. Book a session online Any time and find your consultation with your best match.

Can I do online therapy sessions instead of in person sessions?

Yes, it is totally possible to do so. This is because some people do not find comfort in direct consultations at first. In order to find comfort and see your best match, you can connect for online consultations first and then switch to in person, according to your convenience.

What type of psychologist helps with mental health?

Every type of psychologist has a different kind of concern that they deal with. You can connect with a psychologist who has expertise in your particular area of interest and have a session with them.

Overcoming Addiction With Best Rehabilitation Centre in Imphal

Addiction can become a lifelong problem- unless we are aware of its repercussions on a personal level. With addiction, we lose our ability to perceive, communicate and make the right decisions for ourselves and our loved ones. Our lives are highly affected by our addictive habits, and this not only deteriorates us physically, but also on a mental level. Within a state like Manipur, people are engaged in earning an honest living- farming, agriculture and traditional crafts. But when things go downhill, anyone can turn towards substances to stray away from their problems for a while. This is where Tulasi Healthcare steps in with its expertise.

Prevalence in the Area

Many studies have pointed towards the rise in consuming different substances across the state. The most common substance abused is Heroin (54.3%), followed by pharmaceutical opioids and methamphetamine. Cannabis, sedatives and inhalants were also very popular amongst the youngsters. A poly drug use trend was also noticed, which means the users were actively using 2 or more substances at the same time. This could cause serious health concerns for the user.

Our Vision at Tulasi Healthcare

Motivation, education and holistic support are an integral part of our plan that aims to bring a transformation in the lives of our clients.

 Holistic methods of healing are a major part of therapeutic intervention, which focuses on an overall upliftment of the client. Understanding our client’s needs stands foremost in our list of priorities.Insight development is an integral part of our value system since without it, treatment is not as effective as it should be. Promoting awareness,  we aim to reduce the stigma that surrounds seeking help.

Services at our Rehabilitation Centre in Imphal

  • Individual counseling– Assessing the client’s immediate issues is only possible when personalized attention is given with individual counseling. It is a great way by which the client can make a resolution and work towards it.Various dynamics of a client’s problem are revealed and this can help in forming a suitable treatment regime for them. Working on a diversified population, our experts are nothing short of producing a transformation in the client’s mindset.
  • Psychiatric care-With a high rate of diagnosis, you find the best compatibility with assessment methods, diagnostic tools and intervention strategies to help the clients reveal the roots of their problems. Our chronic care home is another facility that is very effective for clients with long-term psychiatric issues.
  • De-addiction care– Our leading rehabilitation centre in Imphal makes sure to equip itself with every resource to deal with the rough patches of treatment. We value moral and medical support. This helps the clients to overcome the mindset of failure. Our team of experts is highly experienced in dealing with addictions like Marijuana, Alcohol, drug, smoking, cocaine, heroine etc. .
  • Rehabilitation services– Our psychiatric intervention strategies are built on the principle of holistic and psychological management. We employ therapeutic interventions like Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, Family therapy, Motivation Enhancement Therapy etc. . Our goal is to remove addiction from the core level and foster responsibility.
  • Relapse Prevention– Relapse is a matter of concern, especially after a rigorous rehab. As a top rehabilitation centre in Imphal, we are keenly involved in making strategies that can encounter every textbook scenario that comes with the problem of addiction. Our  prevention program restructures the client’s mindset in a manner that they understand the repercussions of their actions.
  • Holistic activities– Holistic activities like therapy, group support, yoga, meditation and mindfulness produce a positive outcome on an overall level. Our visiting experts are highly trained in a particular activity and facilitate an environment that strengthens them to their core and keeps their motivation intact.

Why choose Tulasi healthcare as your treatment partner?

  • Personalized Approach– Every person brings their own set of problems and concerns to deal with. At Tulasi, our values indicate a personal touch since it is in the best interest of our clients. They get to draw maximum benefits in that manner and an increased level of motivation to lead a transformative life.
  • Unconditional support– Unconditional support is an integral part of pursuing treatment. An environment free of judgment and filled with support helps clients regain their confidence easily.
  • Esteemed quality standards– Our neuromodulation lab takes the  standard of our facilities up a notch. Our estate is adorned with a pious and scenic environment to help clients imbibe its positivity.
  • Aftercare support– Aftercare is necessary to keep a track of the client’s issues and progress in the long run. We have a dedicated team handling clients in their aftercare program.

Looking for support? We’re here to help.

Rehabilitation is a serious concern, even when it is to be done in the starting stages of addiction. Removing a toxic substance from one’s body is a task in itself, and it should come with the best support anyone has to offer. With our rehabilitation centre in Imphal, we aim to build a facility that is a haven of support, motivation and transformation. Our team of experts is trained in many respects to handle all the scenarios and difficulties your loved one might face during their treatment.

To know more about how we can help your loved ones fight their problem of addiction, make sure to visit our rehab centre and sit with our counselors to explore the best methods of treatment, recovery and aftercare today.

FAQs

Can we overcome addiction without rehab?

There are very slim chances that a person can overcome addiction without rehabilitation. Addiction is an uncontrolled action, where the client loses all rationality and pursues the substance to damage their body.

How long is durg and alcohol rehabilitation duration?

The duration of a client's stay depends upon the severity of their problem. Usually, the stay can range from 30, 60 to 90 days.

Should I get inpatient or outpatient treatment?

You can ask your healthcare provider and consult them for information on both the programs and they can suggest the right program based on their assessment and diagnosis.

contentHtml:
Find the right balance of treatment and management for your OCD

Knowing Obsessive Compulsive Disorder

Related to unwanted thoughts and obsessions of irrational origin, Obsessive Compulsive Disorder can cause disruptions in the daily lives and activities of an individual rendering them unable to carry on a fulfilling life. Such people might get intrusive thoughts that may be unrelated to their lives, and the urge to carry on these thoughts. This disorder is often related with anxiety issues, which in principle is correct given its anxiety inducing nature. 

OCD may be triggered by a combination of certain factors, but there is no clear cause why the condition exists. Three major contributors are-

  • -Imbalance in neurotransmitters
  • -Genetic mapping
  • -Stress, Anxiety and Situational factors.

As one of the best OCD treatments in India, our plan at Tulasi healthcare is to identify the right cause and build a regime that sets you back on the path of wellness and transformation.

Risk factors in OCD

The risk of incidence is more in the females for OCD than males, and the onset is usually between adolescence to late adulthood. A list of common risk factors is included here-

  • – A parent or sibling with OCD
  • – Physical differences in brain structure
  • – Experience of past trauma and abuse
  • – History of anxiety, depression and ticks

Common types of OCD

OCD can manifest in some common themes, which are discussed below-

  • 1.)Checking– The constant worry that you might have left something unattended and suspicions about completing a certain task remain. It can lead to the thoughts that something bad might happen.
  • 2.)Contamination– The fear of getting your surroundings contaminated and the compulsion of cleaning is one of the most common types of OCD.
  • 3.)Symmetry and Ordering– The intrusive thought of lining up things in a certain order or symmetry is also a common type of OCD.
  • 4.)Rumination– Thinking aggressively on a line of thought is called rumination. The thoughts can be violent and this type of OCD can also be very harmful for the people surrounding the ones with it.

Treatment options for OCD

To find the best OCD treatment in India, you need not look elsewhere. When you find a facility that combines different methods of treatment under one roof to bring the personalized approach, Tulasi Healthcare is your best bet. Our brain stimulation lab is a state of the art establishment that is actively involved in producing the best results with non-invasive stimulation methods. Our team is also intellectually stimulated to know the latest advancements in the field to bring the best of wellness and recovery to our clients. Let’s discuss some of the highly revered methods for treating OCD in India as recommended by the best psychiatrists in the country.

-Cognitive Behavioral Therapy– One of the highest employed psychotherapeutic approaches in the field of psychology, CBT identifies the negative thought patterns and builds a form of active behavioral pattern to sustain the transformation from negative to positive thoughts. It involves a series of conversations, insight formation and activities to facilitate the transition.

-Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy– A form of CBT, ERP therapy deploys the principle of CBT to change the ritualistic behavior and thought patterns through a series of planned and strategically built activities. According to many credible sources, a combination of ERP and medications (SSRIs) is effective for over 70% of clients.

-Acceptance and Commitment Therapy– ACT is also a highly proven therapeutic intervention for OCD. Its growing popularity lies in its basic ideology- acceptance of the issue and committing to resolving it through active efforts and insight. This therapy changes the dynamics of the person with obsessions and intrusive thoughts, addresses dynamics of psychological flexibility and aims to build a wide range of responses towards the feared stimulus for better adaptation. With an emphasis on willingness to accept, it is one of the best OCD treatments in India with our team of expertly trained professionals.

-Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation– TMS is a revolutionary treatment for OCD. When other treatment methods do not produce a significant result, TMS is a viable option to look for improvement in the client’s condition. The magnetic field created through the coils is targeted towards the brain structures responsible for the different mental health conditions. rTMS and dTMS are different forms of simulations but with a specific difference in their workings. rTMS is more traditional in nature with a narrow range of activation, but its effect kicks in with repeated efforts. Deep TMS on the other hand is of high efficacy since it manages to reach the deeper parts of the brain and produce significant results with minimal exposures. Both the methods are safe to use with minimal side effects. Since it is cleared by the FDA board, the method is quite popular amongst the medical professionals for its high efficacy and result-oriented approach.

-Medication– Medicinal intervention is a necessary step to aid the other methods of therapeutic treatments in OCD. Since OCD is attributed to imbalance of neurotransmitters, SSRIs and SNRIs are deployed for management. Looking at the best OCD treatment in India, some of the best psychiatrists in India curate these plans and personalize them according to the client’s condition.

Some of the common medications that are prescribed for the treatment of OCD include-

–  Citalopram

– Escitalopram

– Fluoxetine

– Fluvoxamine

– Paroxetine

– Sertraline

These medications may take at least 2-4 months to start showing their effects, although the timing may vary from client to client. In case not much improvement is seen, antipsychotics like Aripiprazole and Risperidone might also be prescribed. If the client is suffering from a case of severe OCD, the management can result in lifelong use of medication along with brain stimulation techniques.

-Holistic management- Holistic methods for management of OCD include mindfulness, meditation and yogic techniques that calm the mind and produce insights into one’s thoughts and behavior. These techniques can help with stressful symptoms of OCD and its long-term management.

Looking for the best OCD treatment in India? Tulasi Healthcare is your destination

OCD can be a debilitating condition, disrupting the wellbeing and growth of an individual in every aspect of their lives. Knowing that the problem exists is the first step towards its resolution and that comes with the development of insight towards the problem. If you feel that you or your loved ones are suffering from this issue and need expert advice to deal with it, we are available for your guidance. Our team of experts is trained to listen, understand and motivate the clients to set their lives on the path of transformation and wellbeing. Connect with us today to plan your journey of happiness and positive development with us.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

FAQ'S

What is the best therapy for OCD?

Cognitive Behavioral therapy and Exposure and Response prevention therapy is considered to be some of the best OCD treatment methods. Apart from these, TMS is also a viable and safe option for pursuing treatment

Can OCD be successfully cured?

Management of a condition like OCD is quite likely rather than its treatment or a cure. Depending upon the severity and intensity of your condition, the treatment can go on for a very long period of time and require a modified management strategy at each stage.

Can OCD be treated without medication?

Yes, depending upon the intensity of the OCD, simply relying on therapeutic methods can be helpful for many individuals. Lifestyle changes can also prove to be highly effective combined with holistic treatment

Mental health, as an area of compass, has lately attracted a lot of attention. still, the challenges related to habitual internal ails still bear further mindfulness and installations. Schizophrenia, bipolar complaint, and major depression are exemplifications of habitual internal ails that can not be effectively treated without long- term interventions.

In similar circumstances, recuperation centres for these diseases come vital as they give cases with acceptable care through integrating medical treatment, cerebral remedy and social support. This paper examines the places, advantages and difficulties involved with recovery centres dealing with habitual internal ails.

Chronic Mental ails An Overview

These last over a long period and frequently need constant operation. They generally enable an individual to perform their diurnal conditioning.

 Schizophrenia: This generally entails visions, visions or indeed, disorganized thinking. Bipolar complaint This sickness involves extreme shifts between manic highs and depressive lows.

Severe Depression: A patient’s feeling of sadness and forlornness is what characterizes this pattern. Compulsive-obsessive complaint It implies having to repeat unwanted studies.

The part of Rehabilitation Centre in the Care of Chronic Mental ails

These recuperation centres are set up to give structured surroundings within which cases can get ongoing backing. These are substantially:

  • Skill Development: To restrict into society and live meetly, life chops, social chops, and vocational chops are part of what recuperation centres educate.
  • Support networks: There’s a need for important support during recovery. Family members are involved in utmost installations in the treatment process, and sessions are fostered among the cases.
  • Holistic approaches: Yoga, contemplation, art remedy, and numerous further holistic practices live in several centres that support heartiness.

Advantages of Rehabilitation Centre

There are several benefits that rehab centres have for individuals with chronic mental disorders:

  • – It is a holistic treatment where medical needs are combined with psychological ones.
  • – The centre provides a well-structured environment that ensures patients do not get involved in any relapse or harm.
  • – Continuous monitoring by professionals helps to evaluate the effectiveness of the treatment plan and consequently make corrections towards it.
  • – These practical skills they learnt to enhance their independence and quality of life.
  • Support from peers: A good centre provides community and support, which adds much to recovery.

Problems Facing Rehab Centre

Whilst these rehabilitation institutions are much-needed sources of help, they also come across numerous challenges, most prominently being:

Psychological Stigma: This is one main reason that can prohibit people from coming out to seek help. Therefore, it will be vital to create awareness amongst the people regarding the rehabilitation process toto gain their trust.

Financial constraints: Most centres suffer from a lack of funds; other times, they are poorly financed; hence, services and facilities fall short.

Distance: People who live far away geographically or because they cannot afford transportation fees.

Personal Attention: All patients have individual needs, thus meaning that personal care cannot be supported while they are hospitalized as a group.

Case Study: A Victory of Rehabilitation

For instance, consider a patient who has been suffering from bipolar disorder and had to be admitted to hospitals repeatedly in the last years because of the devastating effects it had caused in his life. He was given an individual therapy package, medical management package and vocational training at admission into a rehabilitation centre.Gradually, patients began developing coping mechanisms to regain self-confidence and eventually land a job.

This shows that comprehensive rehabilitation can potentially transform people’s lives

Innovations in Rehabilitation

Even mental health rehabilitation centre is changing itself with time. Some of these contemporary innovations are:

Teletherapy: Therapy has become accessible to many through remote sessions.

Peer Support Programs: People use the experiences of those close by who have learnt how to handle their conditions.

Digital Tools: There are mobile apps and web-based platforms that help with both self-management and therapy. 

The Future of Rehabilitation Centre

Indeed, bright prospects await rehabilitation centres for chronic mental illnesses with ongoing efforts to care better. These are:

Integrated Care Models: This involves integrating physical and mental health to meet people’s integral needs.

Community-Based Programs: Such programs shall be invented to enable patients to be cared for while staying near their homes.

Research and Development: Investigation of the invention of new treatments and therapies will undoubtedly increase the potential for recovery or rehabilitation.

Policy Support: This will be an integral component in increasing access to the rehabilitation service by promoting policies that allocate more funds to reduce stigma.

Conclusion

It is given this that rehabilitation centre for chronic mental illness patients are significant in offering the comprehensive as well as continuous care required by such patients. The centres provide medical treatment and therapeutic interventions, offer skill training, and provide a conducive environment that equips patients with more control over their condition to have a satisfying life. Though the challenges in the form of prejudices and lack of funding stay good, innovation and dedication to specific care give a bright outlook to mental health rehabilitation.

Final Thoughts

Though the journey to mental health recovery is usually long and arduous, individuals who have chronic mental illness can be sentenced to have gained much ground towards living better lives. These rehabilitation centre work at the frontline with suitable pools of tools and other resources necessary for empowering patients on their journey towards recovery.

Changes in sleeping patterns- Circadian rhythm can be a huge indicator of mental and physical disturbances that should be dealt with on priority.

Unexplained anxiety or emotions- There may be times that you feel a surge of emotions that are unexplained and unrelated to your current mood or situation. In such a case, you can approach a psychiatrist for consultation.

Considering the severity of mental health issues, it is important that only an expert is involved in its treatment. With some of the top mental health support in India, Tulasi makes it possible for you to expand your horizons and consult with ease and trust.

With a well established facility and proper plan of care and management, psychiatrists serve as catalysts for analyzing the root of complex issues, whether they may be psychological or physical in nature.
