Mental illness is an amalgamation of a variety of factors. These can include issues ranging from emotional, physical to cognitive barriers that hinder daily wellbeing. Even with the use of addictive substances and maladaptive habits, one can be at a big risk.

contentHtml:
Transforming lives with the best rehabilitation centre in Faridabad

People these days are plagued with the stress of demanding lifestyle, pushing them into pursuing habits that are not good for them. Substance and alcohol abuse has been growing multifolds and has a huge impact on the lives of people. This rising use can be attributed to easy availability, flexible regulations and lack of awareness about the demerits of substance use. With so many individuals dependent upon substance use, the responsibility of eradication falls upon Tulasi Healthcare, one of the best rehabilitation centre in Faridabad.

What exactly is substance abuse?

A foreign substance that produces temporary and permanent alterations in the physical and mental dimensions of an individual are known as drugs. It works on the principle of stimulating the brain’s pleasure center and raising the body’s tolerance towards it to procure more and more substance. This dependence turns into a chronic condition and gives rise to substance abuse.

Rehab centers try to break this pattern with medical and therapeutic procedures.

Some of the common substances that are used are listed below-

  • Opioids- These substances numb the sensations in the body and are highly addictive in nature, Their main use in pharmaceutical avenues is as painkillers. Some common opioids are- heroin, codeine, opium, brown sugar and morphine.
  • Depressants- These drugs numb the Central nervous system and slow down cognitive functioning. Some common names are- Alcohol, Benzodiazepines and Cannabis.
  • Stimulants- Quite opposite to depressants, stimulants activate the Central Nervous System. Cocaine, Methamphetamine, Nicotine, Caffeine are all common examples of stimulants.
  • Hallucinogens- As per its name, this substance produces hallucinations and alters an individual’s perception of reality. The users feel very euphoric after consuming this drug and raise the level of anxiety and aggressiveness. LSD, Ketamine, magic mushrooms, PCP fall under this category.
  • Inhalants- Consumed through fumes or vapors, these substances produce a short ‘high’ when inhaled. The person needs to consume a good amount to see its effects. Paint thinners, correction fluid, petrol fumes, nitrous oxide are some commonly used inhalants.
  • Cannabis- Harboring most abusers after cocaine and nicotine, cannabis is a plant based substance that can be consumed through fumes or edibles. It also produces an intense euphoric sensation. Hash, charas, bhang are some common cannabis based products.

Symptoms of Substance Abuse

When an individual is stricken with the problem of substance abuse, they exhibit several signs that can be good indicators of impending issues. Some of these symptoms are-

  • Frequent use, multiple times in a day
  • Inability to separate from the substance
  • Experiencing withdrawal symptoms like shivers, anxiety and restlessness when not in use
  • Having problems on personal, professional and occupational fronts.
  • Financially draining all resources to procure the substance
  • Able to perform activities only under the influence

Factors responsible for growing drug addiction

Certain factors are highly responsible for adding to factors of developing substance abuse.As a responsible rehab center, psychoeducation is a necessity for both the clients and their family members to facilitate a transformative journey. These crucial factors are listed here-

  • Biological factors- Genetic vulnerabilities contribute highly to the acquiring and developing drug addiction. Ethnic vulnerability, gender and presence of previous mental disorders are also responsible.
  • Environmental factors- Activities that trigger the use of illegal substances include- abuse (verbal or physical), personal guidance, misguidance due to disturbed family, prolonged stress are some examples.
  • Developmental factors- Young adults are highly prone to addictive habits, since they are still developing their levels of cognition, thinking and memory

Treatment Approaches our Rehabilitation Facility

At Tulasi Healthcare, we believe in the fact that every individual deserves a care plan that is tailored to their specific needs. Displaying our concise care plan, we follow these steps with a bigger perspective to ensure proper support.

  • For a smooth insight development and planned healthcare plan, an in depth counseling and check is done
  • Medically assisted detoxification and mental support- this boosts the rehabilitation procedure and acts as a catalyst to facilitate better recovery.
  • therapeutic approach (12 step therapy)- a scientifically backed procedure to lighten the effects of rehabilitation and restore functioning.
  • Recovery promotion with behavioral transformation techniques like Cognitive Behavior Therapy (CBT), Rational Emotive Behavior Therapy (REBT) and other solution focused therapies prescribed according to the client’s condition and needs.
  • Holistic treatment approaches like meditation, mindfulness practices and yoga with recreational activities to promote an overall well being
  • Psychoeducation to every individual involved to promote recovery.

Occupational therapy with rehabilitation to reintroduce skills and bring a transformation into their lives..

Why Choose Tulasi Healthcare?

As a state of the art neuro-psycho-social rehabilitation centre in Faridabad, let’s explore why Tulasi Healthcare should be your choice to start your rehab journey..

  • Facilitated by Industry experts- Founded by Dr. Gorav Gupta, a pioneer in the field, Tulasi Healthcare is composed of  a team of 100+ experts in different areas along with  psychiatrists to cater to every need of the clients.
  • 24/7 support availability- With care extending beyond hours, our support system is available round the clock for our clients, both in-patient, out-patient and emergency clients.
  • Customized treatment plans- Tulasi Healthcare keeps the wellbeing of our clients as our priority, and comfort with customized treatment plans promotes a better recovery rate.
  • Psychotherapy support- Our skilled team is truly trained to provide the best psychotherapeutic interventions. With highly accredited credentials, we are proud to boast extraordinary psychotherapy support.
  • Aftercare support- Aftercare is necessary to maintain and analyze the impact of our treatment plans. We offer extensive after treatment support to all our clients and administer relapse prevention techniques.

Choosing to transform? We’re here to help.

Identifying and managing triggers becomes easier with the guidance of experts around you. As one of the best rehabilitation center in Faridabad, we are proud to help over 2 lakh clients in our lifetime and procure over 100+ experts in the mental health sector. A balanced life is a must, and enduring problems is just another part of it. But when self inflicted pain comes to light, it is not always easy to accept it. Substance abuse is one of those self inflicted issues that is chronic in nature and is very hard to manage. At Tulasi Healthcare, we are inclined to restore the balance in your life and guide you towards the positive transformation of your life with the best holistic and psychopharmacological management strategies.

Factors responsible for growing drug addiction

Multiple factors are responsible for the problems to surface. There are many situational and predispositional factors that play a part in converting maladaptive habits to abuse. Most cases range within a combination of these. These crucial points are listed here-

  • Biological factors- Genetic predispositions are highly responsible for developing substance abuse and its related disorders. Ethnic factors, gender vulnerability and presence of mental disorders also weigh in significantly.
  • Environmental factors- Different situations within the family and society along with a disturbed interpersonal environment also triggers substance abuse- physical/verbal abuse, loss of a loved one, prolonged stress are some examples.
  • Developmental factors- Cognition, thinking and memory develop during the early years. Young adults tend to tamper with such substances usually when they are curious, meddling with their development that paves way to addiction.

Why do people consume drugs- even after knowing its consequences?

It has often been a question- why can’t I control myself OR why can’t you control yourself?

It is not just about the surge of happiness that these substances provide the users, but also the dependency that comes with it. The brain’s reward center is highly impacted by the surge of these substances in the body. It releases dopamine, which fills the mind with pleasure. Thus, the motivation to repeatedly perform these pleasure giving acts sets in, leading to addiction.

With time, small rushes of dopamine don’t affect the body since the body is used to a higher dosage. So, the use of the substance only grows with time, until intervention.

This is where rehab centers come into place. Through the detoxification process, this ‘dependency’ is removed with medications and a 12-step rehabilitation process that is necessary to transform the individual. It is a second chance at life, and we respect your willingness and rigor to embark and continue this journey at your best capacity. Our aftercare programs are meant to  provide the necessary support, education and help that is needed to continue a healthy lifestyle.
  • Community reintegration- reintegration into the society is a challenge for many clients post rehab. Empowering the clients with skills that are necessary to survive in the community and draw benefits to sustain life are necessary to teach. Clients are seldom lost in their own well being when they are in rehabilitation and this is where our community programs are a leisurely yet a strong way to help them get back on their path to success along with their recovery.

FAQ's

This is description

What is the purpose of rehabilitation centers?

The purpose of a rehabilitation center is to restore the people who are grappled by addiction back to their normal lives. This includes a variety of treatments and therapies. The clients can find a will to live and lose the maladaptive ways of life.

What does rehabilitation involve?

The process of rehabilitation involves building the body’s strength both mentally and physically, relearning functioning skills and going back to the society as a responsible and sober citizen.

What is the most difficult part of the rehabilitation process?

The most difficult part of the rehabilitation process is usually the detoxification process. As it involves removing the toxins from the body through medical assistance, it is definitely a crucial step to identify the willingness of the client to gain benefits from rehabilitation.

Which patients need rehabilitation?

The patients who have lost the capacity to function on the most basic level and perform their own tasks require urgent rehabilitation. Clients that have developed an insight and want to leave their maladaptive ways of addiction are also eligible to seek rehabilitation.

What is behavioral addiction?

Addictions are not only based on the consumption of a substance, but can also be related to a process or a behavior that the person is obsessed with and maladaptive to their daily life. This is known as behavioral addiction. It is also similar to substance addiction, creating a stressful environment and dependence upon others for fulfilling the daily tasks. Since the person’s thoughts and cognition are actively focused on such behavior, they cannot concentrate on their familial, social and occupational duties leading to a maladaptive lifestyle. Some common examples of behavioral addiction include gambling, gaming, surfing the internet etc.

How to identify the symptoms of behavioral addiction?

Addictive behavior may sometimes need a sharp eye to spot, since it brews within a certain span of time and may be observed as a regular occurrence. However, these mentioned symptoms may help you identify when it is high time to consult an expert. - Denying the existence of any such “behavioral pattern” when pointed out - Spending a hefty amount of time engaging in the mentioned behavior - Losing track of time, orientation and place while engaging in the behavior - Having trouble separating from the behavior when needed to - Feeling that the thoughts, actions and activities of the person circle around and focus on that particular behavior - Feeling symptoms of withdrawal (restlessness, anxiety and irritability) when barred from performing the behavior. - Neglecting every other aspect of life - Downplaying or denying the problem or behavior overdo Impact of behavioral addiction- Behavioral addictions can also be recognized as compulsive behaviors, but they need not generally be bound to unfold so quickly. They take hold quite aggressively, and render the person unable to function on important tasks.Suffering losses and interpersonal conflicts becomes a part of their life, and they can do very little to manage this. They are surely affected by it, but their addiction to their behaviors leaves little room for any kind of introspection. In such cases it is the efforts and keen insight of the family and close confidants of the person that lead to the diagnosis and access to a treatment facility.

What are the most common forms of behavior addiction?

According to DSM-5, only gambling addiction is classified as a behavioral addiction, but certain other behaviors are also found more commonly amongst the cases. These commonly include- - Exercise addiction - Eating addiction - Internet addiction - Relationship/love addiction - Tattoo addiction - Video game addiction - Work addiction - Sexual addiction - Thrill seeking addiction/ adrenaline rush Many such other addictions related to any certain behavior can occur. These may also be differentiated into OCD and other related disorders categories.

What are the common treatment methods for behavioral addiction?

Since it is a behavioral aspect that needs to be tackled, some therapeutic methods fit perfectly to its treatment regime. The methods include- - Cognitive Behavioral Therapy - Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy - Group therapy - Medication based intervention - Individualized counseling - Self help and support groups To understand the deeper meaning and issues that lie behind the problem of behavioral addiction, you can connect with our team of experts that can help you navigate the issue and provide the best professional guidance possible in the industry.

Internship Opportunities At Tulasi Healthcare

Tulasi Healthcare is a pioneer in the Rehabilitation network, providing holistic treatment modalities in every aspect of psychological, psycho-somatic and psychiatric disorders. Driving our expertise our founder Dr. Gorav Gupta is a psychiatrist with 20+ years of experience in the industry, dealing with a variety of disorders. With our patient centric approach, we’re inclined at providing value to our clients through a variety of staff specializing in specific modalities that provide care in the best manner possible.

Our medicinal treatment along with psychological interventions are focused at tailoring the treatment according to the client’s needs and requirements.

Guidance- at a glance

During the internship program, the trainees will be exposed to the following aspects-

  • Focused on helping the trainees grasp a practical understanding on the ethics of clinical psychology and management practices.
  • Hands-on training with a mentor providing in-depth training in History taking, Mental Status Examination (MSE), differential diagnosis of a variety of disorders and related outcomes.
  • Exposure to psychometric testing modalities with diagnostic procedures and management planning.
  • Imparting knowledge of holistic care systems and therapeutic modalities required to handle clients.
  • Understand different theoretical concepts through real life examples and provide insight to develop a skill set.
  • In-depth analysis and testing of concepts by the mentor to enhance problem-solving experience.
  • Work and conceptualize biopsychosocial aspects of intervention.
  • Develop empathy, reflection and interpersonal skills..

Eligibility Criteria

The candidates should be pursuing masters in clinical psychology and have knowledge of basic concepts of the field.

The students should be well-versed in concepts and active communication practices.

Current Intake

The current intake is limited to 10 students in the facility, which is strictly based on the students application timeline and eligibility.

Training Period

The training period for this internship is 1 month. (On-site)

Post-Internship Skill Development Expectations

  • Get a keen insight on diagnostic criteria, treatment options and theoretical concepts and their flexibility in application.
  • Building rapport and trusting relationships with clients during the treatment process.
  • Smooth transition as a practitioner from a classroom setting.
  • Gain professional ties and ample exposure of clinical setting
  • Have a positive attitude, reflective mindset and problem-solving approach in crisis situations.
  • Develop a hefty skill set needed for practicing in a clinical setting.

Exposure Opportunities

The activities and tasks from the intern’s end during the guidance will entail the following-

contentHtml:
Drug & Alcohol Rehabilitation Centre in Chandigarh

An alcohol and drug rehabilitation centre in Chandigarh, commonly referred to as a rehab or treatment facility is an institution that seeks solving issues related with addictions on substances such as drugs and alcohol. These treatment centres offer a highly structured supportive environment that allows people to benefit from professional help in the fight against substance abuse and toward achieving recovery.

Tulasi Healthcare follows a patient-centric approach to the treatment & rehabilitation of psychiatric and addiction patients.

  • More than 28 years of Experience.
  • A dedicated team of 7 Psychiatrists & 25 Psychologists.
  • Best patient & doctor ratio.
  • 125-bed Mental Health Facility.
  • Daily Psychiatric & Psychologist counseling.

Features of Alcohol and Drug Rehabilitation centre in Chandigarh include.

Assessment and Evaluation: The admission seeker to a rehabilitation centre goes under detailed assessments that determine the degree of substance dependence their physical health, mental state and any comorbidity. This information is used to formulate an individualized treatment protocol.

Detoxification (Detox): individuals who are physically dependent on drugs or alcohol require a supervised process of detoxification to address withdrawal symptoms. In this phase, the medical team follows individuals and provides replacement therapy.

Counseling and Therapy: Rehabilitation centres provide different types of counseling and therapies to deal with the psychological manifestation of addiction. This may include individual counseling, group therapy and holistic therapies for optimal wellness.

Support Groups: Group therapy and support groups, such as AA or NA, help people meet other sufferers. Recovery process can also involve sharing experiences and offering mutual support.

Medical Care: patient may need continuous medicine in alcohol and drug rehabilitation centre, especially if they have other health conditions. Medical practitioner cares for patients with empathy.

Aftercare Planning: Rehabilitation is successful when one makes preparation for life away from the centre. Some aftercare plans involve long-term counseling, attending support groups and living a lifestyle that will prevent relapse.

Holistic Approaches: Others blend holistic strategies such as yoga, meditation art therapy and exercise to promote overall well-being of a person hence enabling them to develop healthy coping mechanisms.

Dual Diagnosis Treatment: Integrated treatment is delivered to people with co-occurrence both substance abuse issues and mental health disorders (dual diagnosis) together at the same time.

Family Involvement: Members of the family are often told to join in on recovery process through education, counseling and even through home therapy sessions.

It is also worth mentioning that rehabilitation plan may have different durations (from short-term to long term), treatment strategies, and equipment. An appropriate rehab centre is based mainly on personal requirements, preferences as well as the level of addiction. Individuals can get professional advice, as well as recommendations from healthcare providers, which would allow them to choose the best alcohol and drug rehabilitation centre in Chandigarh based on their unique needs.

contentHtml:
Best Rehabilitation Centre for Alcohol and Drug addiction disorders

Rehabilitation Centre or a rehab centre is facility that offers personalized recovery programs and services to assist individuals in recuperating from different mental or behavioural disorders. These concerns may encompass substance abuse, addiction, mental health disorders and so forth. The main purpose of a rehabilitation centre is to help individuals regain their independence and functioning, eventually leading to an fulfilling lives.

Drug and Alcohol Rehabilitation Centres: These facilities are aimed at assisting people in overcoming substance abuse and addiction.

Mental Health Rehabilitation Centres: These centres focus on handling cases of people who are mentally ill, like dementia and many more. The treatment can consist of therapy, counseling, medication management and other therapeutic interventions.

Rehabilitation programs usually are inter-disciplinary efforts designed by a whole team of healthcare professionals such as psychiatrists , doctors or nurses, therapists and counselors etc. The services provided can be different, depending on the nature of rehabilitation centre and needs of those who ask for help. Rehabilitation lasts for different periods depending on a severity of the condition and an individual’s recovery process.

Why should you choose Tulasi Healthcare best Rehabilitation Centre?

Tulasi Healthcare is one of the most prominent rehabilitation centre that provide comprehensive treatment for mental disorders and addiction. The group of highly trained professionals is committed to the mission “saving lives and restoring families”. The rehabilitation process involves a multidimensional approach for medical treatment, psychotherapy, family therapy, psychoeducation and the 12 steps program.

Receiving the right care can make all the difference.

At Tulasi Healthcare, we are dedicated to bringing the best an institution has to offer. Stepping into the real world after a de addiction treatment requires a lot of support, independence, counseling and occupational therapy. You might think, why is going to a rehabilitation center a good idea? It has many impacts on the lives of the affected person than any normal treatment plan could have.

At our facility, our clients receive bespoke and intensive care programs for any and all kinds of conditions related to mental health disorders, addictions and counseling issues.

Transforming lives since 22 years

As our reputation holds, we have delivered on our promise over the last 22 years. We have proudly transformed numerous valued lives that have made an impact on the society’s overall health and well-being. Establishing a reputation that marks us as one of the best rehabilitation center in Delhi NCR, we are proud to open our services to all and everyone who looks for a guiding light.

We comprehend the art of rehabilitation and its impact on the lives of the affected.Supporting our clients on every single step of the way, we are proud to nurse them back to their full health and follow up to see them achieve their life goals.

Client centered care

When a team of experts come together, the clients are bound to benefit from their expertise. We bring together a range of experts that are versatile in their respective fields and provide the best of care to our clients. This rehabilitation centre team involves profiles like consultants, specialist nurses, psychologists, psychiatrists, social workers, occupational therapists, counselors and support staff. We believe that with the right support system anyone is capable of breaking the cycle of addiction and disorder stricken life.

The Difference we make.

Environment- An oasis of peace and warmth, Tualsi Helathcae fosters a positive environment to boost the rehabilitation recovery journey in the best manner. The caregivers introduce a sense of support and happiness, making recovery a positive journey.

Ethos- We aim to bring a profound, transformational change on a personal level in the clients that is bound to last.

Positivity- Our ethos exude our positivity. The moment you enter Tulasi Health Care, you will know that you have chosen the right way forward.

Individual care- No treatment plan is ideal, and no two clients are the same. At our institution, we make sure to provide custom solutions to our clients based on the issues that they are facing.

Tulasi Healthcare has always proved to be a pinnacle of support and hope for people who have approached us with their concerns. When it comes to the environment that exudes support and care, it’s an instant priority for us. With expanding experience of over 2+ decades, Tulasi has built a reputation that is beyond treatment. We stand out for our personalized approach- not just in treatment, but in everything that we offer. Recognizing that no two journeys are alike, Tulasi has built its principles around the fact that clients deserve the understanding of everyone they trust with recovery.

What makes Tulasi rehabilitation centre stand apart is its team of multidisciplinary experts that have experience in special niche care areas of mental health. With a team of psychiatrists, psychologists, counsellors, mental health therapists and nurses at hand, we provide something that others don’t. This is the ability to resolve any and every concern that they face.

Whether you are dealing with alcohol dependence, personality issues, behavioral addictions- Tulasi is here for you. Our rehabilitation center blends medical practices with holistic steps to bring out the best of treatment.

Tulasi’s facilities are designed to provide a safe haven for clients and help patients regain control over their lives. Our commitment is not limited at detox or short-term care—we also provide relapse prevention, family counseling, and long-term rehabilitation support.

So, if you are looking for a rehabilitation centre in Delhi to continue your journey to wellbeing- Tulasi can be your support system.

CALL US : +91-8800000255

Why Approach a Rehabilitation centre?

1- Improve your health

The body suffers on many levels due to issues that arise from addiction. At a rehabilitation centre, you receive a guide on overall well-being and care treatment plans that are timely executed to restore your mind and body levels to the right amounts.

2- Address underlying issues

The key to successful rehabilitation is knowing the cause behind the problem. What made the person turn to this substance, why do they use it so often and what was the particular factor that contributed to its onset is a crucial point of knowing and giving the right treatment plan. The counselors use various therapy programs to identify these causes and make a suitable treatment journey for the clients.

3- Foster accountability

Clients can understand their condition and battle with addiction better when they are able to take responsibility for their actions and measure their progress with people who are in the same boat as them. During group discussions, this non-judgemental and supportive environment can help them grow and step in the right direction.

4- Build a structured lifestyle

The environment of a rehab helps one construct a routine that is a guiding step to recovery. This helps in developing productive habits and participating in healthy activities necessary to facilitate a successful treatment. This is also a need for post treatment.

5- Ends the addictive cycle

At first, it can be hard to approach a rehab center, purely because of a lack of insight. But when the person decides to enroll, they indulge in self care and break the habit of consumption of these substances through detoxification and a supportive lifestyle. Our experts, under the supervision of one of the best psychiatrists in Delhi, equip the clients to become the best version of themselves and live a healthy life with the best treatment and care possible.

Some basic behavioral signs to visit

As a caregiver and family member, you can recognize the basic behavior signs that can assure you that you need to visit a rehab center for consultation. Some of them are listed here-

  • No regard for harm caused to others
  • Obsessive actions towards the consumption of a particular substance
  • Loss of control (can be both physical and mental)
  • Inability to admit the use of addictive substances
  • Exhausting finances
  • Neglecting daily responsibilities
  • Not able to perform usual tasks

If these signs are showing up on a regular basis, it is your sign to come and visit, seek help and organize your treatment journey as soon as possible.

Contact us

Our Plan at Tulasi Healthcare

  • Primarily residential services- With the 12-step recovery program and inpatient residential services, the clients get full community disclosure and support with access to holistic care regimes.The inpatient services are highly impactful in reducing the effects of addiction, as per the choices and preferences of the client.
  • Outpatient services- There are many flexible packages available at Tulasi health care for pursuing outpatient treatment. The care plan remains similar, the only difference being that the client is aware, psychoeducated and willing to cooperate with the care specialists during treatment plan.
  • Aftercare plan- To maintain long term sobriety, aftercare plans are essential to maintain. At our rehabilitation centre, we are aligned to provide the necessary guidance and resources to prevent relapse and keep our clients on a positive path.

Addiction is not limited to drugs. It can manifest as prescription medication dependency, nicotine addiction, and even behavioral addictions like gambling, gaming, or internet use. For each, a specific way is the right way to move ahead. At the core of it all, lies the importance of right assessment and diagnosis. This process is quite helpful in identifying the underlying issues and needed solutions for the proposed problem.

Detoxification holds significance here. In any case, the trigger to the issue is removed as not to hamper the progress going forward.

Behavioral therapy like Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), and motivational enhancement are some staple methods to treat addiction. It is used to help individuals understand the root causes of their addiction, build coping strategies, and avoid relapse. Group therapy and 12-step programs like Alcoholics Anonymous (AA) also play a big role in peer-supported recovery.

For certain addictions, medications may be prescribed to manage cravings or stabilize mood disorders. Long-term follow-up, aftercare planning, and family involvement ensure that recovery continues well beyond the initial treatment phase.

Whether you’re dealing with alcohol, opioids, or digital addiction, support is available. And if you’re near the NCR region, reaching out to the best psychiatrist in Gurgaon or at Tulasi Rehabilitation Centre can be the first powerful step toward healing.

To sail past these issues and return back to the once happy and satisfied life, connect with us at www.tulasihealthcare.com and start your journey to recovery today!

Frequently Asked Questions

FAQ's

What is the rehabilitation of psychiatric patients?

Psychiatric rehabilitation is focused on aiding individuals with mental health issues to regain independence and improve their quality of life. It involves structured therapies, occupational training, and social skills development to lead a life of quality and respect. Tulasi Healthcare, led by Gorav Gupta, offers personalized psychiatric rehabilitation to support patients in their recovery journey, helping them get back into the society with enhanced coping strategies and overall well-being.

How are patients treated in the rehabilitation centre?

At Tulasi Healthcare, we follow a comprehensive approach in providing treatment to our patients. This includes therapy sessions, counseling, medication management, and rehabilitation activities. The treatment is personalized to each individual by Gorav Gupta & his team, one of the best psychiatrist in Delhi. Patients receive support in building life skills, emotional resilience, and mental stability to help them lead fulfilling lives.

What are the functions of a rehabilitation centre?

A rehabilitation centre like Tulasi Healthcare, provides a range of services. These functions include but are not limited to psychiatric assessment, therapy, medication management, and occupational training. Rehabilitation is facilitated through skill-building, community reintegration, and mental wellness. The aim is to enhance patients' functionality, reduce symptoms, and help them develop healthier coping mechanisms.

What are the three goals of psychiatric rehabilitation?

The three main goals of psychiatric rehabilitation are: 1) To reduce symptoms and improve overall functioning 2) Introduce daily independence and enhance life skills. 3) Support social integration and community involvement

What is the purpose of a rehabilitation centre?

A psychiatric rehabilitation centre serves as a facility designed to offer complete help and treatment for people dealing with mental health challenges. The primary reason of these facilities is to assist individuals in improving from ailments, coping with their signs, and reintegrating into their communities.

What are the challenges of rehabilitation?

There are numerous barriers to such rehabilitation, including stigma, a limited readiness and willingness in society at large as well as among professionals. Who can be unrealistic about the prognosis; lack of resources available for supporting patients entering or maintaining their recovery: co-occurring disorders which add to its difficulty. To take on these challenges, a systematic approach, involving all players in health care-from practitioners to policymakers and from communities to individuals-is needed. So that public information can be available where the citizens live; delivery of services at their door step becomes possible; quality of life is guaranteed for them by accessible and effective treatment.

Who needs rehab centre?

Those suffering from mental illnesses or addictions are treated at psychiatric and addiction rehabilitation centres. Such facilities are a life raft for anyone with substance use disorders (alcohol or drug addiction) and people suffering from dual diagnoses -- that is, those coping both with substances abuse problems as well as mental illness. These centers provide support to people with serious mental illnesses, trauma victims or those facing legal consequences. In addition, persons with strained family relations because of mental illness or substance problems. Those affected in their employment or education; and people seeking post-rehabilitation services are potential recipients. These centers provide a stable, conducive environment in which medical people are joined by therapists and counselors into multidisciplinary teams. Different people have different needs, circumstances and determination to go through the recovery process. So whether you should look at psychiatric or addiction rehabilitation centre can only depend on yourself. As a whole, these centres provide complete care and assistance to people seeking recovery from psychosis or addiction. From here, they have the chance of making their lives better.

What are benefits of rehabilitation?

A variety of advantages are available to persons suffering from mental illnesses and substance abuse through rehabilitation programs. They offer multi-dimensional treatment plans covering both the mental health and addiction issues, providing a complete solution to recovery. People are detoxified under medical supervision, and therapy including counseling and group therapy explore basic causes and help develop coping strategies. The structured environment reduces triggers, allowing for focused recovery. Rehabilitation teaches life skills, provides peer support and education about triggers and relapse prevention. Aftercare planning is to help people back to their normal lives. The process of participating helps break down barriers against mental illness and addiction. The real purpose of rehabilitation is to raise overall quality of life, both in terms of mental and spiritual well-being as well as relationships with others. It can also help people live good lives.

What addictions are treated at Tulasi Healthcare best rehabilitation centre?

A variety of substance use disorders and behavioural addictions are treated at Tulasi Healthcare rehabilitation centre. Typical addictions treated include alcohol, drugs (both illegal and prescription), tobacco/nicotine, cannabis, opioids or painkillers. This focus may differ from place to place, and some rehabilitation centres only treat alcoholics while others take a more complete approach. Furthermore, treatment methods and interventions are also different. Therefore individuals must suit themselves by doing independent research to find a rehabilitation centre that can most fully meet their needs. All in all, rehabilitation centres provide an important service to society helping people shake off various addictions. They offer individually tailored support for a successful recovery and better well-being.

Do psychiatric and addiction patients stay together?

It's essential to note that while some facilities have separate psychiatric and addiction patients, others may adopt an integrated or dual diagnosis approach, where both conditions are addressed simultaneously within the same program. The choice of treatment setting depends on the facility's philosophy, available resources, and the prevalence and complexity of co-occurring disorders among the individuals seeking treatment. Tulasi Healthcare has different wards for psychiatric patients and addiction patients.

Is there a female only ward?

Yes, we have a separate female ward in Tulasi Healthcare rehabilitation centre.

What is anxiety?

Everyone feels anxious now and then: before an exam, a medical test or a big decision. An anxiety disorder is different. The worry or fear is out of proportion to the situation, lasts for weeks or months, and starts to get in the way of sleep, work, studies or relationships.

Anxiety disorders are among the most common mental health conditions, and they respond well to treatment. You do not have to manage this alone.

Common types of anxiety disorder

  • Generalised anxiety disorder (GAD): constant worry about many everyday things that is hard to control, often with restlessness, tiredness, muscle tension and poor sleep.
  • Panic disorder: sudden waves of intense fear (panic attacks) with a racing heart, breathlessness, sweating or dizziness, and a fear of having another attack.
  • Social anxiety disorder: a strong fear of being judged or embarrassed around other people, which leads to avoiding them.
  • Phobias: intense fear of a particular thing or situation, such as heights, flying or injections.
  • Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD): unwanted, distressing thoughts (obsessions) and repeated actions or mental rituals (compulsions) that are done to ease the distress.
  • Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD): anxiety, flashbacks and nightmares after a frightening or traumatic event.

Signs to look out for

  • Thoughts and feelings: constant worry, feeling on edge, a sense of dread, irritability.
  • In the body: a racing heart, shaking, sweating, breathlessness, an upset stomach, headaches, trouble sleeping.
  • In behaviour: avoiding places or people, needing a lot of reassurance, difficulty concentrating.

Anxiety and substance use

Some people use alcohol or drugs to calm their anxiety. This can bring short relief, but over time it usually makes anxiety worse and can lead to dependence. At Tulasi Healthcare our psychiatrists and psychologists treat anxiety and addiction together, because treating only one of them rarely lasts.

How anxiety is treated

  • A careful assessment by a psychiatrist or clinical psychologist, to understand the type of anxiety and what is keeping it going.
  • Talking therapy: cognitive behavioural therapy (CBT) is the best-studied therapy for anxiety. It helps you notice and change anxious thought patterns and gradually face the things you have been avoiding.
  • Medication, when it is needed: a psychiatrist may prescribe medicines such as SSRIs. Sedative medicines are used only briefly and with care because they can cause dependence. Medicines should only be started or stopped by a doctor.
  • Everyday skills: slow breathing, relaxation and mindfulness, regular sleep and exercise, and cutting down caffeine and alcohol.
  • Group and family support, so that you and the people close to you understand what is happening and how to help.

When to ask for help

Please speak to a specialist if your anxiety has lasted for several weeks, is affecting your daily life, or if you have started to rely on alcohol or other substances to cope.

If you ever have thoughts of harming yourself, call Tele-MANAS on 14416 (free, 24 hours) or 112 straight away.

%%BOOKING_CTA%%

Frequently asked questions

How is anxiety different from ordinary stress?

Stress is a response to a particular pressure and usually fades when the pressure passes. Anxiety is worry or fear that carries on even when there is no clear reason, or that is much stronger than the situation deserves, and it starts to affect sleep, work or relationships.

Can anxiety be treated?

Yes. Most people improve a great deal with the right treatment, and many recover fully. Anxiety can return in stressful periods, so the skills you learn in therapy are part of staying well.

Will I need medication?

Not always. Mild to moderate anxiety often improves with talking therapy alone. Medication is considered when symptoms are severe or therapy on its own has not been enough. The decision is made together with a psychiatrist.

Can I see someone online?

Many of our doctors offer online consultations. Check the doctor's profile or call us and we will help you choose.

This page is for general information and is not a substitute for advice from a qualified doctor.

What Types of Therapies Are Used at Our Psychiatric Facility?

Tulasi healthcare has always prioritized the well being and happiness of its clients in every manner possible. Therapies play a crucial part in treating psychiatric illnesses, along with medication and other holistic techniques. Our team takes pride in being experts of different therapeutic modalities that are employed in curing mental health issues. Let us understand different therapies that our employed at our facility during different treatment plans in many conditions.

Cognitive Behavioral Therapy

CBT is one of the highest employed therapies across a variety of conditions. It works on a simple principle of behavior modification by moulding thought cognition and adjusting maladaptive behaviors. A quite affordable and short term therapy, it has shown efficacy in treating a variety of mental health conditions. Some of the top psychiatrist in Delhi favor the use of this therapy since it shows a true change in the individual within limited sessions. The therapy focuses more on what is the problem currently, rather than what issues have built up to the currency situations. The absolution of the issues in the current scenario is emphasized. Healthy coping mechanisms are professed and taught at a pace where one can manage and channelize them in their life.

Dialectical Behavior Therapy

DBT is used to understand emotional expressions and regulations, and incorporate mindfulness for distress tolerance. Here, the person is taught to identify their emotional triggers, behaviors, self validate and distinguish themselves from the experience of others. This treatment is all about expanding a person’s skills to navigate their thought processes, emotional expressions and coping mechanisms in distressing situations.

Exposure Therapy

Exposure treatment is particularly employed in conditions where a person has undergone abuse, trauma or situations that have produced phobias and terrifying emotional responses on their part. Here, the person is first analyzed and then their triggers are identified. When these triggers are in place, the person is exposed to them under supervision to study their response. This also helps them to familiarize with this fear with repeated exposures and learn different aspects of their emotional response. With such repeated exposures- the client starts to abandon their fear, and adopt rational thinking to counter this behavior.

Mindfulness Based Therapy

Mindfulness based therapies are holistic in nature, bringing the ability to be present and aware of our emotions. Therapists teach the clients ways and manners in which they can draw energy and positivity from their present emotions, and generate coping mechanisms by which they can deal with negative thoughts. Tapping into feelings as they arise, such a technique is instrumental in decreasing and managing symptoms of anxiety, depression and trauma related issues. As one of the best mental health specialist in Mehrauli Delhi recommends, it is one of the highly effective therapies in the space of mental wellness.

Family Therapy

 Family therapy is all about taking care of an individual as a part of the family unit. It is a fact that a person is a part of the family system, and when one part of the system is affected, it ends up pushing the load on others too. The disbalance of harmony can take a toll on the other family members, and healing can become a more complex process. With family therapy, each individual has a chance to respond to the situation and share their issues, and cope with the problem they have faced.

Interpersonal Therapy

Interpersonal therapy is employed in cases where an individual lacks insight and needs guidance from an expert to understand their situation. Here, the client and the therapist work together to gauge through the diagnosis and understand it from the perspective of the experiences that the client has had. A strong support system is essential for this therapy since sharing experiences with a therapist is a matter of trust and confidence. This therapy can work wonders with people who suffer with depression, anxiety and mood disorders.

Group Therapy

Group therapy is all about being part of a community that faces a common issue. As one of the best experienced psychiatrist in Delhi have noted, group therapy is highly efficient in building coping mechanisms among people who have shown slow progress. Here, they get to learn from the other members of their group and apply those learnings in their journey to become a healthy individual. This therapy provides an air of emotional safety, support and education to everyone involved.

FAQ's

What are the treatments provided at Tulasi health care?

There are a variety of treatments provided at our facility. These can range from anxiety, depression, stress or substance abuse to severe psychiatric illnesses like personality disorders, schizophrenia, dementia and other complex mental health conditions.

Can a person only be treated with the help of medication?

No. Treatment is a mixture of therapeutic interventions, alongside a number of holistic techniques and counseling sessions. Mental health treatment is not just about treating the physical manifestations- it is also about abdicating it from the root. A true treatment plan involves all the elements where they all have a specific role to play.

For how long will I have to take medicine if I am prescribed to?

The answer to it depends upon the severity of your condition. The dosage of the medicine depends upon the type of problem you are facing, and the frequency is till the time your healthcare provider can notice positive changes. Apart from this, you will receive regular counseling from the experts.

What are the benefits of seeing a psychiatrist?

There are multiple benefits of seeing a psychiatrist, especially when one can feel stress and other issues build up in their lives. It is just a matter of time after these issues become manifestations and show up in our daily activities.

Will I have to take medication for the rest of my life?

Not necessarily. It truly depends upon the kind of issue you are facing and the severity it presents. Medication may be discontinued in a few months or years if the person shows any improvement, or otherwise stay on it for life.

What do psychiatrists do?

Psychiatrists are medical doctors that help in diagnosing, making treatment plans, and preventing mental health disorders. They work with mental health therapist & clinical psychologist to assess patients' psychological conditions, provide therapy, and prescribe medications. They work with various clients experiencing a variety of issues that can include depression, anxiety, schizophrenia, bipolar disorder & many more issues, offering both short-term and long-term treatment plans to improve mental well-being.

Do psychiatrist do therapy?

Yes, psychiatrists can provide therapy, often called psychotherapy or talk therapy. At Tulasi, we work with one of the best therapist in India to curate an experience for each of our clients. While the therapist has primary focus on diagnosing and treating mental health disorders, they may use different techniques, such as cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), in addition to prescribing medication. However, some psychiatrists may refer patients to psychologist or mental therapist for more specialized therapy.

Can a psychiatrist prescribe medicine?

Yes. Psychiatrists can prescribe medications since they are medical doctors that have obtained a license from medical authorities. They are licensed to diagnose mental health conditions and offer pharmacological treatments, such as antidepressants, antipsychotics, and mood stabilizers. They tailor medication plans based on the individual's needs, often combining them with therapy to manage conditions. However, a clinical psychologist cannot prescribe them. If you look for an online therapist, or psychiatrist, make sure to keep these points in mind.

What is the difference between a psychologist and a psychiatrist?

The main difference between a psychologist and a psychiatrist is their ability to prescribe medications.Their training and approach also differ in a variety of ways.As the best therapist in India, Dr. Gorav Gupta has redefined the mental health landscape. Psychologists typically hold a doctoral degree in psychology and focus on therapy and psychological assessments, but they cannot prescribe medication. Psychiatrists often combine medication with treatment, while psychologists primarily use therapy. So if you are searching for a psychologist near me, make sure to keep these points in mind according to your needs.

When to consult a psychiatrist?

Consulting a psychiatrist should not just be limited to an issue. There may be times when one feels lost and without guidance. A psychiatrist can help you with that. They can help you identify your needs and work on your issues with you or refer you to a clinical psychologist or therapist for further evaluation. A psychiatrist in particular can help you if you're experiencing persistent mental health symptoms, such as severe depression, anxiety, mood swings, hallucinations, or thoughts of self-harm.

What does a psychiatrist do for anxiety?

A psychiatrist helps you diagnose and plan a treatment for your anxiety. They connect you with an anxiety therapist that guides you through the course of treatment. As the best therapist in Delhi, Dr. Gorav Gupta helps you build resources and resilience to maintain coping mechanisms. contentHtml:
Modified Electroconvulsive Therapy (M ECT)

Modified Electroconvulsive Therapy (M ECT) is a treatment modality in Psychiatry, which involves administration of a small electric charge to the patient’s brain to produce a seizure activity. When such a small electric charge is administered under general anesthesia along with muscle relaxant, the treatment is referred to as Modified Electroconvulsive Therapy (M ECT).

How Is it given?

Subsequent to a thorough Psychiatric and Medical evaluation and obtaining a written Informed consent from the patient and/or the nominated representative (legal guardian), a small electrical charge is administered to the patient, through electrodes placed on scalp under the effect of brief general anesthesia, with continuous monitoring of cardio-respiratory system and the CNS for seizure activity. Patient is then closely monitored until full recovery from the effects of general anesthesia and seizure.

When is M ECT given?

M ECT is administered across a number of psychiatric and medical disorders which include

  • Depression: Especially useful in severe depression, patients with high suicide risk, depressive stupor, catatonia, psychotic depression, and treatment resistance or intolerance.
  • Catatonia due to various disorders
  • Bipolar Disorder (Manic excitement, Depression and Mixed states)
  • Highly useful for Catatonia, florid psychosis, high suicide risk, risk of harm to others, and treatment resistance or intolerance.
  • Other psychosis including acute psychosis, schizoaffective disorder and schizophreniform psychosis
  • Exceptional Cases including neuroleptic malignant syndrome; a life threatening situation, MECT can be life saving
  • Medical conditions like Parkinsonism, Intractable seizure disorder, and delirium.

What are the Contraindications of M ECT?

  • Raised intracranial pressure

Other relative contraindications include:

  • Recent myocardial infarct Large aneurysms
  • Space occupying lesions in brain

What happens before the M ECT administration?

  • The Informed consent of the patient/legal guardian is taken for MECT and Anesthesia.
  • Patient is investigated thoroughly for relevant blood investigations, fundus, ECG examination and pre-anaesthetic check up.
  • PAC- fitness obtained
  • Patient is kept on an overnight fast (minimum6-8 hrs of fasting).
  • Any loose tooth or dentures are removed.

What happens during the M ECT administration?

  • Patient is asked to empty the bladder.
  • Patient is taken to the MECT room and assisted onto the MECT table.
  • The treating team includes a Psychiatrist, personnel experienced in anesthesia, and nursing staff trained in the use of MECT.
  • An IV line is put by the doctors/nursing staff to administer medications as well as additional fluids.
  • A blood pressure cuff, heart monitor, pulse oximeter are put in place.
  • Injection anesthetic and muscle relaxant are given.
  • Bilateral electrodes are placed on the scalp.
  • A small electrical charge is administered to produce seizure with monitoring of seizure activity and vital signs.

What happens after the M ECT?

  • The patient is continued on ventilation till the commencement of spontaneous breathing.

The patient is then wheeled to the recovery room where he/she is monitored till consciousness is fully regained.

What are the Alternatives to M ECT?

A wide variety of treatment options are available for people with mental illness which apart from MECT include-

  • Pharmacological agents (Medications).
  • Psychological interventions.
  • Psychosocial interventions
  • Deep transcranial magnetic stimulation
  • Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation
  • Ketamine therapy
  • Deep brain stimulation
  • Psychosurgery

What are the Benefits of M ECT?

M ECT confers upon the patient the following important benefits-

  • Proven and scientifically established efficacy
  • Fewer long-term adverse effects
  • Rapid recovery with patients returning to functional state within hours to days.
  • Lowers suicide risk (often life saving)
  • Useful in patients with catatonia, depressive stupor – Facilitates response to ongoing drug treatment and so hastens remission
  • Useful in those with intolerable medicinal adverse effects

What are the adverse effects/ risks?

M ECT is a relatively safe treatment option with risk of severe adverse effects as low as 1/1000 and risk of death as 1/10,000 similar to that of any procedure under general anesthesia.

Main adverse effects of M ECT and Anesthesia are:

  • Neurological – Headache, reversible memory deficits (for hours to days), prolonged seizure, delirium
  • Cardiac-Tachycardia, arrhythmias
  • Respiratory- Prolonged apnoea, exacerbation of COPD/asthma, respiratory arrest
  • Musculoskeletal-Myalgia, fracture, dental injury
  • Gastrointestinal – Nausea, Vomiting
  • Psychiatric-Manic switch

M ECT does not lead to irreversible or permanent brain damage.

In case of any adverse event developing during the treatment course, it is treated appropriately and further MECTS are withheld until the condition completely reverts to normal.

What is the duration of treatment?

The duration and frequency of M ECT is decided on an individual basis by the treating Psychiatrist and depends on the response, adverse effects, and relapse. Average number of M ECTS is around 6-12 with a frequency of two to three M ECTS per week. No stipulated/fixed number of MECT’s for a given condition recommended.

M ECT is discontinued after:

  • Remission of target symptoms
  • No further response on 2-3 consecutive treatment trials
  • Intolerable adverse drug effects
  • Withdrawal of consent of patient/NR

MECTS are also used beyond the acute illness, in continuous and maintenance phase treatment. There is no maximum or lifetime number of MECTS recommended.

What are Sexual Disorders and it's treatment by best sexologist?

Sexual disorders are a complex and sensitive issue that can significantly impact an individual’s overall quality of life and emotional well-being. Fortunately, the field of mental health has made significant advancements in understanding and treating these disorders. In the bustling urban landscape of Delhi, Gurgaon, and the National Capital Region (NCR), individuals struggling with sexual disorders can find solace in the form of comprehensive treatment options. This article delves into the importance of sexual disorder treatment by sexologist, explores the range of therapies available in the region, and emphasizes the significance of a holistic approach to sexual well-being.

Sexual disorders encompass a range of conditions that affect an individual’s sexual thoughts, feelings, behaviors, and experiences. These disorders can be categorized into various types, including erectile dysfunction, premature ejaculation, sexual aversion disorder, hypoactive sexual desire disorder, and more. They often stem from a combination of psychological, emotional, and physiological factors, making their treatment complex and multifaceted.

What are types of sexual disorders in Males and Females?

Sexual disorders encompass a wide range of conditions that affect an individual’s sexual thoughts, feelings, behaviors, and experiences. These disorders can occur in both men and women, and they often stem from a combination of psychological, emotional, and physiological factors. Tulasi Healthcare has a team of best sexologist near me for the treatment of sexual disorders. Here are some of the common types of psychosexual disorders in men and women:

Sexual Disorders in Men:
  • Erectile Dysfunction (ED): Also known as impotence, ED is characterized by the inability to achieve or maintain an erection sufficient for sexual intercourse. It can be caused by factors such as anxiety, stress, depression, medical conditions, or certain medications.
  • Premature Ejaculation (PE): This disorder involves ejaculating sooner than desired, often before or shortly after penetration. Psychological factors, performance anxiety, or hypersensitivity are common causes of PE.
  • Delayed Ejaculation: Delayed ejaculation is the difficulty or inability to ejaculate, even with sufficient sexual stimulation. This can lead to frustration, dissatisfaction, and strained relationships.
  • Low Sexual Desire (Hypoactive Sexual Desire Disorder): This disorder is characterized by a persistent lack of interest or desire for sexual activity. It can result from psychological factors, hormonal imbalances, relationship issues, or medical conditions. It can be effectively treated by expert sexologist. 
  • Sexual Aversion Disorder: Individuals with this disorder experience extreme aversion or fear of sexual activities, often due to past trauma, negative experiences, or anxiety.
Sexual Disorders in Women:
  • Female Sexual Arousal Disorder: This involves difficulty or inability to become sexually aroused, leading to challenges in achieving orgasm. Factors such as stress, anxiety, and relationship issues can contribute to this disorder.
  • Orgasmic Disorder: Women with this disorder have difficulty achieving orgasm despite adequate sexual stimulation. Psychological factors, past trauma, and relationship dynamics can play a role in this condition.
  • Vaginismus: Vaginismus is characterized by involuntary muscle spasms in the vaginal area, making penetration painful or impossible. It can be triggered by anxiety, fear, or past traumatic experiences.
  • Dyspareunia: Dyspareunia refers to persistent pain during sexual intercourse. Physical factors (infections, hormonal changes) and psychological factors (anxiety, trauma) can contribute to this disorder.
  • Low Sexual Desire (Hypoactive Sexual Desire Disorder): Just like in men, women can also experience a persistent lack of interest in sexual activity due to various factors.
Gender-Neutral Disorders:
  • Sexual Arousal Disorder: This disorder involves difficulty becoming aroused or maintaining arousal, regardless of gender. It can result from psychological factors, medical conditions, medications, or hormonal imbalances.
  • Hypersexuality (Compulsive Sexual Behavior): While not exclusive to a particular gender, hypersexuality involves an excessive and uncontrollable urge to engage in sexual behaviors. It can lead to distress and negatively impact one’s life.
  • Sexual Pain Disorders: These disorders, such as vaginismus and dyspareunia, can affect individuals of any gender and involve physical discomfort or pain during sexual activity.

It’s important to note that psychosexual disorders can be highly individualized, and the causes and symptoms can vary widely. Additionally, a comprehensive assessment by qualified healthcare professionals, including psychologists, Sexologist, and medical doctors, is necessary to diagnose and treat these disorders effectively. Treatment often involves a combination of psychological therapy, medical intervention, lifestyle adjustments, and open communication to address the underlying factors contributing to the disorder and to promote sexual well-being.

What are the most common causes of sexual disorders?

The causes behind a sexual disorder can either be physical issues, or they may stem from environmental disturbances and psychological roots.

Physical causes include–

  • Chronic conditions
  • Heart and related vascular diseases
  • Neurological disorders like MS or nerve damage
  • Hormonal imbalances
  • Cancer
  • Menopause
  • Alcohol or other substance abuse conditions

Psychological interferences may include-

  • Stress and anxiety
  • Relationship and marital disturbances
  • Depression
  • Previous sexual trauma or abuse
  • Concerns about sexual performance / performance anxiety

Signs and Symptoms of sexual disorders

There are very clear signs you can observe to understand and consult with an expert for a formal diagnosis. These signs include-

  • Lack of desire
  • Difficulty feeling aroused or maintaining arousal
  • Feeling pain during sexual activity
  • Vaginal dryness
  • Inability to achieve orgasm
  • Premature ejaculation/ No ejaculation
  • Erectile issues

If you feel that you and your partner are experiencing any of these symptoms and it is significantly impacting your relationship dynamics, it may be a good time to consult an expert sexologist near me.

How is sexual dysfunction diagnosed?

The diagnosis is quite uncomplicated when it comes to sexual disorders. The symptoms are quite prevalent in such cases and the client can feel a very present change in their sexual activity and history. A history is usually taken to identify any interfering factors and partners pitch their individual feedback to build the big picture. With this, certain medical and psychological tests are also performed to understand the root of the issue. Usually, lab testing has a very limited impact on understanding the core issue.

Usually the client’s social and relationship evaluation reveals a lot about their cognitive and emotional patterns that can impact their sexual activity and result in a disorder.

Why is there a need for specialized treatment for sexual disorders?

Sexual disorders have a profound impact on our lives, given that it is counted as a basic need in our lives. It severely hampers the quality of life, and impacts the intimate relationships of an individual. Since it is an integral part of a successful and fulfilling lifestyle, a specialized treatment is necessary.

  • It may indicate other brewing conditions– Issues in sexual activity can result from a problem in the physical spectrum or stressors from the environment that affect the physical conditions. Stress is often the major indicator in identifying underlying conditions.
  • Mental health conditions– Deficit and issues with sexual activity can result in anxiety, stress and depression, which can form a vicious cycle of self doubt and recurring problems.
  • Self doubt– Countering sexual disorders can raise a question on our self worth. It can cause us to question our choices and the decisions that we make in our life- that results in self doubt.

What are the comprehensive treatment options for sexual disorders?

Individuals struggling with sexual disorders have access to a range of comprehensive treatment options by best sexologist in india. These options include psychological therapy, medical intervention, lifestyle modifications, and partner involvement.

Psychological Therapy for sexual Disorders

Psychological therapies, such as cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT) and sex therapy, are at the forefront of treating sexual disorders. These therapies aim to identify and address underlying psychological factors that contribute to sexual difficulties. They provide a safe and confidential space for individuals to discuss their concerns and work collaboratively with therapists to develop coping strategies and solutions.

Medical Intervention for Sexual Disorders by best sexologist

Medical intervention plays a crucial role in treating certain sexual disorders. For example, individuals with erectile dysfunction or hormonal imbalances might benefit from medication prescribed by a qualified sexologist doctors. It’s essential to consult with a knowledgeable healthcare provider before starting any medication regimen to ensure its appropriateness and safety.

Lifestyle factors such as diet, exercise, sleep, and stress management can significantly impact sexual health. Integrating regular physical activity, maintaining a balanced diet, and managing stress can contribute to improved sexual well-being. Consulting with healthcare experts who specialize in sexual disorders can provide tailored advice on lifestyle modifications.

Partner Involvement

In many cases, sexual disorders can affect both partners in a relationship. Involving partners in the treatment process can lead to a more holistic and supportive approach. Couples therapy and communication workshops can help partners understand each other’s needs, improve communication, and navigate the challenges together.

What to expect during your first therapy session?

Talking about your sexual history can be a difficult task. Expecting to talk explicitly even to a therapist about your problems may seem like a far cry. The process of therapy is slow, and trust should be established from both ends before any progress is made. This is essential for a therapeutic setting.

Gathering essential information about the issues that you are facing is necessary, so the therapist will try to establish a comfortable and safe space for you to truly express your concerns. This however, comes with experience to a therapist. So, consulting someone who has experience dealing with such disorders can be a huge plus point for you.

The sessions will take their pace slowly, but do keep in mind that your first therapy session will be the time where you can definitely voice your concerns, sit with your problems and identify the goals of the therapeutic journey with your therapist.

What is the Holistic Approach to Sexual Well-being?

A holistic approach to treating sexual disorders recognizes that sexual health is interconnected with an individual’s overall well-being. This approach addresses not only the physical symptoms but also the emotional and psychological aspects of the disorder. Here’s why a holistic approach is crucial:

Psychological Well-being

Sexual disorders often have psychological roots, such as anxiety, depression, trauma, or body image issues. By addressing these underlying psychological factors through therapy, individuals can experience improved sexual functioning and a better overall quality of life.

Relationship Enhancement

Sexual difficulties can strain relationships and lead to misunderstandings between partners. A holistic approach involves couples therapy and open communication, fostering a deeper understanding between partners and enhancing the emotional bond.

Self-esteem and Confidence

Sexual disorders can severely impact an individual’s self-esteem and confidence. Integrating therapy to address these issues can empower individuals to regain their self-assurance and engage in fulfilling sexual experiences.

Education and Awareness

A holistic approach includes educating individuals and couples about sexual health, fostering awareness about normal sexual functioning, and debunking myths and misconceptions. This knowledge equips them to make informed decisions and reduces the stigma associated with sexual disorder.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

FAQ's

What causes sexual disorders?

Sexual disorders can have a range of causes, including physical factors (such as medical conditions or medications), psychological factors (like stress, anxiety, or trauma), relationship issues, and cultural or societal influences. In many cases, a combination of these factors contributes to the development of psychosexual disorders. Identifying the underlying causes is an important part of therapy.

Is there hope for individuals with sexual disorders to improve their sexual function?

Yes, there is hope. Many sexual disorders are treatable, and individuals can experience significant improvements in their sexual function and overall sexual satisfaction with the right therapy and support. It's important to seek help from a qualified therapist who specializes in sexual issues, as they can provide guidance and strategies to address the specific concerns and challenges an individual or couple is facing.

Is medication used to treat sexual disorders?

Yes, in some cases, medication may be prescribed to address underlying issues like anxiety, depression, or hormonal imbalances that contribute to sexual disorders.

What is the role of psychotherapy in treating sexual disorders?

Psychotherapy, including cognitive-behavioral therapy and sex therapy, is often a primary treatment approach. It helps individuals understand and manage their thoughts, emotions, and behaviors related to their sexual concerns.

Can sexual disorders be prevented?

Prevention strategies include maintaining open communication about sexual matters, seeking help for mental health issues early, and adopting a healthy lifestyle that includes regular exercise and stress management.

Are sexual disorders a lifelong condition?

Not necessarily. With appropriate treatment and support, many individuals can see significant improvement or resolution of their sexual disorder. The duration and success of treatment can vary depending on the specific disorder and individual factors.

Why is it important to address sexual disorders?

Sexual concerns are a part of everyone’s life, and play a very intimate role in establishing relationships. If sexual disorders persist, they can meddle with the person’s quality of life and hamper their overall well being. Psychological issues can also result.

What is hyper sexual disorder?

Hyper sexual disorder, also known as sexual addiction is a disorder that is accompanied by excessive urges, thought and activities of sexual nature. The person feels preoccupied with such thoughts majority of the time that causes hindrance in their daily activities and hampers psychological well being.

What is hypo sexual disorder?

hypo sexual disorder is a lack of sexual desire, that includes disinterest, lack of urges and desires of sexual nature. To seek hypoactive sexual desire disorder treatment, you can connect with us to know more about the condition and build a personalized plan for your wellbeing.

What is sexual sadism disorder?

- People who experience sexual arousal in hurt, humiliation and pain of other people. It can be a very serious issue for people who are the submissive partners in these cases. There is no known cause behind this, but many treatment and management options are available.

What is Virtual Reality Therapy?

Virtual Reality (VR) Technology has rapidly evolved beyond the realm of gaming and entertainment, finding promising applications in various fields, including healthcare. VR therapy, a novel and innovative approach to mental health treatment, has gained significant attention in recent years.

Understanding VR therapy involves immersing patients in computer-generated 3D environments, simulating real-life scenarios or imaginary settings tailored to treat a range of psychological and emotional conditions. These virtual environments can be interactive, allowing patients to navigate, interact with objects, and face challenging situations safely. Therapists can design personalized scenarios that address specific phobias, anxieties, PTSD, and other mental health issues, thereby enabling a more targeted and effective treatment approach.

VR therapy is a therapeutic approach that utilizes virtual reality technology to address various mental health conditions, such as anxiety disorders, phobias, post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), Depression, and many more.

By stimulating real-life situations or treating them in controlled scenarios, individuals can engage with their fears and anxieties in a safe and controlled environment. The immersive nature of VR therapy allows therapists to carefully guide and monitor their patients during the exposure process, ensuring a tailored and gradual approach to treatment.

Benefits of VR Therapy

Enhanced Immersion

Traditional Therapy can be limited in its ability to recreate real-world situations, making it challenging for patients to fully engage in the treatment process. VR therapy offers an unparalleled level of immersion, allowing patients to experience scenarios more realistically, leading to better outcomes.

Personalized Treatment

VR therapy enables therapists to customize scenarios to match each patient’s specific needs. Whether it’s a fear of heights, public speaking, or confined spaces, VR environments can be tailored to replicate these triggers accurately.

Safe Environments

VR Therapy provides a secure environment for patients to confront their fears without being exposed to the risks of the real world. The controlled setting allows therapists to manage the intensity of exposure and gradually increase the challenges as the patient progresses.

Overcoming Stigma

Some individuals may feel hesitant or stigmatized about seeking help for their mental health conditions. VR therapy offers a discreet and private treatment option, encouraging more people to get the support they need.

Applications

Anxiety and phobia

VR Therapy has shown remarkable success in treating various anxiety disorders such as social anxiety, specific phobias (e.g., fear of heights, fear of flying, or spiders), and Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). Patients can repeatedly confront their fears in a safe environment until they gain confidence and reduce their anxiety.

Addiction Treatment

VR therapy is also being explored as a supportive tool for addiction treatment. By simulating situations that trigger substance cravings, patients can practice coping strategies in a risk-free environment.

The future of VR therapy is promising. As research continues to demonstrate its effectiveness, it is expected to become an integral part of mental health treatment protocols.

It represents a groundbreaking approach to mental health treatments, offering innovative and highly immersive solutions to address a wide range of psychological conditions. Its ability to provide safe exposure, enhanced engagement, and a personalized experience makes it a valuable tool in the toolkit of the therapist. As technology advances, VR therapy has the potential to revolutionize the way we approach mental healthcare, ultimately leading to better outcomes and improved quality of life for patients.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

FAQ,s

How is VR therapy different from other mental health therapies?

VR therapy is a novel and innovative approach to mental healthcare which aims to provide non-pharmacologic methods in treating mental health problems.

How costly is VR therapy?

The best thing about VR therapy is that technology is becoming more pervasive and affordable and has come within the reach and budget of general population.

How can we make best use of virtual therapy?

We can make best use of virtual therapy by combining the virtual therapy treatment along with other therapies like the talk therapies and pharmacotherapies.

What is the future of virtual therapy?

The future of virtual therapy looks quite bright as it gains popularity among the clients and also the number of people being benefitted increases.

Which disease Virtual reality can treat?

Virtual reality has proven to be quite helpful for therapists and patients with phobias, PTSD (Post-traumatic-stress-disorder), OCD and anxiety.

excerpt: What is digital and gaming addiction?
