contentHtml:
What is Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease?

When the fat accumulates inside your liver cells causing damage to liver cells is called fatty liver disease. It may even lead to liver failure if not treated for a longer period of time. Initially, the disease is asymptomatic, with symptoms only showing when the liver has been damaged severely. Hence it may be called a silent killer.

Fatty liver is of two types i.e

  • Alcoholic fatty liver
  • Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease

Alcoholic fatty liver is due to excessive intake of alcohol.  Nearly 90% of heavy drinkers develop fatty liver. In heavy drinkers, it is important to recognize the signs as early as possible because repeated damage can lead to cirrhosis. Cirrhosis is the irreparable damage caused to the liver by permanent scarring of the liver. A connection with other metabolic dysfunctions cannot be ruled out. Patients suffering from chronic alcoholism may need support from an alcohol deaddiction center to avoid liver failure due to alcohol intake.

One such deaddiction center is Tulasi Healthcare which helps people to give up alcohol drinking in chronic alcoholism cases. At Tulasi Healthcare rehabilitation of chronic alcoholics is possible. It is a full-fledged rehabilitation center with a 225-bed capacity, where de-addiction treatment for alcohol is given.

Non-Alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD)is due to a heavy cholesterol diet or other metabolic disturbances. It has got close association with obesity and type 2 diabetes mellitus.

Moderate or heavy alcohol use can cause additional damage and fat accumulation in the liver in people with NAFLD. Therefore patients with NAFLD should avoid alcohol entirely if possible.

Stages of Fatty Liver Disease

The fatty liver disease can be divided into three grades or stages depending on the amount of afat stored and the level of damage caused to liver.

GRADE 1 : in this stage patient is asymptomatic and disease is not diagnosed until routine check up or abdominal sonography is done for other indications. This stage is reversible because  no irreversible damage to liver is caused by this time.

GRADE 2: in this stage mild symptoms are seen such as pain in upper right quadrant of abdomen or below the ribs, nausea and some inflammation in the liver cells. Inflammation is the sign that liver is self healing. Like the first stage this stage is reversible too , because no irreversible damage to liver is caused by this time. The condition is known as liver steatosis.

GRADE 3: In this stage damage becomes irreversible as scarring of liver tissue has already taken place and the condition is known as liver cirrhosis.

Risk Factors for Fatty Liver Disease

  • Obesity
  • Liver Injury
  • Dyslipidemia
  • Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
  • Hypertension

During the process of alcohol metabolism, alcohol, and its metabolites have various effects on metabolic-related abnormalities. Some examples are given below:

Obesity and alcohol consumption: Heavy alcohol consumption is associated with increased body weight as well as waist circumference due to increased total energy intake and impaired peripheral or central insulin signaling pathways.

Although light to moderate alcohol consumption is likely to maintain normal body weight through improved insulin resistance.

Liver injury and alcohol consumption: Heavy alcohol consumption exerts synergistic effects on liver injury. In obese patients, this effect is more prominently seen. Two important mechanisms are the Liver-adipose tissue axis and the liver-gut axis.

Lipid metabolism and alcohol consumption: Alcohol is related to increased triglyceride and HDL levels. However, the anti-oxidant effects of HDL are different showing impaired anti-oxidative properties in heavy alcohol consumption with poor liver function. However low to moderate alcohol consumption shows enhanced anti-oxidative properties.

Type 2 diabetes mellitus and alcohol consumption: Heavy alcohol consumption is associated with an increased risk of type 2 diabetes mellitus mainly because of impaired insulin signaling, decreased insulin secretion, and insulin resistance. However low to moderate alcohol consumption, especially in combination with a healthy lifestyle is related to improved insulin resistance and decreased risk of type 2 diabetes mellitus partly through regulating the expression of adiponectin.

Hypertension and alcohol consumption: The effects of alcohol consumption on blood pressure are common. Heavy alcohol consumption is usually associated with significantly increased blood pressure and risk of hypertension, while in low to moderate alcohol consumption risk of hypertension is lower.

The treatment for alcoholic fatty liver disease is available at Tulasi Healthcare Center located at Sector- 64, Gurgaon. Here a team of Psychiatrists,  M.B.B.S doctors, Psychologists, and Gastroenterologists (available on call) help you with alcohol addiction treatment as well as Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease by bringing lifestyle changes and following a proper diet.

h1: Drug Addiction Treatment Centre in Delhi, Gurgaon and NCR
excerpt: Drug Addiction Treatment Centre in Delhi, Gurgaon Drug addiction or substance use disorder is a chronic relapsing disorder in humans characterized by compulsive drug seeking causing physical and psychological damage despite adverse consequences. Alcohol, marijuana, nicotine, sleep and anti-anxiety medications are few of the known substances considered as drugs and may cause brain disorder, heart […]
contentHtml:
Drug Addiction Treatment Centre in Delhi, Gurgaon

Drug addiction or substance use disorder is a chronic relapsing disorder in humans characterized by compulsive drug seeking causing physical and psychological damage despite adverse consequences. Alcohol, marijuana, nicotine, sleep and anti-anxiety medications are few of the known substances considered as drugs and may cause brain disorder, heart diseases, and malfunctioning of any organ of your body and may even lead to death if left untreated. Detoxification is the first step for treating any person suffering from drug addiction. Other popular addiction treatment are counselling and behavioural programs and medications.

Why do People Get Drug Addicted?

Some major causes of drug addiction are given below:

Curiosity and social pressure: Peer pressure among teens can be strong enough to get oneself addicted to drugs. Since adolescence is a developmental period among individuals, curiosity or adventure to explore new things including drugs can invite drug addiction among teens at such an early stage of life.

To feel good: At initial stage consumption of drugs can produce intense feelings of pleasure. This feeling of pleasure is followed by other effects, which vary with the type of drug consumed. For instance, stimulants namely cocaine, consumption of which lead to feelings of increased energy, power and self-confidence. On the other hand, consumption of heroine brings feelings of relaxation and satisfaction.

To feel better: Some people suffering from stress, social anxiety, and depression start consuming drugs to feel less anxious. Stress can play an important role to start consuming drugs as well as relapse (return to drug use) in patients who are going through addiction treatment or drug addiction rehab.

To do better: At times, people feel pressure to improve their focus in studies, or at work or their performance in sports. This can play a role in trying or continue consuming drugs, such as cocaine or prescription stimulants.

Factors Increasing Risk of Addiction

Some of the factors which increase the risk of addiction are mentioned below:

Biological Factors: Genes, stage of development and even ethnicity or gender can affect a person’s risk of drug addiction. Scientists have estimated that a person’s gene including environmental factors (epigenetics) can account for a person’s risk of drug addiction by 40-60 percent. Studies have shown that teens and person’s with mental disorder are exposed to greater risk of drug addiction than others.

Peer and School: Friends and peers may have an increasingly strong increase on a person to get drug addicted especially during their teens. Teens with drug addiction can sway even those without risk factors to try to experience the same for the first time. Children with poor social skill or struggling in school are more prone to become drug addicted.

Home and Family: The home environment particularly during childhood play an important role for children getting drug addicted. Parents or older family members who consume drugs or alcohol and evening breaking law can contribute to children’s risk of future drug addiction.

Early use: Research studies have shown that people starting to use drugs at an early age are more prone to develop serious problems. This is mainly due to the harmful effect that drugs can have on the brain which is at a development stage and might be a result of a mix of early social and biological factors, which may include exposure to physical or sexual abuse, lack of a stable home, genes or mental illness.

How the drug is taken: Smoking or injecting a drug into veins increases its addictive potential as this enter the brain within seconds, leading to a powerful rush of pleasure. However, this intense high drops abruptly within few minutes. Scientists believe this powerful contrast drives people to repeatedly use drugs to recapture the feeling of pleasure leading to drug addiction.

Common Symptoms of Drug Addiction

Some common symptoms of drug addiction are given below:

Signs and Symptoms of Use of Hashish, Marijuana, and other Cannabis-Containing Substances

  • Having an intense urge to use drugs that block any other thoughts.
  • With increasing time, over use of the drug is desired to get the same effect.
  • Amount of dosage of use of drugs increases.
  • Making certain that the supply of drugs is readily available.
  • Spending money on drugs even not in a position to afford it.
  • Cutting off on social or recreational activities, not meeting work responsibilities or obligations because of use of drugs.
  • To continue use of drugs, even though the person knows it is causing physical or psychological harm.
  • Doing illegal activities, viz stealing to get permanent supply of drugs.
  • Doing risky activities when the person is under the influence of the drug.
  • Failing in repeated attempts to stop using the drug.
  • Experience withdrawal symptoms when the addicted attempts to stop using the drug.

Cannabis containing substances are used either by eating, smoking, or inhaling a vaporized form of the drug. These are often used along with alcohol or other illegal drugs. Some of the common signs and symptoms of consuming the same is given below:

  • Feeling high or a sense of euphoria.
  • An enhanced sense of taste, visual and auditory perception.
  • Increase in the heart rate and blood pressure.
  • Red eyes.
  • Mouth becoming dry frequently.
  • Decrease in coordination skill.
  • Difficulty in concentrating or remembering things.
  • Slowed down in reaction time.
  • Being anxious or paranoid thinking.
  • Yellow fingertips or cannabis odour from clothes.
  • Major cravings for certain food at odd hours.
  • Frequent cough and cold with lung infection.

Signs and Symptoms of Use of K2, Spice and Bath Salts

Two groups of synthetic drugs — synthetic cannabinoids, also called K2 or Spice, and substituted or synthetic cathinones are sprayed on dried herbs and then smoked. These can also be prepared as a herbal tea and is vaporized and used in electronic cigarettes. Some of the common signs and symptoms of consuming the same is given below:

  • Feeling high or a sense of euphoria.
  • An elevated mood.
  • An enhanced sense of taste, visual and auditory perception.
  • A feeling of extreme anxiety or agitation or paranoid thinking.
  • Hallucinations.
  • Increase in the heart rate and blood pressure or even heart attack.
  • Vomiting.
  • A feeling of confusion.
  • Violent behaviour.

Signs and Symptoms of Use of Barbiturates, Benzodiazepines and Hypnotics

Barbiturates, benzodiazepines and hypnotics are often prescribed as depressants for the central nervous system.  Phenobarbital belongs to the barbiturate category, alprazolam (Xanax), clonazepam (Klonopin), diazepam (Valium), etc belong to benzodiazepines category. While zaleplon (Sonata), zolpidem (Ambien), etc belong to the  hypnotics  category. Some of the common signs and symptoms of consuming the same is given below:

  • A feeling of drowsiness.
  • Decrease in coordination skill
  • Slurred speech.
  • Difficulty in concentrating or remembering things.
  • Decreasing mental sharpness.
  • Movement of both eyes is involuntary.
  • Lack of inhibition.
  • Reduction in heart rate and blood pressure
  • Frequent falls or meeting accidents.
  • Dizziness

Signs and Symptoms of Use of Meth, Cocaine and other Stimulants

Stimulants viz. cocaine, meth (methamphetamine), methylphenidate (Ritalin, Concerta, others) are often used to boost energy, to lose weight or control appetite, to improve performance at work or school, etc. Some of the common signs and symptoms of consuming the same is given below:

  • A feeling of high confidence and happy excitement.
  • A increase in alertness.
  • An increase in energy and restlessness
  • Change in behaviour or aggression
  • Rambled or rapid speech.
  • Unusual large pupil with the black circles in the middle of the eyes.
  • Delusions, confusions, and hallucinations.
  • A feeling of extreme anxiety or irritability or paranoid thinking
  • Body temperature, heart rate and blood pressure change is noticed.
  • Vomiting or nausea with weight loss.
  • Making poor judgement.
  • Congestion in the nasal canal and damage to the mucous membrane of the nose.
  • Decay in tooth, gum diseases and mouth sores from smoking drugs.
  • Insomnia.
  • Wearing off the drug leading to depression.

Signs and Symptoms of Use of Hallucinogens

Most common hallucinogens are phencyclidine (PCP) and lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD). Some of the common signs and symptoms of consuming the same is given below:

  • Hallucinations
  • Highly reduced perception of reality, for instance hearing colors.
  • Movement of both eyes is involuntary.
  • Decrease in coordination skill and movement
  • Impulsive behaviour
  • Aggressive and violent behaviour
  • Rapid shift in emotions
  • Increase in heart rate and blood pressure
  • Difficulty in concentrating or remembering things
  • Tremors
  • Problems speaking
  • Flashbacks, even years later after the actual event
  • Intolerance to loud noise
  • Lack of pain sensation
  • Sometimes seizures or coma

Treatments of Drug Addiction

Drug addiction is a treatable disorder, like other chronic diseases such as asthma or heart disease; it cannot be completely cured but can be managed successfully. Medication is the primary treatment of opiods (prescription pain relievers or drugs like heroin or fentanyl), which may at times is coupled with some form of behavioural therapy or counselling. Medications have proved to be effective to treat addiction to alcohol and nicotine. On the other hand, people with addictions to drugs like stimulants or cannabis, are prescribed behavioural therapies. This includes addressing each patient’s drug use patterns and drug related mental and social problems.

Detoxification

This is the first step in treating patients suffering from drug addiction. In this substance abuse treatment, a substance is cleared from the body with limiting its withdrawal reactions. In 80 % of the cases, detox centres in Delhi NCR or Gurgaon will use medications to reduce medical symptoms. For patients addicted to more than one substance, medications are applied for each to reduce withdrawal symptoms.

Counselling and behavioural therapies

Therapies are applied on a one-to-one, group, or family basis depending on the criticality of the case.  This procedure is intensive at the initial stage with the number of sessions gradually reducing over time as the patient condition improves.

Different therapies are mentioned below:

cognitive-behavioral therapy: In this addiction treatment at detox centers in Delhi NCR and Gurgaon, patients are able to recognize and change ways of thinking associated with use of such substance.

multi-dimensional family therapy: In this addiction treatment at detox centers in Delhi NCR and Gurgaon, family function around a teen or adolescent with a substance-related disorder is improved.

motivational interviewing: In this addiction treatment at detox centers in Delhi NCR and Gurgaon, an individual’s willingness to change and make adjustments to behaviors is maximized.

motivational incentives: In this therapy, positive reinforcement is applied to encourage abstinence of an individual.

Rehabilitation programs

Longer-term treatment programs at drug rehabilitation centre in Delhi NCR and Gurgaon for substance-related and addictive disorders focus on remaining drug-free and resuming function within social, professional, and family responsibilities. A few type of the facilities providing therapeutic environment are given below:

Short-term residential treatment:  Intensive counselling which focuses primarily on detoxification and prepares an individual to sustain for a prolonged period within a therapeutic community.

Therapeutic communities: In this substance abuse treatment, the patient would live in a residence for between 6 and 12 months with on-site staff and others in recovery for long term treatment. The community and staff serve play key role in helping the patient in recovery from and changes in attitudes and behaviors toward drug use.

Recovery housing: In this substance abuse treatment, drug rehabilitation centre in Delhi NCR and Gurgaon patients go for short-term stay in housing to engage with responsibilities and adapt to a new, independent life without on-going substance use. The therapy includes providing advice on handling finances and finding work, as well as providing the connection between the patient during the final stages of recovery and community support services.

Self-help groups

Drug addiction rehab at Delhi NCR and Gurgaon, help patients suffering from drug addiction help patients meet others with the same addictive disorder which in turn boosts motivation and reduces feelings of isolation of the individual. Few of the common examples are Alcoholics Anonymous (AA) and Narcotics Anonymous (NA).  Detox Centers about self-help groups can be reached by an internet search or consulting experts at Delhi NCR and Gurgaon.

Medications for Drug Addiction Treatment

Using medication withdrawal symptoms can be managed using medications during detoxification. Long term use of such medicines will help reduction for cravings of alcohol thus preventing relapse, or prevent returning to use such substance after having recovered from addiction. To prevent people with alcohol use disorder, can take the following medications:

Naltrexone: This medicine prevents the action of opioid receptors in the brain producing rewarding and euphoric effects when a person consumes alcohol and thus reduces the risk of relapse.

Acamprosate, or Campral: Long-term withdrawal symptoms, including anxiety, sleeplessness, and a general feeling of unhappiness are reduced consumping this medicine and are of special benefit for people with severe substance-related and addictive disorders.

Disulfiram, or Antabuse: This medication disrupts the breakdown of alcohol, leading to adverse effects including irregular heartbeat, feeling sick, and facial redness of such patients and proves to be effective for people having high levels of motivation toward recovery.

As mentioned in earlier section, drug addiction is a substance use disorder causing physical and psychological damage which is difficult to treat and requires on-going care. Drug rehabilitation center at Delhi NCR and Gurgaon have specialized counsellors who offer specific medical, mental, social, occupational, family, and legal needs of such patients to help in their recovery.

What does a Typical Day in a Drug Addiction Treatment Center look like?

Every day in a drug de addiction center is different. Each day brings new challenges, triumphs and decisions to the client that can help them improve their lifestyle. It is the structure and reliability of the facility that helps them cope with the needs and challenges that their body and mind pose. Physical issues are quite common in the early days of recovery, while the battle persists with mental adjustments in the later stages.

These treatment centers are closed, secure and supportive environments. Here, a specific routine is set and followed by all the people, which include treatment, recreational activities, self care and having positive interactions to boost morale.

Depending upon the condition you are being treated for, your day may be structured accordingly, with dedicated timings for rest, contemplation and rejuvenation. Therapies for clients suffering with drug addiction can include-

  • -Cognitive Behavioral Therapy
  • -Individual counseling
  • -Group therapy
  • -Trauma informed therapy
  • -Recreational therapy
  • -Exposure therapy
  • -Dialectical Behavior therapy

All these therapies are evidence based and are sure to provide relief in mild to severe cases of drug addiction. With trauma informed care and addiction care guidelines, these are the best modalities combined with medication treatment that produce the best results

Is Addiction Treatment Facility an Effective Option?

Many believe that if a person relapses, they were meant to and the treatment did not add any effective change to the person’s life- this is far from the truth.

In recovery, relapse is quite a common thing. Around 50% of people who are continuing their journey post recovery experience relapse. This is similar to any other chronic condition, like diabetes. The urge to use a substance means only one thing- adjustment in approach to treatment methods. If this reaches a level of physical dependency, a short inpatient program might be the answer you need.

Some statistics from Butler Center Hazelden Betty ford foundation explain why treatment from a certified facility and expert is the best option.

  • 80% of people who completed their treatment felt that their quality of life improved quite significantly.
  • 85%-95% of people are completely drug free even after 9 months of rehab
  • The longer the treatment plan is, the lower the relapse rate result.

Even with such advanced stats, it is with standardized and personalized treatment that a person can effectively prevent relapse and lead a life of happiness, transformation and recovery.

How to understand your Drug Addiction Treatment is Effective?

It is easy to understand your progress when you know how to spot the signs. Long term abstinence is one way to track, but other effective signs to look for include-

  • -Your emotions and mental health feel positive
  • -Your mood states have improved significantly and stabilized
  • -Your motivation to achieve goals have returned
  • -You feel closer to your loved ones and see a change in your interpersonal relationships
  • -You feel supported with your concerns and have not relapsed

These goals can be thoroughly supported with professional counseling and therapy, given that the client follows the path to sobriety with all the help and resources provided.

Looking for a Drug Addiction Treatment? We can help

Tulasi healthcare has established itself at the pinnacle of success in providing rehabilitation counseling and treatment modalities to numerous clients over the years. With our experts and support staff, the journey to recovery can be a positive and motivated one. Our expertise lies in the process of making you feel at home, and transforming you with our positivity and support. To connect with us, visit our facility today.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

FAQ's

What is drug addiction treatment?

Drug addiction treatment is a process that typically involves a combination of medication, counseling, and behavioral therapies to help individuals overcome their dependence on drugs and achieve long-term recovery.

What are the types of drug addiction treatment?

Drug addiction treatment generally involves medicine-assisted treatment, inpatient and outpatient rehab and behavioral therapies. Individual needs and the severity of the addiction will determine the most suitable type of treatment.

How long does drug addiction treatment last?

The length of drug addiction treatment varies depending on the individual's needs and the severity of the addiction. Some people may only require a few weeks of treatment, while others may require several months or even years of ongoing therapy and support.

Does drug addiction treatment work?

Yes, drug addiction treatment can be highly effective in helping people overcome their addiction and achieve long-term recovery. However, it is important to note that there is no one-size-fits-all approach to treatment, and success rates can vary depending on a variety of factors, including the individual's willingness to participate in treatment and their support system outside of treatment.

What should I expect during drug addiction treatment?

During drug addiction treatment, you can expect to participate in a variety of therapies and activities designed to help you overcome your addiction and develop the skills and strategies needed to maintain long-term sobriety. This may include individual counseling, group therapy, medication-assisted treatment, and more.

What happens after drug addiction treatment?

After drug addiction treatment, it is important to continue to receive ongoing support and care to maintain long-term sobriety. This may include attending support groups, continuing with counseling or therapy, and making lifestyle changes to support your recovery. CONTACT US

excerpt: Drug & Alcohol Rehabilitation Centre in India Mental health disorders cover a wide spectrum of illnesses which include schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, substance addiction, depression, organic disorders etc. DSM V defines Mental illness as “a syndrome characterized by clinically significant disturbance in an individual’s cognition, emotional regulation, or behavior that reflects a dysfunction in the psychological, […]
contentHtml:
Drug & Alcohol Rehabilitation Centre in India

Mental health disorders cover a wide spectrum of illnesses which include schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, substance addiction, depression, organic disorders etc. DSM V defines Mental illness as “a syndrome characterized by clinically significant disturbance in an individual’s cognition, emotional regulation, or behavior that reflects a dysfunction in the psychological, biological, or developmental processes underlying mental functioning”.

Four D’s, namely Deviance, Distress, Dysfunction, and Danger, can help explain mental illness. Patterns of psychological disturbance are typically Deviant (aberrant, unusual and atypical) Distressing (unpleasant and upsetting to the person), Dysfunctional (interfering with the person’s ability to function appropriately in a constructive manner) and Danger (to the individual or others). Symptoms of mental illness may be persistent, relapsing, remitting, or occur as single episodes. Severe mental illness greatly affects an individual’s ability to function normally. The process of restoring functioning of the individual, known as rehabilitation, is widely used in the field of mental health.

Psychiatry rehabilitation specifically encompasses the restoration of the psychological and social functioning of individuals with mental illness. It is a process that facilitates the opportunity for individuals who are impaired, disabled or handicapped by a mental illness to reach their optimal level of independent functioning. Drug & Alcohol Rehabilitation Centre in India helps in the process of enhancing the recovery of individuals with severe mental illness by teaching or restoring psychological, emotional, behavioural and social skills that will enable them to function in their community and by promoting that endeavour through a continuum of services such as pharmacological management, psychotherapy, cognitive retraining, skill development, family psychoeducation and illness management.

The rehabilitation centre in India suitably carries out psychosocial rehabilitation for a patient with mental illness in a residential setting. The services begin as soon as patient is admitted for residential treatment and are provided incessantly thereafter and is constantly modified according to the need and progress of the individual patient.

A team of specialized professionals (Psychiatrists, Clinical Psychologists, Rehabilitation Psychologists, Counsellors, Psychiatric social workers and Addiction counsellors) provides the services. who utilise concentrated programs and techniques to assist individuals with mental illness in achieving their maximum potential and functional independence.

What makes Tulasi healthcare best rehabilitation centre in India?

The top rehabilitation centres focus on personalized treatment, with qualified and licensed professionals who practice evidence-based treatment plan. Since they understood the importance of family involvement, they offer a conducive environment characterized by wholesome recovery. Full continuum of care from inpatient to outpatient services and robust aftercare ensures a smooth transition and long-termed improvement. Transparency in communication, utilizing outcome measurements and client testaments further demonstrate their pursuit of excellence making them trustworthy partners on the road to rehabilitation and recovery.

More than twenty five years of experience

Tulasi Healthcare has been providing rehabilitation for addiction and mental disorder patients for more than twenty-five years. In all these years it has constantly evolved as one of the best rehabilitation centre in India. It is one of the best rehab centre with modern infrastructure, best patient-doctor ratio and evidence-based treatment. 

Need for Rehabilitation Centre in India:

People with severe and chronic psychiatric illnesses such as bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, OCD, organic mental disorder etc may be mentally disabled by their condition, and require rehabilitation to learn basic skills. In disorders such as mental retardation, patients undergo a process of rehabilitation to learn skills necessary for daily functioning. The process of rehabilitation aims to help the patient develop social and cognitive skills which will enable them to reintegrate with the society.

This helps the person find a meaningful role for themselves and making gradual improvement in various aspects of life. It also helps in reducing the hostility of patients towards their family members and vice – versa. Rehabilitation supports the patient by improving skills, providing opportunities, and preventing stigma and discrimination against mental illness.

Goals Of Rehabilitation:

  • Recovery from mental illness– focusing on the reduction of symptoms and management of illness.
  • Reintegration of the patient– reintegration of patient with mental illness in the family and community.
  • Better quality of life– need to ensure improved quality of life for the patient.

Within a recovery framework, professionals conduct psychosocial rehabilitation. The recovery framework emphasises that recovery from mental illness is a process rather than an outcome. Recovery involves a personal journey where one rediscovers oneself while learning to live with an illness, rather than letting the illness define them.

 At an individual level, it is about the development of hope and a vision for the future. At the community level, it is about supporting engagement and participation through provision of opportunity and making connection with the person rather than the illness.

The team designed the rehabilitation programme by considering the individualised needs of the patients. Psychoeducators educate patients about their illness. After gaining insight, they actively engage in setting goals and developing skills such as self-care, communication, problem solving, and interpersonal skills through individual and group sessions. Active participation in leisure activities such as reading, painting, light exercises, indoor and outdoor sports and yoga provides patients with experiences that enhance their wellbeing and enables them to experience alternative ways of attaining contentment and enjoyment.

The focus is on helping patients with mental illness develop skills and make use of assets they require in order to thrive and be content in their way of living, learning and social environment and include a wide spectrum of services and supports. As we are aware that patients afflicted with conditions such as schizophrenia, Bipolar disorder, Substance addiction etc are likely to have some degree of impairment in cognitive functioning (in areas such as working memory, verbal memory, attention and concentration). To a large extent these impairments contribute to the severity of disability in people with mental illness and tend to predict the outcomes of treatment. Psychosocial rehabilitation helps in minimizing these impairments by actively engaging the patients in various activities by promoting a sense of fulfilment and accomplishment.

Even though recovery is an individual journey, it transpires within an interpersonal context i.e in a Psychiatric hospital. Consequently, facilitating effective collaboration and coordination between the patients with mental illness, health professionals, family and caregivers. Evidence-based psychosocial rehabilitation services are widely catered to patients living with mental illness due to their demonstrated effectiveness and recovery orientation.

Social skills training is an important aspect of rehabilitation in India

Social skills training is an important aspect of  rehabilitation. Rehabilitation centres provide social skills training. These are behavioural techniques or learning activities that enable individual with mental illness to establish or resurrect pragmatic skills in fields needed to meet the demands of interpersonal relationships, self-care, vocational and other requisites to live in a society. Social skills are also important for showing specific responses required during various social interactions.

They include verbal skills (e.g., use of suitable tone, rate and volume) and nonverbal skills(e.g., gestures and facial expressions). The individual must acquire and preserve these skills for a long time to empower their performance of social roles and increase their level of quality of life. Increasing social skill competence and improving social role functioning has been a major focus of rehabilitation.

Here is sufficient evidence to suggest that social skill training, when meticulously designed and implemented, can expand patient’s knowledge and skill level and reduce the relapse rates. Social skills training aimed to alleviate issues encountered in daily life such as enhancing personal hygiene, as well as broader issues involving medication compliance, interpersonal relationships, problem-solving and conflict resolution. Social skill training encompasses following interventions in rehabilitation centre:

Problem definition: Providing training to the patient to identify his/her deficits in behaviour in order to let him/her recognize and understand the problematic areas of his/her behavioural repertoire which need intervention and planning the appropriate intervention to resolve the problem.

Inventory of assets: Enabling the patient to recognize his/her strengths. Patient usually suffer from a negative self-image and are not in a position to recognize their strengths. They make themselves aware of their strengths and utilizing these assets helps them to improve their problem-solving capacity.

Goal setting: Helping the patient to focus his/her attention on specific areas and not to disperse in the pursuit of sometimes unachievable expectations.

Behavioural rehearsal: Patients usually do not achieve a high degree of proficiency in their skills from the beginning, the tasks require lengthy rehearsal, usually by means of role playing.

Shaping: Shaping is the building of complex sequences and chains of social behaviour through successively reinforcing small step along the way.

Prompting: It is a technique which enables patients to reinforce positive elements even before such elements actually occurred with the help of various types of prompts.

Modeling: Demonstrating to the patient specific behaviour or skill as an example, in such a form that the patient may understand and rehearse it.

Cognitive Rehabilitations: Presence of neuro cognitive deficits in long term mental illness such as Schizophrenia, Bipolar disorder, Substance addiction has provoked clinicians to focus on neuropsychological rehabilitation. In cognitive rehabilitation there are mainly three general targets:

(a)Restoration: Cognitive training and exercises directed towards strengthening and restoration of cognitive function.

(b)Substitution: Compensatory strategies are directed towards substitution of lost functions and promoting conservation of affected brain functions.

(c)Restructuring: Cognitive restructuring, or cognitive reframing, is a therapeutic process that helps the client discover, challenge, and modify or replace their negative, irrational thoughts.

Rehabilitation is a multidimensional therapeutic intervention which requires active participation and coordination among inter-disciplinary team of professionals to promote optimum level of functioning of the patients with mental illness in a Psychiatric hospital. Psychosocial rehabilitation is a comprehensive approach that includes numerous therapeutic elements such as emphasis on medication compliance, insight generation, self-care, cognitive retraining, skill development and community living by focusing on the strengths of the individual suffering from mental illness. Rehabilitation, especially for long-term patients, does not end with discharge. On the contrary, it is intensified as the patient come face to face with the realities and problems of life in the community. Constant support from trusted professional team is essential during the bridging phase as the experiences gained at earlier stages of programme are to be consolidated and augmented, as the person successfully integrates back to the community.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

FAQ's

What is a rehabilitation center?

A rehabilitation center can be defined as a facility that offers specialty programs and services aimed at helping people manage various mental health issues and addiction disorder such as anxiety, OCD, schizophrenia, bipolar and other mental disorders.

What types of rehabilitation services are offered in Tulasi Healthcare?

Services include addiction treatment for various substances, treatment for various mental disorders & counseling, DTMS, VR, MECT and more.

How do you know if you need rehabilitation?

Consult with a mental healthcare specialist who evaluate your condition and suggests the most appropriate treatment plan for your condition. He or she may recommend admission to a rehabilitation centre if necessary.

contentHtml:
Alcohol and Drug Rehab in Gurgaon

Tulasi Healthcare is the best Alcohol and Drug Rehab centre in Gurgaon. Inaugurated in November 2020, the 125 bedded modern facility has state-of-the-art infrastructure along with top notch medical experts making it one of the most sought after treatment center for Alcohol and Drug Dependency in the whole of North India.

The round-the-clock availability of medical and paramedical staff along with the mental health professionals ensures that the treatment seeker is provided with a seamless medical care experience so that they can recover at the earliest. 

Alcohol and drug addiction are some of the most unnerving and upcoming issues in today’s times. From adolescents to adults, there has been a very steep increase in the consumption of these illicit substances. This growth has negatively impacted the mindset and societal values in our country.

Alcohol and drugs are heavily influencing our culture- and it has permeated every source of our well being and poisoned it to its core. Its bold advertisements and growing popularity has added to its exponential boom. The use of such substances is now considered a norm to fit into societies and participate in its activities- which is not an option for some people who struggle with peer pressure and fall under its spell under social pretense.

Rehabilitation Centre in Gurgaon

Our Alcohol and Drug Rehab in Gurgaon focuses on providing a holistic treatment for recovery with an emphasis on relapse prevention and psycho-education of the patient as well as the patient’s family as to measures to be taken for managing the situation in case of relapse.

Our Mental Health Professionals include experts in the fields of Psychiatry and Psychology who have been selected based on their ability to carry out their duties as per the standards established by Tulasi Healthcare and they undergo periodic training and performance evaluation to ensure that high quality treatment is provided to the clients. 

A rehab center is a necessity in cases where an individual feels that they are no longer in control. The people around them feel that they are truly dependent upon the illicit substance and this is causing a great amount of harm to them and their family as well.

Insight generation is necessary- this is because most individuals do not even realize that the things that they are experiencing are a problem to them and to others. Their social, emotional, occupational and mental well being always suffers in the process, leaving them with no choice but to accept their issues. As one of the best rehab centers in Gurgaon, we understand the need to have access to the best mental health care possible- because it impacts every other aspect of our lives.

We host experts from every mental health faculty that helps us chart the best course of action for our clients. Our team includes psychiatrists, psychologists, therapists, psychiatric nurses, social workers and counselors from every walk of life. This ensures that the client is tended to in every way possible and every concern is heard.

We are not only involved in caring for our clients, but also maintain our values and ethics in every step that we take.

Treatment

The team of psychiatrists decide the best possible medication plan to help the patient transition from the withdrawal state to the initial recovery stage. After Which the team of psychologists work alongside the psychiatrists to help the patient with their long term recovery.

We believe that along with medication, psycho-education and counseling, the 12 step program is of immense and indispensable help when it comes to recovery. The support group of this spiritual program composed of people who have recovered and of those who are in recovery provides the patient with the strength and the faith to go through the ups and downs of life in recovery.

Facilities Offered

An Indoor stadium with a provision for badminton, football, cricket and basketball. Table tennis, pool and billiards tables alongside a gym ensure that the patient has an opportunity to work on their physical health as well as indulge in recreational activities which boost recovery. A yoga instructor helps the patients with individualized as well as group yoga sessions as per the individuals requirements.

Regular follow-ups of discharged patients help ensure the efficacy of treatment. Family centric approach improves the interpersonal relationship of the patient and their family thereby countering emotional triggers at home. Living up to our motto of truly “Restoring Families and Saving Lives”.

Revisiting healthcare management with Best rehabilitation center in Gurgaon

The changing landscape of addiction and psycho-somatic care has led institutions like ours to develop on an elevated level, motivating us to become the driving force of change in the field of rehabilitation. As the epicenter of addiction and related problems, the national capital has seen its own struggles in managing these issues on a deeper level.

As pioneers in this field, we strive to change some major horizons- providing accessible rehab care and building a trustworthy rapport within our client circle that need help returning to their daily lives, as all of us deserve.

Tulasi Healthcare is a renowned entity when it comes to rehab treatment, especially focusing on client-centered approaches in every way possible.

Changing landscape- A glance

Gurgaon and NCR region is grappling with a very sensitive situation where substance abuse and alcohol addiction have taken over. With a 44.7% prevalence of heroin and 26.4% rates of alcohol abuse, the situation is indeed dire.

With these issues, underlying and comorbid conditions surface, the most common being anxiety, depression and personality disorders. Keeping this in focus, Tulasi healthcare has been active on all fronts in providing the much needed care and education on related aspects.

Our Vision at Tulasi Healthcare

At Tulasi Health Care, we are first and foremost caretakers of our client’s well being. Our vision extends on the grounds of making our services accessible and approachable by all.

Our holistic and scientific therapy takes the client’s perspective foremost  in every way possible and aims to produce a positive impact into the lives of our clients. We promote awareness towards curbing addiction and the stigma that surrounds in seeking help for our loved ones.

Treatment Approaches our Rehabilitation Facility

Actively working towards our client’s well being, we are truly involved in ensuring that every individual receives the best tailored approach according to their needs.Our overall approach is bound in these mentioned steps with usual tweaks as needed per case.

  • In-depth consultation and pre-counselling
  • ensure insight development for a speedy recovery.
  • Amplifying rehabilitation through medically assisted detoxification
  • Therapeutic approach (12 step therapy)
  • Behavior modification and recovery amplification through Cognitive Behavior Therapy (CBT), Rational Emotive Behavior Therapy (REBT) and other solution focused therapies modified according to the client’s condition and needs.
  • Holistic treatment approaches based on eastern knowledge and skills
  • Psychoeducation to every involved individual to promote awareness
  • Occupational therapy and rehabilitation to enhance skills and introduce a real change into their lives.

Services at our Mental Healthcare Facility in Gurgaon

Rooted in holistic evaluation, treatment and scientifically backed care options, we provide a wide range of care options with customized stay and care options for our clients.

Psychiatric care center

Among a few centers in the country, Tulasi healthcare stands amongst the top ones that provide in-patients optimal care for problems like bipolar disorders, schizophrenia, personality disorders, depression, anxiety and other comorbid disorders. Our inpatient care boasts a variety of care options customized for every patient’s needs. Extremely focused on mental rehabilitation, we take pride in our excellent care facility.

Psychiatry Treatment Center

De Addiction care

Our leading de addiction rehabilitation center in Gurgaon is thoroughly equipped for handling every type of problems that one encounters as an addict. Our mission to provide moral and medical support to overcome the mindset of moral failure is exhibited through our team of experts. We are specialized in dealing with addictions like Marijuana, Alcohol, drug, smoking, cocaine, heroine and digital/ gaming areas.

De Addiction Center

Rehabilitation services​

Our comprehensive approach takes psychological interests in healing addiction issues from the roots. Applying therapeutic interventions that include Cognitive Behavioral Therapy and Family therapy to enhance rehabilitation, our mission is to eradicate addiction on a psychological level.

Rehab Services

Medical Interventions

Addressing psychiatric concerns can be a matter of in-depth analysis, and our experienced professionals are expertly trained in finding the root causes of these concerns on a physical level. Through Deep TMS and Modified Electroconvulsive therapy, we find the root of issues like Depression and OCD that help prevent comorbid issues as well.

Psychiatric Interventions

Relapse Prevention

Relapse into old addictive ways is always a possibility, but as a top rehabilitation center in Gurgaon, we are prepared to handle every alternate scenario that comes with issues like addiction. Our relapse prevention program helps the clients to turn back from their own ways and discover a life that is full of opportunities and a new mindset that comes with it.

Relapse Prevention Plan

Why Choose Tulasi Health Care?

Establishing a top-notch neuro-psycho-social rehabilitation center in Gurgaon, let’s see why Tulasi Health Care is the right choice for your loved ones.

  • Industry experts– Led by Dr. Gorav Gupta, a leading psychiatrist in the field, Tulasi Health Care has grown to be a team of 25+ psychologists in different areas along with 7 psychiatrists to cater to medical needs of the clients.
  • Round the clock support– Our dedicated support staff is available 24/7 to assist with any need and emergency that arises at our facility. Our care extends beyond working hours for our patients.
  • Customized treatment & stay– We focus on comprehensive recovery programs that provide both inpatient and outpatient services.
  • Psychotherapy support– Our skilled experts offer great insight through continuous support from individual and family therapies that offer a cathartic support and enhance the healing journey of our clients.
  • Aftercare support– To ensure success of our treatment program in the long run, we provide a comprehensive follow up on our client’s progress.

When multiple approaches are combined together, they bring together their strengths and amplify their powers to bring out the best results. With our evidence based therapy approaches combined with age old holistic measures, we make sure that the client receives a care regime that is truly suited to them and nourishes that mind, body and soul.

Our team makes sure to review every interpersonal dynamics in your lives to understand its impact on your mental well being. This ensures that whatever measures we employ are not only aimed at treating the specified condition but also improve your life’s dynamics in the long run.

Understanding the practical issues in your life that arise from the disruption caused by alcohol and drug abuse is also necessary. This ensures that when the person steps back into the society, they will be equipped with healthy and practical mechanisms to cope with the issues that they face. Such therapeutic interventions are quite necessary, which are thoughtfully addressed by our team of psychiatrists.

Levels of care at Tulasi

There are multiple modalities through which we help our clients gain the transformation and independence they need in their lives. We offer many levels of care at Tulasi, which include-

  • Aftercare support program- The path after healing isn’t naturally smooth and automatic, it requires regular observations and follow ups to understand the level of adjustment. The road to ultimate healing and development is a bumpy one- riddled with challenges of relapse and peer interactions. It is upon us as caregivers to understand the intricacies and challenges of the real world and provide appropriate support to such individuals. We are committed to providing long term sobriety through steps like-
    • Continued therapeutic support
    • Group counseling sessions
    • Family support groups
    • Psychoeducation camps

Active involvement in these activities can reduce the risk of relapse and offer a way to extend the life long care regime.

  • Inpatient program- When conditions of addiction are unmanageable at a personal level, inpatient program is considered. Here, the client is assessed under a 24/7 supervision where he is provided with consistent and benevolent support by all members of the staff and experts. A sincere update and exposure is given to clients about their conditions and goals for their treatment are decided in accordance with their level of insight.

Our 12 step program is applied under careful supervision that addresses the pressing concerns and understands its immediate impact on the client’s health and well being. An inpatient program uses intensive methods to rehabilitate the client, and as one of the best rehab centers in Gurgaon, we are proud to provide the best care programs in the region.

  • Partial hospitalization program- A partial hospitalization program allows individuals to pursue their treatment as well as have a flexible schedule to be present in their family, society and work environment. This approach is practically applicable for people who experience mild or moderate symptoms from their addiction but still have enough insight to move towards their transformation. PHP builds hands-on skill and immediate applicability to change the maladaptive patterns in their lives. This however, is only available under certain circumstances and as per the assessments made by the experts,

Delving into a healing journey with our mental rehabilitation procedures

Helping our clients embark on a transformative journey, our mental wellness support is of crucial importance in our treatment plan. Our approach to our treatment plan is beyond the “mainstream” methods of recovery. This is how-

  • We help you rediscover the purpose and meaning of life with meditative and psychotherapeutic methods.
  • Providing the aftercare and familial support needed to stand back on your feet
  • Connecting you with additional resources to provide overall care.

Dedicated experts that prioritize your recovery in every manner possible.

Willing to approach a changed lifestyle? We’re Here to help.

If you’re looking to speed up and develop the insight you need to set out on your transformative journey, we’re here to help in every manner possible. Our dedicated team is ready to connect with necessary resources to get you started on your rehabilitation journey.

Is rehabilitation a painful process?

No, rehabilitation involves medically assisted time-based flushing out of toxins from one’s body, which is done under the supervision of psychiatrists, psychologists and other medical professionals. Yes. We are open to molding our treatment plans keeping in mind it does not hinder the patient’s well-being. Our services are meant to provide comfort and peace of mind to all involved in this tedious journey.

contentHtml:
Tulasi Healthcare

Psychiatric Hospital & Rehabilitation Centers​ in Gurgaon & Delhi

Tulasi Healthcare is a widely renowned group of psychiatric hospital & Rehabilitation Centers in Delhi and Gurgaon, India providing specialized treatment for substance abuse disorders and mental illnesses.

Tulasi was co-founded by Dr. Gorav Gupta and Dr. Ruchika Gupta. The operations started with a small, yet highly qualified team comprising of 1 psychiatrist and 2 psychologists. The facility at that time in Mehrauli was sufficient to cater to the needs of 10 patients.

Mental Research Society, an NGO started by the same group was established and commenced its operations. Keeping in mind the requirement for a halfway home & psychiatric hospital for patients with chronic psychiatric illnesses, Tulasi Home was established.

Moving ahead on the growth ladder, the group has been consistently revamping and enhancing the treatment facilities. Another psychiatric nursing homes & Rehabilitation Centers was started by the group in Mandi, Delhi. With the same, the combined number of active treatment seekers reached 125.

With the evolving needs of Mental Health Domain, the group is coming up with its state-of-art facility in Gurgaon, which will be sufficient for additional 125 patients requiring treatment for mental illnesses and addiction disorders. The combined employee strength stands at a proud 100 employees today.

At Tulasi Health Care, the following modes of treatment are adhered to:

  • Medication
  • Psychosocial Rehabilitation
  • Family education for mental illness, addiction and relapse prevention

Treatment

  • Tobacco De Addiction
  • Cocaine De Addiction
  • Schizophrenia Treatment
  • Marijuana De Addiction
  • Dual Diagnosis
  • CBT Behavioural Therapy
  • Alcohol De Addiction
  • Bipolar Disorder Treatment
  • Obsessive Compulsive Disorder Treatment
  • Dementia Treatment

Being a top rated drug de-addiction and psychiatric hospital in Delhi NCR, we provide the best possible treatment of the above mentioned illnesses. A team of qualified psychiatrists, psychologists and paramedical staff are committed to the treatment of patients dealing with addiction(s) and mental health disorder(s).

After a patient is admitted to one of our psychiatric nursing homes & Rehabilitation Centers, various integrative therapies are initiated, so as to facilitate the patients to digress from thinking about their addictions and mental disorders. Yoga, laughter therapy, social gathering, games, routine exercise and meditation are included in our rehabilitation programs. Family members are made aware of ways to deal with their relative’s (patient’s)problems.
Psychosocial rehabilitation helps an individual in making changes to their thinking, goals, information, skills and self esteem. Owing to these changes, a patient no longer sees himself/herself as someone suffering from the diagnosed disease or as a liability, but regards himself/herself as a person who can live prosperous and gratifying lives, so as to contribute to his/her individual growth.

Key Features of Our Rehabilitation Program:
  • Timely detection, including screening and intervention.
  • Comprehensive assessment and personalized treatment plan.
  • Contracting with patients using the carrot and stick approach (to reward good behavior and to punish bad behavior can improve treatment outcomes).
  • Social skills training: The basis for cognitive behavioral therapy.
  • Continuous care for patients.

Tulasi Healthcare is now empanelled with SBI General Insurance and Future Generali Insurance for cashless treatment of patients with mental health problems.

contentHtml:
Admission into a Psychiatric Mental Hospital in Delhi NCR

Though most persons with mental disorders probably won’t be admitted to a psychiatric hospital or a mental hospital, an individual may need to be hospitalized. If there is a risk of suicide or harm to others or in scenarios where leading life normally becomes challenging. In a few cases, the patients may even get violent, and the prescribed medication may need to be adjusted. In certain cases, the patients may even need to be monitored after an acute episode when their mental illnesses temporarily worsened. A person may also be hospitalized in a psychiatric hospital or a mental hospital. If it is decided that it is the best decision at the demand of a nominated representative or a mental health professional.

It is vital to warily review if hospitalization into a psychiatric hospital or into a mental hospital is essential for oneself or for a relative/ kith & kin. whether or not it is the finest choice given the conditions.

In-Patient Care in a Psychiatric Hospital

In-patient care is not meant to keep a patient confined for ever; the goal is to encourage sovereign living by using the most appropriate & optimal level of care for one’s specific illness.

There are also times when a person becomes so ill that they are at risk of hurting themselves or others and hospitalization into a psychiatric hospital or mental hospital becomes necessary. Even though the individual does not wish to enter a psychiatric hospital or mental hospital.

While looking for help willingly is always encouraged, a family member may have to make the decision to hospitalize someone with a mental illness involuntarily in a psychiatric hospital or mental hospital. This deed, while difficult to undertake, is more considerate and compassionate than it seems to be if that is the only way to get someone the help they need. A caregiver must consider helping his/her loved one lead an optimistic life, especially if the sufferer is showing signs of mental illness.

Treatment Options

The treatment options depend on the level of care which the patient needs. Below feature descriptions of some of the facility types that offer different forms of care to cater to different needs of mentally ill patients:

  • In-patient, 24-hour care is provided by the psychiatric units within general hospitals, and also at private psychiatric hospitals. Care is supervised by psychiatrists, and provided by psychiatric nurses and group therapists.
  • Short-term and long-term care is made available to needy and homeless people at public psychiatric hospitals.
  • Therapeutic services are provided during if the mentally ill patients are partially hospitalized, but not on a 24-hour basis. These establishments are commonly referred to as halfway homes. This may well be a transitional step between residential care and discharge.

Facility at best mental hospital in Gurgaon NCR

  • Largest Team of Psychiatrist & Psychologists. 
  • Separate Male & Female wards.
  • Daily Counselling sessions. 
  • Post Discharge care program.
Contact us FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

FAQ's

What does it mean to be in a mental hospital?

Persons who are advised for residential treatment at a mental hospital usually have been struggling with serious mental health conditions such as bipolar, depression, schizophrenia, dementia & OCD, etc. Such psychiatric patients require long-term assistance due to reduced functioning because of mental disorders and hence need 24*7 residential care. There should be no stigma associated with hospitalization in a mental hospital.

Can you prevent mental health problems?

Anyone can suffer from mental health problems. To develop mental well-being requires identifying and seeking help early which can prevent serious deterioration.

Are there cures for mental health problems?

There is no cure as of now for mental health issues. Mental health problems can be controlled with the help of counseling & medications.

How do I know if I'm unwell?

Mental illness can cause problems in one's daily life, work or relationship. There for it is important to identify issues related to mental health. These are the early signs of mental health problems such as anxiety or worry, unusual behavior, insomnia, mood swings, depression & social withdrawal.

Which country has the healthiest Mental Health?

Sweden tops the positive mental health index with a Positive mental well-being score: 7.13 out of 10.

contentHtml:
Privacy Policy

this is the code – Last Updated: 04-09-2026

Introduction

Tulasi Healthcare (“Tulasi Healthcare”, “we”, “our”, or “us”) is committed to protecting the privacy and confidentiality of individuals using the Tulasi Healthcare mobile application (“App”). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, disclose, and safeguard your personal information when you access or use the App. By using the App, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.

Information We Collect

Depending on the services you access through the App, we may collect the following categories of information:

Personal Information: Name, age, gender, emergency contact and other identification details provided by you.

Contact Information: Mobile number, email address, postal address, and other communication details.

Health Information: Information relating to your mental health, medical history, consultations, diagnoses, treatment plans, prescriptions, assessments, and any other health information voluntarily shared by you for receiving healthcare services.

How We Use Your Information

We may use your personal information for purposes including:

Creating and managing your user account.

Providing healthcare, counselling, consultation, and related services.

Scheduling appointments and facilitating communication with healthcare professionals.

Improving the quality, functionality, and security of the App.

Complying with applicable legal, regulatory, and healthcare obligations.

We process your information only where permitted by applicable law or with your consent, where required.

Protection of Your Information

We implement appropriate administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, misuse, or loss. Access to personal information is restricted to authorized personnel and service providers who require such access for legitimate business or healthcare purposes.

Under Section 23 of the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017, all mental health information and medical records are strictly confidential.

The information here includes information which is stored and maintained electronically or digitally. However, we might share such information wherever permitted or required by law, including for the purposes of providing treatment with the members of the treating team or with a duly authorized representative after obtaining proper consent.

The disclosure of information might also be done in cases where it is necessary to prevent harm, violence, or threat to life, or to adhere to any orders passed by the competent court or authority.

Patients can choose to add their care-givers’/NR/any other authorized person’s name while registering on the app with whom the wish to share their information, the onus of such transaction/disclosure remains on the patient himself in such cases.

In all such situations, Tulasi will try to limit the disclosure of information that is reasonable and necessary for the relevant purpose.

All personal and health data is primarily stored and processed on secure servers located within India (AWS India Region). Any cross-border data transfer to third-party SDKs or service providers complies strictly with the DPDP Act 2023, ensuring processing only occurs in jurisdictions or frameworks permitted by Indian regulatory authorities.

The App contains specific caretaker flows for minor patients. In accordance with the DPDP Act 2023:

Processing data of individuals under 18 years of age requires verifiable parental or lawful guardian consent.

We do not track behavior, construct behavioral profiles, or serve targeted advertisements to minors.

Data Retention and Security Standards

Data Retention: We retain medical and health records for a minimum statutory period of 3 years from the date of your last consultation (or up to 20 years for specialized mental health/long-term clinical records) or for as long as necessary to provide our services, comply with legal and regulatory requirements, resolve disputes, and enforce our legal rights, in accordance with Indian medical record regulations. Non-health personal data and the information that is no longer required is securely deleted or anonymized once the purpose for collection ends or upon valid consent withdrawal.

Security Standards: Data is protected using end-to-end encryption (E2EE) and AES-256 encryption at rest, along with TLS 1.3 encryption in transit, adhering to HIPAA-compliant and enterprise-grade technical safeguards.

Your Privacy Rights

Under applicable law (including the DPDP Act 2023), you have the right to:

Access, review, and request copies of your data.

Correct, update, or erase inaccurate or outdated data.

Restrict or object to certain processing activities.

Receive a copy of your personal information, where applicable.

Withdraw consent for optional processing.

Right to Nominate: You have the right to nominate another individual who, in the event of your death or incapacity, can exercise your privacy rights and manage your health records under this Policy.

Also, nothing in these terms takes away or limits any of the rights of the users given to them under the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 or any other applicable laws.

The app shall not be interpreted in any manner determining the user’s legal or mental capacity merely because a user has or does not have access to a certain feature of the app. Requests may be subject to applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Data Breach Notification:

In the event of a personal data breach, Tulasi Healthcare will promptly notify the Data Protection Board of India and affected individuals without undue delay, outlining the nature of the breach, potential impact, and remedial steps taken.

Updates to this Privacy Policy

Tulasi Healthcare may revise this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in legal requirements, technology, or our services. Any updated version will be made available through the App, along with the revised “Last Updated” date. Continued use of the App after such changes constitutes acceptance of the updated Privacy Policy.

Grievance Redressal

If you have complaints, questions, or wish to exercise your rights, you may contact our designated Grievance Officer:

Name: Chandra

Designation: Data Protection & Grievance Officer

Address: Tulasi Healthcare, Sector 64, Gurgaon, Haryana, India

Email: gmoperations@tulasihealthcare.com

Response SLA: We will acknowledge your grievance within 24 hours and resolve your request within 15 business days (not exceeding the 30-day statutory limit).

Contact Us

If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or the handling of your personal information, please contact:

Email: info@tulasihealthcare.com

gmoperations@tulasihealthcare.com

We encourage users to review this Privacy Policy periodically to stay informed about how their information is collected, used, and protected.

contentHtml:
Mission

“Saving lives, restoring families”

Our mission is simply not just a mix of words, but an emotion that resonates within each and every professional that works with us. Dedicated to providing the best that the healthcare industry has to offer, we care about every problem and aspect of your lives. From the moment a client enters our facility, they are an inseparable part of our lives that deserve our utmost care and support.

Families and their bonds suffer a severe blow when people are subject to issues of mental health. This is something that has inspired us to work towards saving the lives of our clients and restoring their health. Every person is entitled to experiencing enriching moments with their loved ones, and we aim to make that dream come true for them.

We believe that every person who requires our care and support should receive it regardless of their status. Optimizing every aspect of a client’s life requires undeterred efforts and support, which has been fueling us to expand our workforce and build our mission.

We stand with our clients on their path to transformation; understanding their pasts and working together to ensure a better future for them– in the process, we also ensure lifetime relapse prevention for everyone treated here at Tulasi Healthcare.

Vision

“Premium care at affordable costs”

Mental health problems are not subject to a particular niche of the society. It can affect anyone, anytime and anywhere. We all have certain situations that trigger different kinds of responses, but the care required to tackle it is not subject to any other factor.

Our vision is simple- providing premium healthcare facilities at affordable prices. Since psychological health is subject to any strata, its care should be too. We visualize our future as a top notch rehabilitation facility for  de-addiction, psychiatric nursing and chronic care by delivering unparalleled patient experience. The amalgamation of class-leading care, knowledge, research and support is what we strive for with each step we take.

Our vision calls upon us as an organization to reach for higher standards of service excellence and to break new ground with every passing day. As an expanding organization, our vision is to enter the space of research and development to add to existing knowledge and develop strategies to enhance psychiatric care.

A restorative and transformative space for all, we envision ourselves as one of India’s most mentally transformative spaces in the coming years.
